5026 private void ShowContextMenuForWaypoint(Entity entity, WaypointData wpData)
5027 {
5028 var contextMenu = new ContextMenu();
5029
5030 bool isPointManipulating = _isCustomDragging || (_designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible && !_isPartManipulating);
5031 bool isMeasure = false;
5032 bool isScanPoint = false;
5033 bool nextIsMeasure = false;
5034 bool prevIsMeasure = false;
5035 bool isApproach = false;
5036
5037 void RefreshWaypointClassification()
5038 {
5039 isMeasure = wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null &&
5040 wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count &&
5041 wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex];
5042 isScanPoint = wpData.Path.PointTypes != null &&
5043 wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count &&
5044 string.Equals(
5045 wpData.Path.PointTypes[wpData.PointIndex],
5046 "scanpoints",
5047 StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
5048 nextIsMeasure = wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null &&
5049 wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.Points.Count &&
5050 wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count &&
5051 wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex + 1];
5052 prevIsMeasure = wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null &&
5053 wpData.PointIndex > 0 &&
5054 wpData.PointIndex - 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count &&
5055 wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex - 1];
5056 isApproach = !isMeasure && (nextIsMeasure || prevIsMeasure);
5057 if (isApproach &&
5058 wpData.Path.PointTypes != null &&
5059 wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count)
5060 {
5061 wpData.Path.PointTypes[wpData.PointIndex] = "Approach";
5062 }
5063 }
5064
5065 RefreshWaypointClassification();
5066 bool hasSharedAxisConstraint = TryGetSharedWaypointMovementAxis(
5067 wpData,
5068 out Vector3D sharedMovementAxis,
5069 out bool hasIncompatibleSharedConstraint);
5070 bool hasSharedSurfaceConstraint = HasSurfaceMeasurementReference(wpData);
5071
5072 if (isPointManipulating)
5073 {
5074 var applyItem = new MenuItem
5075 {
5076 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_AcceptPosition") ?? "Accept Position",
5077 Command = StopManipulatingCommand,
5078 CommandParameter = entity,
5079 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "✅", FontSize = 12 }
5080 };
5081 contextMenu.Items.Add(applyItem);
5082
5083 var cancelItem = new MenuItem
5084 {
5085 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_Cancel") ?? "Cancel",
5086 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "❌", FontSize = 12 }
5087 };
5088 cancelItem.Click += (s, e) =>
5089 {
5090 CancelWaypointManipulation(entity);
5091 };
5092 contextMenu.Items.Add(cancelItem);
5093 }
5094 else
5095 {
5096 var moveItem = new MenuItem
5097 {
5098 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_MovePoint") ?? "Move Point",
5099 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "🎮", FontSize = 12 },
5100 IsEnabled = true,
5101 ToolTip = hasIncompatibleSharedConstraint
5102 ? "Choose which compatible point group to detach and move."
5103 : (hasSharedAxisConstraint
5104 ? "All reused occurrences move together along their common approach axis."
5105 : (hasSharedSurfaceConstraint
5106 ? "All reused occurrences move together on the measurement surface."
5107 : "All reused occurrences move together."))
5108 };
5109
5110 void BeginWaypointMove(IReadOnlyCollection<WaypointReference>? selectedReferences)
5111 {
5112 if (selectedReferences != null)
5113 {
5114 if (_pathManager?.SplitSharedWaypointForManipulation(entity, selectedReferences) != true)
5115 return;
5116
5117 RefreshWaypointClassification();
5118 }
5119
5120 hasSharedAxisConstraint = TryGetSharedWaypointMovementAxis(
5121 wpData,
5122 out sharedMovementAxis,
5123 out hasIncompatibleSharedConstraint);
5124 hasSharedSurfaceConstraint = HasSurfaceMeasurementReference(wpData);
5125 if (hasIncompatibleSharedConstraint)
5126 return;
5127
5128 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
5129 {
5130 if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData)
5131 {
5132 ent.Selected = false;
5133 }
5134 }
5135 entity.Selected = true;
5136
5137 Point3D pt = wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex];
5138 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = wpData.Path.CloneState();
5139 _prevDragPosition = (Point3D)pt.Clone();
5140
5141 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints = new List<(ColorPath Path, int PointIndex)>();
5142 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = new List<(ColorPath Path, ColorPath OldState)>();
5143
5144 // Determine if the selected point is an approach point
5145 bool selectedIsApproach = isApproach;
5146
5147 foreach (var reference in GetValidWaypointReferences(wpData))
5148 {
5149 if (ReferenceEquals(reference.Path, wpData.Path) && reference.PointIndex == wpData.PointIndex)
5150 continue;
5151
5152 // Classify the overlapping reference point
5153 string refPointType = reference.Path.PointTypes != null && reference.PointIndex < reference.Path.PointTypes.Count
5154 ? reference.Path.PointTypes[reference.PointIndex] : "";
5155 bool refIsApproach = string.Equals(refPointType, "Approach", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
5156
5157 // If the selected point is NOT an approach point, exclude overlapping approach points
5158 // from the drag group — they have normal-direction constraints and should be moved separately.
5159 if (!selectedIsApproach && refIsApproach)
5160 continue;
5161
5162 // If the selected point IS an approach point, only include other approach points
5163 // that share a compatible normal direction (within ~5°).
5164 if (selectedIsApproach && refIsApproach)
5165 {
5166 if (reference.Path.Normals != null && reference.PointIndex < reference.Path.Normals.Count &&
5167 wpData.Path.Normals != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.Normals.Count)
5168 {
5169 double dot = Vector3D.Dot(wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex], reference.Path.Normals[reference.PointIndex]);
5170 if (dot < 0.996) // ~5° tolerance
5171 continue;
5172 }
5173 }
5174
5175 if (!_otherOverlappingBridgePoints.Any(item =>
5176 ReferenceEquals(item.Path, reference.Path) && item.PointIndex == reference.PointIndex))
5177 {
5178 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints.Add((reference.Path, reference.PointIndex));
5179 }
5180
5181 if (!ReferenceEquals(reference.Path, wpData.Path) &&
5182 !_otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Any(item => ReferenceEquals(item.Path, reference.Path)))
5183 {
5184 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Add((reference.Path, reference.Path.CloneState()));
5185 }
5186 }
5187
5188 _indirectlyMovedSharedPoints = new List<(ColorPath Path, int PointIndex, Point3D OldPosition)>();
5189 if (hasSharedSurfaceConstraint)
5190 CaptureSharedSurfaceDependentPoints(wpData);
5191
5192 string ptType = wpData.Path.PointTypes != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count ? wpData.Path.PointTypes[wpData.PointIndex] : "";
5193 if (ptType == "Bridge" || ptType == "BridgeIntermediary")
5194 {
5195 if (_pathManager != null)
5196 {
5197 foreach (var otherPath in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
5198 {
5199 if (otherPath == wpData.Path) continue;
5200 for (int k = 0; k < otherPath.Points.Count; k++)
5201 {
5202 string otherPtType = otherPath.PointTypes != null && k < otherPath.PointTypes.Count ? otherPath.PointTypes[k] : "";
5203 if (otherPtType == "Bridge" || otherPtType == "BridgeIntermediary")
5204 {
5205 if (otherPath.Points[k].DistanceTo(wpData.OriginalPosition) < 0.01)
5206 {
5207 if (!_otherOverlappingBridgePoints.Any(item =>
5208 ReferenceEquals(item.Path, otherPath) && item.PointIndex == k))
5209 {
5210 _otherOverlappingBridgePoints.Add((otherPath, k));
5211 }
5212 if (!_otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Any(item => ReferenceEquals(item.Path, otherPath)))
5213 {
5214 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Add((otherPath, otherPath.CloneState()));
5215 }
5216 }
5217 }
5218 }
5219 }
5220 }
5221 }
5222
5223 if (hasSharedSurfaceConstraint)
5224 {
5225 var closest = FindClosestFace(pt);
5226 _draggingMeasurePointFace = closest.Face;
5227 _draggingMeasurePointBrep = closest.Brep;
5228
5229 if (_draggingMeasurePointBrep != null && _draggingMeasurePointFace != null)
5230 {
5231 try
5232 {
5233 _draggingFaceMesh = _draggingMeasurePointBrep.Faces[_draggingMeasurePointFace.FaceIndex].ConvertToMesh();
5234 }
5235 catch
5236 {
5237 _draggingFaceMesh = null;
5238 }
5239 }
5240 }
5241
5242 Vector3D zAxis = hasSharedAxisConstraint
5243 ? (Vector3D)sharedMovementAxis.Clone()
5244 : wpData.Path.Normals![wpData.PointIndex];
5245 if (!hasSharedAxisConstraint && isApproach)
5246 {
5247 int mIdx = -1;
5248 if (wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.Points.Count && wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex + 1])
5249 {
5250 mIdx = wpData.PointIndex + 1;
5251 }
5252 else if (wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex > 0 && wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex - 1])
5253 {
5254 mIdx = wpData.PointIndex - 1;
5255 }
5256
5257 if (mIdx != -1)
5258 {
5259 zAxis = wpData.Path.Normals![mIdx];
5260 }
5261 }
5262
5263 if (zAxis.LengthSquared < 1e-6) zAxis = Vector3D.AxisZ;
5264 zAxis.Normalize();
5265
5266 Vector3D xAxis = Vector3D.Cross(Vector3D.AxisZ, zAxis);
5267 if (xAxis.LengthSquared < 1e-6) xAxis = Vector3D.Cross(Vector3D.AxisY, zAxis);
5268 xAxis.Normalize();
5269
5270 Vector3D yAxis = Vector3D.Cross(zAxis, xAxis);
5271 yAxis.Normalize();
5272
5273 var trans = new devDept.Geometry.Transformation();
5274 trans[0, 0] = xAxis.X; trans[0, 1] = yAxis.X; trans[0, 2] = zAxis.X; trans[0, 3] = pt.X;
5275 trans[1, 0] = xAxis.Y; trans[1, 1] = yAxis.Y; trans[1, 2] = zAxis.Y; trans[1, 3] = pt.Y;
5276 trans[2, 0] = xAxis.Z; trans[2, 1] = yAxis.Z; trans[2, 2] = zAxis.Z; trans[2, 3] = pt.Z;
5277
5278 // If it's a measure point, also select the associated approach point entity and orient camera
5279 if (isMeasure)
5280 {
5281 var approachEntity = FindApproachEntityForMeasure(wpData);
5282 if (approachEntity != null) approachEntity.Selected = true;
5283
5284 // Put camera normal to the surface for a top-down drag view
5285 /*
5286 if (_draggingMeasurePointFace != null)
5287 {
5288 _cameraUtils.OrientCameraToFacePerpendicularly(_draggingMeasurePointFace);
5289 }
5290 else
5291 {
5292 _cameraUtils.OrientCameraToNormal(pt, zAxis);
5293 }
5294 */
5295 }
5296
5297 _initialTriadTrans = trans;
5298 _manipulatingEntity = entity;
5299
5300 if (hasSharedSurfaceConstraint && !hasSharedAxisConstraint)
5301 {
5302 _isCustomDragging = true;
5303 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
5304
5305 // Keep the real measurepoint sphere visible
5306 entity.Selected = false;
5307
5308 // Create dragging sphere
5309 _draggingSphere = devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Mesh.CreateSphere(0.45, 8, 8);
5310 _draggingSphere.Color = System.Drawing.Color.LimeGreen;
5311 _draggingSphere.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
5312 _draggingSphere.Translate(pt.X, pt.Y, pt.Z);
5313 _draggingSphere.Selected = true;
5314 _designControl.Entities.Add(_draggingSphere);
5315 _draggingSpherePosition = (Point3D)pt.Clone();
5316 }
5317 else
5318 {
5319 _isCustomDragging = false;
5320 _draggingMeasurePointFace = null;
5321 _draggingMeasurePointBrep = null;
5322 _draggingFaceMesh = null;
5323
5324 ConfigureWaypointManipulator(hasSharedAxisConstraint || isApproach);
5325 _designControl.Invalidate();
5326 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Enable(_initialTriadTrans, false);
5327 _designControl.Invalidate();
5328 ConfigureWaypointManipulator(hasSharedAxisConstraint || isApproach);
5329
5330 }
5331
5332 _designControl.Invalidate();
5333 }
5334
5335 if (hasIncompatibleSharedConstraint)
5336 {
5337 var movementChoices = BuildSharedWaypointMovementChoices(wpData);
5338 if (movementChoices.Count == 0)
5339 {
5340 moveItem.IsEnabled = false;
5341 moveItem.ToolTip = "No valid path occurrence is available for movement.";
5342 }
5343 else
5344 {
5345 foreach (var choice in movementChoices)
5346 {
5347 var choiceItem = new MenuItem
5348 {
5349 Header = choice.Label,
5350 ToolTip = choice.ToolTip,
5351 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "↕️", FontSize = 12 }
5352 };
5353 choiceItem.Click += (s, e) => BeginWaypointMove(choice.References);
5354 moveItem.Items.Add(choiceItem);
5355 }
5356 }
5357 }
5358 else
5359 {
5360 moveItem.Click += (s, e) => BeginWaypointMove(null);
5361 }
5362
5363 contextMenu.Items.Add(moveItem);
5364 }
5365
5366 // Show Tool and Rotate Point are available for all waypoint types
5367 {
5368 var showToolItem = new MenuItem
5369 {
5370 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ShowToolOnPoint") ?? "Show Tool on this Point",
5371 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "🔧", FontSize = 12 }
5372 };
5373 showToolItem.Click += (s, e) =>
5374 {
5375 ShowToolPreviewOnPoint(entity, wpData);
5376 };
5377 contextMenu.Items.Add(showToolItem);
5378
5379 var checkCollisionItem = new MenuItem
5380 {
5381 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_CheckToolCollisionOnPoint") ?? "Check tool collisions on this point",
5382 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "🛡️", FontSize = 12 }
5383 };
5384 checkCollisionItem.Click += (s, e) =>
5385 {
5386 CheckToolCollisionOnPoint(entity, wpData);
5387 };
5388 contextMenu.Items.Add(checkCollisionItem);
5389
5390 var changeRotItem = new MenuItem
5391 {
5392 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ChangePointRotation") ?? "Change Point Rotation",
5393 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "🔄", FontSize = 12 }
5394 };
5395 changeRotItem.Click += async (s, e) =>
5396 {
5397 if (IsPointRotationPanelOpen)
5398 {
5399 IsPointRotationPanelOpen = false;
5400 await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(260);
5401 }
5402
5403 _pointRotationEditingWaypoint = wpData;
5404 _pointRotationBaseNormal = (Vector3D)wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex].Clone();
5405 _pointRotationBaseUp = wpData.Path.UpVectors != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.UpVectors.Count
5406 ? (Vector3D)wpData.Path.UpVectors[wpData.PointIndex].Clone()
5407 : new Vector3D(0, 1, 0);
5408 _pointRotationOldState = wpData.Path.CloneState();
5409
5410 ShowToolPreviewOnPoint(entity, wpData);
5411
5412 PointRotationX = 0;
5413 PointRotationY = 0;
5414 PointRotationZ = 0;
5415
5416 IsPointRotationPanelOpen = true;
5417 };
5418 contextMenu.Items.Add(changeRotItem);
5419 }
5420
5421 // Always show the "Delete Point" option
5422 var deleteItem = new MenuItem
5423 {
5424 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_DeletePoint") ?? "Delete Point",
5425 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "🗑️", FontSize = 12 }
5426 };
5427 deleteItem.Click += (s, e) =>
5428 {
5429 bool isManipulating = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible;
5430 if (isManipulating)
5431 {
5432 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
5433 }
5434
5435 string pointType = "";
5436 if (wpData.Path.PointTypes != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count)
5437 {
5438 pointType = wpData.Path.PointTypes[wpData.PointIndex];
5439 }
5440
5441 if (pointType == "Start" || pointType == "End")
5442 {
5443 // Do not delete normal path points like Start or End. Just cancel manipulation.
5444 if (isManipulating)
5445 {
5446 CancelWaypointManipulation(entity);
5447 }
5448 return;
5449 }
5450
5451 // Capture path state before deletion
5452 var oldState = wpData.Path.CloneState();
5453
5454 // Remove from Path
5455 if (wpData.PointIndex >= 0 && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.Points.Count)
5456 {
5457 int indexToRemove = wpData.PointIndex;
5458 wpData.Path.Points.RemoveAt(indexToRemove);
5459 wpData.Path.Normals.RemoveAt(indexToRemove);
5460 if (wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && indexToRemove < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count)
5461 wpData.Path.IsMeasure.RemoveAt(indexToRemove);
5462 if (wpData.Path.PointTypes != null && indexToRemove < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count)
5463 wpData.Path.PointTypes.RemoveAt(indexToRemove);
5464 if (wpData.Path.OriginalPoints != null && indexToRemove < wpData.Path.OriginalPoints.Count)
5465 wpData.Path.OriginalPoints.RemoveAt(indexToRemove);
5466
5467 // Update Path visuals (clears single path visuals and redraws spheres + segment lines correctly!)
5468 if (_pathManager != null)
5469 {
5470 _pathManager.DrawSinglePath(wpData.Path);
5471 }
5472
5473 // Register command in Undo history
5474 if (_pathManager != null)
5475 {
5476 UndoManager.PushCommand(new UpdateColorPathCommand(_pathManager, _designControl, wpData.Path.Color, oldState, wpData.Path.CloneState()));
5477 }
5478
5479 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
5480 _designControl.Invalidate();
5481 }
5482 };
5483 contextMenu.Items.Add(deleteItem);
5484
5485 // Only add the "Revert Position" context menu item if the point has actually been moved after generation
5486 bool canRevert = wpData.GeneratedPosition != null && wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex].DistanceTo(wpData.GeneratedPosition) > 0.001;
5487 if (canRevert)
5488 {
5489 var revertItem = new MenuItem
5490 {
5491 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_RevertPosition") ?? "Revert Position",
5492 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "↩️", FontSize = 12, Padding = new Thickness(4, 0, 0, 0) }
5493 };
5494 revertItem.Click += (s, e) =>
5495 {
5496 bool isManipulating = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible;
5497 if (isManipulating)
5498 {
5499 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
5500 }
5501
5502 var oldState = wpData.Path.CloneState();
5503
5504 // Revert the point's position to its GeneratedPosition
5505 Point3D genPos = wpData.GeneratedPosition!;
5506 if (genPos != null)
5507 {
5508 wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex] = (Point3D)genPos.Clone();
5509
5510 // If it is a measure point, update adjacent approach points back to their generated positions too!
5511 if (isMeasure && !isScanPoint)
5512 {
5513 Vector3D newNormal = wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex];
5514 var closest = FindClosestFace(genPos);
5515 if (closest.Brep != null && closest.Face != null)
5516 {
5517 try
5518 {
5519 var fn = closest.Brep.Faces[closest.Face.FaceIndex].Normal(genPos);
5520 if (fn != null && fn.Length > 1e-6)
5521 {
5522 newNormal = fn;
5523 newNormal.Normalize();
5524 }
5525 }
5526 catch { }
5527 }
5528 wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex] = newNormal;
5529
5530 if (wpData.PointIndex > 0 && wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && !wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex - 1])
5531 {
5532 var entryWd = FindWaypointData(wpData.Path, wpData.PointIndex - 1);
5533 if (entryWd?.GeneratedPosition != null)
5534 {
5535 wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex - 1] = (Point3D)entryWd.GeneratedPosition.Clone();
5536 wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex - 1] = (Vector3D)newNormal.Clone();
5537 }
5538 }
5539 if (wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.Points.Count && wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex + 1])
5540 {
5541 var exitWd = FindWaypointData(wpData.Path, wpData.PointIndex + 1);
5542 if (exitWd?.GeneratedPosition != null)
5543 {
5544 wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex + 1] = (Point3D)exitWd.GeneratedPosition.Clone();
5545 wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex + 1] = (Vector3D)newNormal.Clone();
5546 }
5547 }
5548 }
5549
5550 if (_pathManager != null)
5551 {
5552 _pathManager.DrawSinglePath(wpData.Path);
5553 UndoManager.PushCommand(new UpdateColorPathCommand(_pathManager, _designControl, wpData.Path.Color, oldState, wpData.Path.CloneState()));
5554 }
5555
5556 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
5557 _designControl.Invalidate();
5558 }
5559 };
5560 contextMenu.Items.Add(revertItem);
5561 }
5562
5563 double tolerance = 2.0;
5564 if (double.TryParse(System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["PointSelectionTolerance"], System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Any, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double parsedTolerance))
5565 {
5566 tolerance = parsedTolerance;
5567 }
5568
5569 if (wpData.PointIndex >= 0 && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.Points.Count)
5570 {
5571 Point3D currentPt = wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex];
5572 var overlappingPoints = new List<(Entity ent, WaypointData data)>();
5573
5574 foreach (var otherEnt in _designControl.Entities)
5575 {
5576 if (otherEnt != entity && otherEnt.EntityData is WaypointData otherWpData && otherEnt.Visible)
5577 {
5578 if (otherWpData.PointIndex >= 0 && otherWpData.PointIndex < otherWpData.Path.Points.Count)
5579 {
5580 Point3D otherPt = otherWpData.Path.Points[otherWpData.PointIndex];
5581 if (currentPt.DistanceTo(otherPt) <= tolerance)
5582 {
5583 overlappingPoints.Add((otherEnt, otherWpData));
5584 }
5585 }
5586 }
5587 }
5588
5589 if (overlappingPoints.Count > 0)
5590 {
5591 contextMenu.Items.Add(new Separator());
5592 foreach (var overlap in overlappingPoints)
5593 {
5594 string colorName = overlap.data.Path != null ? ColorNamer.FormatColorWithRgb(overlap.data.Path.Color) : "";
5595 var selectItem = new MenuItem
5596 {
5597 Header = $"Select point {overlap.data.PointIndex}" + (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(colorName) ? $" ({colorName})" : ""),
5598 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "📍", FontSize = 12 }
5599 };
5600 var capturedEnt = overlap.ent;
5601 var capturedWpData = overlap.data;
5602 selectItem.Click += (s, e) =>
5603 {
5604 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
5605 capturedEnt.Selected = true;
5606 _designControl.Invalidate();
5607 ShowContextMenuForWaypoint(capturedEnt, capturedWpData);
5608 };
5609 contextMenu.Items.Add(selectItem);
5610 }
5611 }
5612 }
5613
5614 contextMenu.PlacementTarget = _designControl;
5615 RegisterAndOpenContextMenu(contextMenu);
5616 }

5623 public void HighlightGeometryItem(object? item, bool selectInTree = false)
5624 {
5625 if (item == null || _visualsManager == null) return;
5626
5627 try
5628 {
5629 isUpdatingSelection = true;
5630 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
5631 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
5632
5633 if (item is CADFace face)
5634 {
5635 HighlightFace(face);
5636 if (selectInTree)
5637 _treeViewHelper.SelectFaceInTree(face);
5638 }
5639 else if (item is CADHole hole)
5640 {
5641 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(hole);
5642
5643 var topFace = GetHoleFaces(hole)
5644 .OrderBy(f => hole.TopCenterPoint == null
5645 ? 0.0
5646 : EyeshotGeometryUtils.GetFaceCenter(f).DistanceTo(hole.TopCenterPoint))
5647 .FirstOrDefault();
5648 if (topFace != null)
5649 HighlightFace(topFace, includeParentHole: false);
5650
5651 if (selectInTree)
5652 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(hole);
5653
5654 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HighlightingHole") ?? "Highlighting hole {0}", hole.HoleId);
5655 }
5656 else if (item is FacePoint vertex)
5657 {
5658 var parentFace = FindParentFaceForVertexPoint(vertex);
5659 if (parentFace != null)
5660 {
5661 if (selectInTree)
5662 _treeViewHelper.SelectVertexInTree(parentFace, vertex.VertexIndex);
5663
5664 TrySelectBrepVertex(parentFace, vertex.VertexIndex);
5665 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(parentFace, highlightVertexIndex: vertex.VertexIndex);
5666 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(parentFace);
5667 _visualsManager.ShowZoomVertexHighlight(new devDept.Geometry.Point3D(vertex.X, vertex.Y, vertex.Z), cubeSize: EyeshotVisualsManager.PreviewVertexCubeSize);
5668 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = parentFace;
5669
5670 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(parentFace);
5671 if (parentHole != null)
5672 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
5673 }
5674 else
5675 {
5676 _visualsManager.ShowZoomVertexHighlight(new devDept.Geometry.Point3D(vertex.X, vertex.Y, vertex.Z), cubeSize: EyeshotVisualsManager.PreviewVertexCubeSize);
5677 }
5678 }
5679 else if (item is Point4D controlPoint)
5680 {
5681 _visualsManager.ShowTemporaryControlPointSphere(controlPoint);
5682 }
5683
5684 _selectionUtils.TryRefreshDesignControlSelection();
5685 _designControl.Invalidate();
5686 }
5687 catch (Exception ex)
5688 {
5689 Debug.WriteLine($"Error highlighting geometry item: {ex.Message}");
5690 }
5691 finally
5692 {
5693 isUpdatingSelection = false;
5694 }

5696 void HighlightFace(CADFace cadFace, bool includeParentHole = true)
5697 {
5698 if (cadFace.EntityIndex >= 0 && cadFace.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
5699 _visualsManager.HighlightFaceVisualFallback(_designControl.Entities[cadFace.EntityIndex] as Brep, cadFace.FaceIndex);
5700
5701 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(cadFace);
5702 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(cadFace);
5703 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = cadFace;
5704
5705 if (!includeParentHole) return;
5706
5707 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(cadFace);
5708 if (parentHole != null)
5709 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
5710 }
5711
5712 List<CADFace> GetHoleFaces(CADHole hole)
5713 {
5714 if (_allFacesByColor == null || hole.FaceGlobalIndices == null || !hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Any())
5715 return new List<CADFace>();
5716
5717 return _allFacesByColor.Values
5718 .SelectMany(list => list)
5719 .Where(face => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(face.FaceGlobalIndex))
5720 .ToList();
5721 }
5722
5723 void TrySelectBrepVertex(CADFace parentFace, int vertexIndex)
5724 {
5725 if (parentFace.EntityIndex < 0 || parentFace.EntityIndex >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
5726 return;
5727
5728 if (_designControl.Entities[parentFace.EntityIndex] is not Brep brep)
5729 return;
5730
5731 try
5732 {
5733 var brepType = brep.GetType();
5734 var setVertex = brepType.GetMethod("SetVertexSelection", new Type[] { typeof(int), typeof(bool) })
5735 ?? brepType.GetMethod("SetVertexSelection", new Type[] { typeof(int) });
5736
5737 if (setVertex == null)
5738 return;
5739
5740 try
5741 {
5742 setVertex.Invoke(brep, new object[] { vertexIndex, true });
5743 }
5744 catch
5745 {
5746 setVertex.Invoke(brep, new object[] { vertexIndex });
5747 }
5748 }
5749 catch { }
5750 }
5751 }
5752
5753 private CADFace? FindParentFaceForVertexPoint(FacePoint vertexPoint)
5754 {
5755 if (_allFacesByColor == null)
5756 return null;
5757
5758 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(list => list);
5759 return allFaces.FirstOrDefault(face => face.KeyPoints != null && face.KeyPoints.Any(point => ReferenceEquals(point, vertexPoint)))
5760 ?? allFaces.FirstOrDefault(face => face.KeyPoints != null && face.KeyPoints.Any(point =>
5761 point.VertexIndex == vertexPoint.VertexIndex &&
5762 Math.Abs(point.X - vertexPoint.X) < 1e-6 &&
5763 Math.Abs(point.Y - vertexPoint.Y) < 1e-6 &&
5764 Math.Abs(point.Z - vertexPoint.Z) < 1e-6))
5765 ?? allFaces.FirstOrDefault(face => face.KeyPoints != null && face.KeyPoints.Any(point => point.VertexIndex == vertexPoint.VertexIndex));
5766 }

6094 .SelectMany(list => list)
6095 .Where(f => f.KeyPoints.Any(p => p.VertexIndex == vPoint.VertexIndex))
6096 .ToList();
6097
6098 var parentHoles = new HashSet<CADHole>();
6099 foreach (var parentFace in allParentFaces)
6100 {
6101 var phole = FindParentHoleForFace(parentFace);
6102 if (phole != null)
6103 {
6104 parentHoles.Add(phole);
6105 }
6106 }
6107
6108 string holeHeaderFormat = (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_SelectHole") ?? "Selecionar Furo") + " {0}";
6109 string holeToolTipFormat = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_SelectHoleIndexed_ToolTip") ?? "Selects Hole {0} in the item tree and displays its markers in the 3D view.";
6110 foreach (var phole in parentHoles.OrderBy(h => h.HoleId))
6111 {
6112 var menuItem = new MenuItem
6113 {
6114 Header = string.Format(holeHeaderFormat, phole.HoleId),
6115 Command = SelectHoleCommand,
6116 CommandParameter = phole,
6117 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "◎", FontSize = 18, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center },
6118 ToolTip = string.Format(holeToolTipFormat, phole.HoleId)
6119 };
6120 contextMenu.Items.Add(menuItem);
6121 }
6122
6123 if (parentHoles.Any() && allParentFaces.Any())
6124 {
6125 contextMenu.Items.Add(new Separator());
6126 }
6127
6128 string faceHeaderFormat = (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_SelectFace") ?? "Selecionar Face") + " {0}";
6129 string faceToolTipFormat = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_SelectFaceIndexed_ToolTip") ?? "Selects Face {0} in the item tree and displays its control points in the 3D view.";
6130 foreach (var parentFace in allParentFaces.OrderBy(f => f.FaceGlobalIndex))
6131 {
6132 var menuItem = new MenuItem
6133 {
6134 Header = string.Format(faceHeaderFormat, parentFace.FaceGlobalIndex),
6135 Command = SelectFaceCommand,
6136 CommandParameter = parentFace,
6137 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "⛶", FontSize = 18, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center },
6138 ToolTip = string.Format(faceToolTipFormat, parentFace.FaceGlobalIndex)
6139 };
6140 contextMenu.Items.Add(menuItem);
6141 }
6142 }
6143 else if (item is Entity ent && (ent is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Brep || ent is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Mesh))
6144 {
6145 if (ShouldOfferBaseAvoidancePlaneMenu(ent, out string? entitySourcePath))
6146 {
6147 AddToggleBaseAvoidancePlaneMenuItem(contextMenu, entitySourcePath, () => ShowBaseAvoidancePlaneForEntity(ent));
6148 contextMenu.Items.Add(new Separator());
6149 }
6150
6151 AddManipulateAndMoveMenuItems(contextMenu, ent);
6152 }
6153
6154 AddBaseAvoidanceMenuItems(contextMenu, item);
6155
6156 if (contextMenu.Items.Count > 0)
6157 {
6158 RegisterAndOpenContextMenu(contextMenu);
6159 }
6160 }

6470 private List<string?> GetVisibleBaseAvoidancePlaneSources()
6471 {
6472 var sourcesByKey = new Dictionary<string, string?>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
6473 if (_designControl == null)
6474 return new List<string?>();
6475
6476 foreach (var entity in _designControl.Entities)
6477 {
6478 if (!entity.Visible || !IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntity(entity))
6479 continue;
6480
6481 string? sourcePath = TryGetBaseAvoidanceVisualSource(entity);
6482 if (sourcePath == null)
6483 continue;
6484
6485 string sourceKey = GetBaseAvoidanceSourceKey(sourcePath);
6486 if (!sourcesByKey.ContainsKey(sourceKey))
6487 sourcesByKey.Add(sourceKey, string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sourcePath) ? null : sourcePath);
6488 }
6489
6490 var sources = sourcesByKey.Values.ToList();
6491 if (sources.Count > 1)
6492 sources = sources.Where(source => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(source)).ToList();
6493
6494 return sources;
6495 }

6502 private void IgnoreItem(object item)
6503 {
6504 SetItemIgnoredState(item, true);
6505 string desc = item is CADFace cFace
6506 ? $"Ignored Face ({ColorNamer.FormatColorWithRgb(cFace.FaceColor)})"
6507 : item is CADHole cHole
6508 ? $"Ignored Hole {cHole.HoleId} ({ColorNamer.FormatColorWithRgb(cHole.HoleColor)})"
6509 : "Ignored Item";
6510
6511 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
6512 () => SetItemIgnoredState(item, false, true),
6513 () => SetItemIgnoredState(item, true, true),
6514 desc,
6515 "Geometry"
6516 ));
6517 }
6518
6525 private void SetItemIgnoredState(object item, bool isIgnored, bool isUndoRedo = false)
6526 {
6527 if (item is CADFace face)
6528 {
6529 if (isIgnored)
6530 {
6531 if (!IgnoredFaces.Contains(face)) IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
6532 face.IsIgnored = true;
6533 if (ShowIgnoredAsTransparent)
6534 {
6535 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(new List<CADFace> { face });
6536 }
6537
6538 // A manually ignored bridge face is an independent operator
6539 // choice. Do not cascade that action into its adjacent holes;
6540 // automatic bridge ignoring remains handled during extraction.
6541 if (!face.IsBridgeBetweenHoles &&
6542 face.FaceType == FaceTypeEnum.Planar &&
6543 face.ControlPoints != null &&
6544 face.ControlPoints.Any() &&
6545 _holesByColor != null)
6546 {
6547 double faceZ = face.ControlPoints.Average(cp => cp.Z);
6548 double minX = face.ControlPoints.Min(cp => cp.X) - 1.0;
6549 double maxX = face.ControlPoints.Max(cp => cp.X) + 1.0;
6550 double minY = face.ControlPoints.Min(cp => cp.Y) - 1.0;
6551 double maxY = face.ControlPoints.Max(cp => cp.Y) + 1.0;
6552
6553 var holesOnFace = _holesByColor.Values.SelectMany(h => h).Where(h =>
6554 (h.TopCenterPoint != null && Math.Abs(h.TopCenterPoint.Z - faceZ) < 1.0 && h.TopCenterPoint.X >= minX && h.TopCenterPoint.X <= maxX && h.TopCenterPoint.Y >= minY && h.TopCenterPoint.Y <= maxY) ||
6555 (h.BottomCenterPoint != null && Math.Abs(h.BottomCenterPoint.Z - faceZ) < 1.0 && h.BottomCenterPoint.X >= minX && h.BottomCenterPoint.X <= maxX && h.BottomCenterPoint.Y >= minY && h.BottomCenterPoint.Y <= maxY)
6556 ).ToList();
6557
6558 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList();
6559 foreach (var hole in holesOnFace)
6560 {
6561 if (!IgnoredHoles.Contains(hole)) IgnoredHoles.Add(hole);
6562 hole.IsIgnored = true;
6563 var facesInHole = allFaces.Where(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)).ToList();
6564 foreach (var f in facesInHole)
6565 {
6566 if (!IgnoredFaces.Contains(f)) IgnoredFaces.Add(f);
6567 f.IsIgnored = true;
6568 }
6569 if (ShowIgnoredAsTransparent)
6570 {
6571 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(facesInHole);
6572 }
6573 }
6574 }
6575 }
6576 else
6577 {
6578 IgnoredFaces.Remove(face);
6579 face.IsIgnored = false;
6580 _ignoredItemManager.RestoreOriginalStyle(new List<CADFace> { face });
6581
6582 var parentHole = face.IsBridgeBetweenHoles
6583 ? null
6584 : IgnoredHoles.FirstOrDefault(h => h.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(face.FaceGlobalIndex));
6585 if (parentHole != null)
6586 {
6587 IgnoredHoles.Remove(parentHole);
6588 parentHole.IsIgnored = false;
6589 }
6590
6591 // Restoring a bridge face is likewise isolated from its holes.
6592 if (!face.IsBridgeBetweenHoles &&
6593 face.FaceType == FaceTypeEnum.Planar &&
6594 face.ControlPoints != null &&
6595 face.ControlPoints.Any() &&
6596 _holesByColor != null)
6597 {
6598 double faceZ = face.ControlPoints.Average(cp => cp.Z);
6599 double minX = face.ControlPoints.Min(cp => cp.X) - 1.0;
6600 double maxX = face.ControlPoints.Max(cp => cp.X) + 1.0;
6601 double minY = face.ControlPoints.Min(cp => cp.Y) - 1.0;
6602 double maxY = face.ControlPoints.Max(cp => cp.Y) + 1.0;
6603
6604 var holesOnFace = _holesByColor.Values.SelectMany(h => h).Where(h =>
6605 (h.TopCenterPoint != null && Math.Abs(h.TopCenterPoint.Z - faceZ) < 1.0 && h.TopCenterPoint.X >= minX && h.TopCenterPoint.X <= maxX && h.TopCenterPoint.Y >= minY && h.TopCenterPoint.Y <= maxY) ||
6606 (h.BottomCenterPoint != null && Math.Abs(h.BottomCenterPoint.Z - faceZ) < 1.0 && h.BottomCenterPoint.X >= minX && h.BottomCenterPoint.X <= maxX && h.BottomCenterPoint.Y >= minY && h.BottomCenterPoint.Y <= maxY)
6607 ).ToList();
6608
6609 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList();
6610 foreach (var hole in holesOnFace)
6611 {
6612 IgnoredHoles.Remove(hole);
6613 hole.IsIgnored = false;
6614 var facesInHole = allFaces.Where(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)).ToList();
6615 foreach (var f in facesInHole)
6616 {
6617 IgnoredFaces.Remove(f);
6618 f.IsIgnored = false;
6619 }
6620 _ignoredItemManager.RestoreOriginalStyle(facesInHole);
6621 }
6622 }
6623 }
6624 }
6625 else if (item is CADHole hole)
6626 {
6627 var facesInHole = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(list => list)
6628 .Where(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)).ToList();
6629 if (isIgnored)
6630 {
6631 if (!IgnoredHoles.Contains(hole)) IgnoredHoles.Add(hole);
6632 hole.IsIgnored = true;
6633 foreach (var f in facesInHole)
6634 {
6635 if (!IgnoredFaces.Contains(f)) IgnoredFaces.Add(f);
6636 f.IsIgnored = true;
6637 }
6638 if (ShowIgnoredAsTransparent)
6639 {
6640 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(facesInHole);
6641 }
6642 }
6643 else
6644 {
6645 IgnoredHoles.Remove(hole);
6646 hole.IsIgnored = false;
6647 foreach (var f in facesInHole)
6648 {
6649 IgnoredFaces.Remove(f);
6650 f.IsIgnored = false;
6651 }
6652 _ignoredItemManager.RestoreOriginalStyle(facesInHole);
6653 }
6654 }
6655
6656 if (!isUndoRedo)
6657 {
6658 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
6659 }
6660 else
6661 {
6662 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
6663 }
6664
6665 if (measuring_sp != null)
6666 {
6667 measuring_sp.UpdateMeasurementCounts();
6668 measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
6669 }
6670 _designControl?.Invalidate();
6671
6672 if (!isUndoRedo)
6673 {
6674 SaveCurrentSession();
6675 }
6676 }

6814 if (_designControl != null)
6815 {
6816 bool normalsVisible = bool.Parse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["ShowNormals"] ?? "false");
6817 if (normalsVisible)
6818 {
6819 // Force refresh by toggling off and on
6820 _designControl.ShowNormals = false;
6821 _designControl.Invalidate();
6822 _designControl.ShowNormals = true;
6823 _designControl.Invalidate();
6824 }
6825 }
6826
6827 // Notify user
6828 string message = wasFlipped
6829 ? string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FlipNormal_Restored") ?? "Normal for face {0} restored to original direction.", face.FaceGlobalIndex)
6830 : string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FlipNormal_Success") ?? "Normal for face {0} flipped successfully.", face.FaceGlobalIndex);
6831
6832 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
6833 message,
6834 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "FlipNormal_Title") ?? "Flip Normal",
6835 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
6836 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Information);
6837
6838 //UI Updates
6839 if (measuring_sp != null) { measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Visible; }
6840
6841 // FACE-JUMPING INTEGRATION: Invalidate existing path when normal is flipped
6842 // Per REQUIREMENTS.md: Flipping must invalidate path and trigger shell regeneration
6843 if (_generatedPathEntities != null && _generatedPathEntities.Count > 0)
6844 {
6845 Debug.WriteLine($" INFO: Normal flip triggered path invalidation - clearing {_generatedPathEntities.Count} path entities");
6846 ClearPathVisuals();
6847 }
6848
6849 // Aplicar textura vermelha nas faces invertidas
6850 ApplyFlippedFaceTextures();
6851 }

6865 private async void RegenerateOffsetShell()
6866 {
6867 if (_designControl == null)
6868 {
6869 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
6870 "No design loaded.",
6871 "Regenerate Offset Shell",
6872 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
6873 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
6874 return;
6875 }
6876
6877 try
6878 {
6879 // Save current shell visibility state
6880 bool shellWasVisible = false;
6881 if (_designControl.Layers.Contains("SHELL_UNIFIED"))
6882 {
6883 shellWasVisible = _designControl.Layers["SHELL_UNIFIED"].Visible;
6884 }
6885
6886 // Clear red overlays before regenerating
6887 if (_ignoredItemManager != null && _flippedFaceNormals.Count > 0)
6888 {
6889 _ignoredItemManager.ClearFlippedFaceOverlays(_flippedFaceNormals.ToList());
6890 }
6891
6892 // Show progress
6893 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_RegeneratingOffsetShell") ?? "Regenerating offset shell...";
6894 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
6895
6896 Debug.WriteLine("INFO: Regenerating offset shell...");
6897 // Call the async method to regenerate shell
6898 await _pathManager.GenerateOversizedShellFromDesignAsync(_designControl, default, forceRegenerate: true);
6899
6900 Machine_Status_Progress = 100;
6901 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ShellRegeneratedSuccessfully") ?? "Shell regenerated successfully!";
6902
6903 Debug.WriteLine($"SUCCESS: Shell regeneration complete");
6904
6905 // Restore shell visibility state if it was visible before
6906 if (shellWasVisible && _designControl.Layers.Contains("SHELL_UNIFIED"))
6907 {
6908 _designControl.Layers["SHELL_UNIFIED"].Visible = true;
6909 Debug.WriteLine(" 👁️ Shell layer visibility restored");
6910 }
6911
6912 // Refresh the viewport to show updated shell
6913 _designControl.Invalidate();
6914 await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(50); // Small delay for render
6915
6916 // Clear the flipped faces list since they've been applied
6917 _flippedFaceNormals.Clear();
6918
6919 // Brief success message
6920 await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Delay(2000);
6921 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
6922 Machine_Status_ProgressText = string.Empty;
6923 }
6924 catch (Exception ex)
6925 {
6926 Debug.WriteLine($"ERROR: Error regenerating shell: {ex.Message}");
6927 Debug.WriteLine($" Stack trace: {ex.StackTrace}");
6928 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
6929 $"Failed to regenerate shell:\n{ex.Message}",
6930 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Failed to regenerate shell",
6931 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
6932 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
6933 }
6934 }

7066 private void ConvertHoleToFaces(CADHole holeToConvert)
7067 {
7068 if (holeToConvert == null) return;
7069 PerformConvertHoleToFaces(holeToConvert);
7070
7071 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
7072 () =>
7073 {
7074 AddNewHole(holeToConvert);
7075 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
7076 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
7077 },
7078 () => PerformConvertHoleToFaces(holeToConvert),
7079 description: $"Convert Hole {holeToConvert.HoleId} ({ColorNamer.FormatColorWithRgb(holeToConvert.HoleColor)}) to Faces",
7080 category: "Hole Management"
7081 ));
7082 }
7083
7088 private void PerformConvertHoleToFaces(CADHole holeToConvert)
7089 {
7090 if (holeToConvert == null) return;
7091
7092 string colorKey = _holesByColor.FirstOrDefault(kvp => kvp.Value.Contains(holeToConvert)).Key;
7093 if (colorKey == null) return;
7094
7095 // 1. Remove hole from the main holes dictionary
7096 _holesByColor[colorKey].Remove(holeToConvert);
7097 if (_holesByColor[colorKey].Count == 0)
7098 {
7099 _holesByColor.Remove(colorKey);
7100 }
7101
7102 // 2. Find the constituent faces from the master list
7103 var facesToAdd = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(list => list)
7104 .Where(f => holeToConvert.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)).ToList();
7105
7106 // 3. Add these faces to the non-hole faces dictionary
7107 if (!_facesByColor.ContainsKey(colorKey))
7108 {
7109 _facesByColor[colorKey] = new List<CADFace>();
7110 }
7111 _facesByColor[colorKey].AddRange(facesToAdd);
7112
7113 // 4. Update the lookup map
7114 foreach (var faceIdx in holeToConvert.FaceGlobalIndices)
7115 {
7116 if (_faceIndexToHoleMap != null)
7117 _faceIndexToHoleMap.Remove(faceIdx);
7118 }
7119
7120 // 5. Rebuild the cache and repopulate the tree
7121 _treeViewHelper.InvalidateCache();
7122 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
7123
7124 EyeshotStatus_Text = $"Hole {holeToConvert.HoleId} converted to {facesToAdd.Count} faces.";
7125 }

7181 private async Task<bool> CancelActiveProcessesAndWaitAsync(int timeoutMs = 5000)
7182 {
7183 bool waitNeeded = false;
7184
7185 if (IsExtractingFaces)
7186 {
7187 CancelFaceExtraction();
7188 waitNeeded = true;
7189 }
7190 if (_pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource != null)
7191 {
7192 CancelPathGeneration();
7193 waitNeeded = true;
7194 }
7195
7196 if (!waitNeeded) return true;
7197
7198 int delay = 100;
7199 int elapsed = 0;
7200 while ((IsExtractingFaces || _pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource != null) && elapsed < timeoutMs)
7201 {
7202 await Task.Delay(delay);
7203 elapsed += delay;
7204 }
7205
7206 return !IsExtractingFaces && _pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource == null;
7207 }

7575 public async Task ImportModelWithoutClearingAsync()
7576 {
7577 if (!await CancelActiveProcessesAndWaitAsync()) { MessageBox.Show(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ErrorCancelling") ?? "Failed to cancel active operations. Please try again later.", GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_Warning") ?? "Warning", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning); return; }
7578 CancelActiveObjectManipulatorForModelChange();
7579 if (!CheckAndDiscardExistingPaths()) return;
7580
7581 var dlg = new OpenFileDialog
7582 {
7583 Filter = "STEP files (*.stp;*.step)|*.stp;*.step|IGES files (*.igs;*.iges)|*.igs;*.iges|OBJ files (*.obj)|*.obj|STL files (*.stl)|*.stl|All files (*.*)|*.*",
7584 FilterIndex = 1,
7585 Title = "Select CAD file"
7586 };
7587
7588 if (dlg.ShowDialog() != true)
7589 return;
7590
7591 string path = dlg.FileName;
7592 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_LoadingAdditionalModel");
7593 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
7594
7595 try
7596 {
7597 string extension = Path.GetExtension(path).ToLowerInvariant();
7598 ReadSTL stlReader = null!;
7599 ReadSTEP stepReader = null!;
7600 ReadIGES igesReader = null!;
7601 ReadOBJ objReader = null!;
7602
7603 // Run the heavy parsing part off the UI thread
7604 await Task.Run(() =>
7605 {
7606 if (extension == ".stl")
7607 {
7608 stlReader = new ReadSTL(path);
7609 stlReader.DoWork();
7610 }
7611 else if (extension == ".igs" || extension == ".iges")
7612 {
7613 igesReader = new ReadIGES(path);
7614 igesReader.DoWork();
7615 }
7616 else if (extension == ".obj")
7617 {
7618 objReader = new ReadOBJ(path);
7619 objReader.DoWork();
7620 }
7621 else
7622 {
7623 stepReader = new ReadSTEP(path);
7624 stepReader.DoWork();
7625 }
7626 });
7627
7628 // 2️⃣ Everything that creates UI objects must run on the UI thread
7629 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
7630 {
7631 var tempDesign = new Design();
7632 if (extension == ".stl")
7633 {
7634 stlReader.AddTo(tempDesign);
7635 }
7636 else if (extension == ".igs" || extension == ".iges")
7637 {
7638 igesReader.AddTo(tempDesign);
7639 }
7640 else if (extension == ".obj")
7641 {
7642 objReader.AddTo(tempDesign);
7643 }
7644 else
7645 {
7646 stepReader.AddTo(tempDesign);
7647 }
7648
7649 var importedEntities = tempDesign.Entities.ToList();
7650 if (importedEntities.Count == 0)
7651 {
7652 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
7653 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_NoEntitiesFound")!,
7654 Path.GetFileName(path));
7655 return;
7656 }
7657
7658 // Duplicate filtering
7659 var existingBoxes = _designControl.Entities
7660 .Select(e => (e.BoxMin, e.BoxMax))
7661 .ToHashSet();
7662
7663 var uniqueEntities = importedEntities
7664 .Where(e => !existingBoxes.Contains((e.BoxMin, e.BoxMax)))
7665 .ToList();
7666
7667 if (uniqueEntities.Count == 0)
7668 {
7669 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
7670 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_AllEntitiesAlreadyExist") ?? "All entities from {0} already exist",
7671 Path.GetFileName(path));
7672 return;
7673 }
7674
7675 int entityCountBeforeImport = _designControl.Entities.Count;
7676 int gridCountBeforeImport = _designControl.Viewports.Count > 0 ? _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Count : 0;
7677
7678 foreach (var ent in uniqueEntities)
7679 {
7680 // Store original filename in EntityData for tooltip
7681 ent.EntityData = path;
7682 _designControl.Entities.Add(ent);
7683 }
7684 _designControl.Units = _units;
7685
7686 AddPartOrigins(uniqueEntities, path); // Add origin symbol for the new model group
7687
7688 var val = System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["MovePartToOriginByDefault"];
7689 if (bool.TryParse(val, out bool autoMove) && autoMove)
7690 {
7691 var newPartEntity = uniqueEntities.FirstOrDefault(IsValidPartEntity);
7692 if (newPartEntity != null)
7693 {
7694 MoveObjectToOrigin(newPartEntity);
7695 }
7696 }
7697
7698 var newEntities = _designControl.Entities.Skip(entityCountBeforeImport).ToList();
7699 var newGrids = _designControl.Viewports.Count > 0
7700 ? _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Skip(gridCountBeforeImport).ToList()
7701 : new List<devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid>();
7702 var relatedGeneratedEntities = new List<Entity>();
7703
7704 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
7705 () =>
7706 {
7707 if (relatedGeneratedEntities.Count == 0)
7708 {
7709 relatedGeneratedEntities.AddRange(_designControl.Entities.Where(ent =>
7710 ent?.LayerName != null &&
7711 (ent.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
7712 ent.LayerName.Contains("IGNORED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))));
7713 }
7714
7715 foreach (var ent in relatedGeneratedEntities)
7716 {
7717 _designControl.Entities.Remove(ent);
7718 }
7719
7720 foreach (var ent in newEntities)
7721 {
7722 _designControl.Entities.Remove(ent);
7723 if (OrderedPartEntities.Contains(ent))
7724 {
7725 OrderedPartEntities.Remove(ent);
7726 }
7727 }
7728 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
7729 {
7730 foreach (var g in newGrids)
7731 {
7732 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Remove(g);
7733 }
7734 }
7735 FacesUpToDate = false;
7736 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
7737 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
7738 _designControl.Invalidate();
7739 },
7740 () =>
7741 {
7742 foreach (var ent in newEntities)
7743 {
7744 if (!_designControl.Entities.Contains(ent))
7745 {
7746 _designControl.Entities.Add(ent);
7747 }
7748 }
7749 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
7750 {
7751 foreach (var g in newGrids)
7752 {
7753 if (!_designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Contains(g))
7754 {
7755 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Add(g);
7756 }
7757 }
7758 }
7759 foreach (var ent in relatedGeneratedEntities)
7760 {
7761 if (!_designControl.Entities.Contains(ent))
7762 {
7763 _designControl.Entities.Add(ent);
7764 }
7765 }
7766 FacesUpToDate = false;
7767 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
7768 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
7769 _designControl.Invalidate();
7770 },
7771 description: $"Import Model {Path.GetFileName(path)}",
7772 category: "Model Import"
7773 ));
7774
7775 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
7776 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_AddedEntitiesFromModel") ?? "Added {0} entities from {1}",
7777 uniqueEntities.Count(), Path.GetFileName(path));
7778
7779 DesignerVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
7780 FacesUpToDate = false;
7781 });
7782
7783 CanExtractFaces = true;
7784 await Task.Delay(200);
7785 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
7786 {
7787 _designControl.Entities.UpdateBoundingBox();
7788 _designControl.ZoomFit();
7789 _designControl.Invalidate();
7790 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = (_allFacesByColor == null || _allFacesByColor.Count == 0) ? GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ExtractFaces") : GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces");
7791 }, DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle);
7792
7793 SaveCurrentSession();

7795 catch (Exception ex)

"An error occurred while loading the STEP model:") + $" {ex.Message}", GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_ImportError") ?? "HirEV SmartFitSystems - Import Error", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
7798 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ImportFailed");

7810 public void RemoveModelEntity(Entity? entity)
7811 {
7812 if (entity == null) return;
7813
7814 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
7815 {
7816 if (_designControl.Entities.Contains(entity))
7817 {
7818 string? sourcePath = entity.EntityData as string;
7819 int orderedPartIndex = OrderedPartEntities.IndexOf(entity);
7820
7821 var removedGrids = new List<devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid>();
7822 var originSymbols = new List<BlockReference>();
7823
7824 // Check if any other entities from the same model remain (same source path) excluding this one
7825 bool anyRemaining = _designControl.Entities
7826 .Any(e => e != null && e != entity && e.EntityData as string == sourcePath && (e is Brep || e is Mesh));
7827
7828 if (!anyRemaining)
7829 {
7830 // Remove associated PART_ORIGIN BlockReference
7831 originSymbols = _designControl.Entities
7832 .OfType<BlockReference>()
7833 .Where(br => br.EntityData is string tag && tag.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
7834 (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourcePath) || tag.EndsWith(sourcePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || tag == "PART_ORIGIN"))
7835 .ToList();
7836
7837 foreach (var os in originSymbols)
7838 {
7839 // Remove associated Viewport Grids matching the origin position
7840 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
7841 {
7842 var gridsToRemove = _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids
7843 .Skip(1) // Skip main grid
7844 .Where(g => g != null && (g.Plane.Origin.Equals(os.InsertionPoint) || g.Plane.Origin.DistanceTo(os.InsertionPoint) < 1.0))
7845 .ToList();
7846 removedGrids.AddRange(gridsToRemove);
7847 }
7848 }
7849 }
7850
7851 Action doRemove = () =>
7852 {
7853 _designControl.Entities.Remove(entity);
7854
7855 if (orderedPartIndex >= 0 && OrderedPartEntities.Contains(entity))
7856 {
7857 OrderedPartEntities.Remove(entity);
7858 }
7859
7860 foreach (var os in originSymbols)
7861 {
7862 _designControl.Entities.Remove(os);
7863 }
7864
7865 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
7866 {
7867 foreach (var g in removedGrids)
7868 {
7869 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Remove(g);
7870 }
7871 }
7872
7873 // Mark state as dirty so user knows they need to update faces
7874 FacesUpToDate = false;
7875 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = (_allFacesByColor == null || _allFacesByColor.Count == 0)
7876 ? GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ExtractFaces")
7877 : GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces");
7878
7879 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
7880 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
7881 _designControl.Invalidate();
7882 };
7883
7884 Action undoRemove = () =>
7885 {
7886 if (!_designControl.Entities.Contains(entity))
7887 {
7888 _designControl.Entities.Add(entity);
7889 }
7890
7891 if (orderedPartIndex >= 0 && !OrderedPartEntities.Contains(entity))
7892 {
7893 if (orderedPartIndex <= OrderedPartEntities.Count)
7894 {
7895 OrderedPartEntities.Insert(orderedPartIndex, entity);
7896 }
7897 else
7898 {
7899 OrderedPartEntities.Add(entity);
7900 }
7901 }
7902
7903 foreach (var os in originSymbols)
7904 {
7905 if (!_designControl.Entities.Contains(os))
7906 {
7907 _designControl.Entities.Add(os);
7908 }
7909 }
7910
7911 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
7912 {
7913 foreach (var g in removedGrids)
7914 {
7915 if (!_designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Contains(g))
7916 {
7917 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Add(g);
7918 }
7919 }
7920 }
7921
7922 FacesUpToDate = false;
7923 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = (_allFacesByColor == null || _allFacesByColor.Count == 0)
7924 ? GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ExtractFaces")
7925 : GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces");
7926
7927 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
7928 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
7929 _designControl.Invalidate();
7930 };
7931
7932 // Execute the removal
7933 doRemove();
7934
7935 // Push the undo/redo action command to the UndoManager
7936 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
7937 undoAction: undoRemove,
7938 redoAction: doRemove,
7939 description: $"Remove Model Entity {entity.GetType().Name}",
7940 category: "Model Import"
7941 ));
7942 }
7943 });
7944 }

7958 private async Task ReExtractFacesPreservingIgnoredStateAsync(
7959 int entityCountBeforeImport,
7960 HashSet<(int EntityIndex, int FaceIndex)> preservedIgnoredFaceIndices,
7961 HashSet<int> preservedIgnoredHoleIds)
7962 {
7963 try
7964 {
7965 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_UpdatingFaces");
7966
7967 // Run extraction-heavy work in background thread
7968 var token = _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource?.Token ?? default;
7972 var extractionResult = await Task.Run(async () =>
7973 {
7974 await UpdateProgressAsync(0, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_PreparingExtraction") ?? "A iniciar extração de faces..."} (0%)", delay: 0);
7975 var extractor = new FaceExtractor(_designControl.Entities);
7976 var extractedFaces = extractor.ExtractFaces((percentage, faceCount) =>
7977 {
7978 // Map 0-100% of extraction to 0-68% of overall progress
7979 int overallProgress = (int)(percentage * 0.68);
7980 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
7981 {
7982 Machine_Status_Progress = overallProgress;
7983 string extractingText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ExtractingFaces") ?? "A extrair faces";
7984 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{extractingText} ({percentage}%)";
7985 }, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Normal);
7986 }, token);
7987
7988 token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
7989 await UpdateProgressAsync(69, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ProcessingFaceData") ?? "A processar dados das faces..."} (69%)");
7990
7991 await UpdateProgressAsync(70, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_StartingHoleDetection") ?? "A iniciar deteção de furos..."} (70%)");
7992
7993 List<CADHole> detectedHoles;
7994 List<CADFace> nonHoleFaces;
7995 (detectedHoles, nonHoleFaces) = HoleDetector.DetectHoles(extractedFaces, (percentage, holeCount) =>
7996 {
7997 // Map 0-100% of hole detection to 70-88% of overall progress
7998 int overallProgress = 70 + (int)(percentage * 0.18);
7999 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
8000 {
8001 Machine_Status_Progress = overallProgress;
8002 string detectingText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_DetectingHoles") ?? "A detetar furos";
8003 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{detectingText} ({overallProgress}%)";
8004 }, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Normal);
8005 }, token);
8006
8007 // await UpdateProgressAsync(89, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_HoleDetectionComplete") ?? "Deteção de furos completa..."} (89%)");
8008
8009 return (extractedFaces, detectedHoles, nonHoleFaces);
8010 }, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
8011
8012 // Now we’re back on the UI thread
8013 var (faces, holes, nonHoleFaces) = extractionResult;
8014
8015 // Update main data structures
8016 _allFacesByColor = GroupFacesByColor(faces);
8017 _facesByColor = GroupFacesByColor(nonHoleFaces);
8018 _holesByColor = GroupHolesByColor(holes);
8019
8020 // Rebuild face-to-hole mapping
8021 _faceIndexToHoleMap = new Dictionary<int, CADHole>();
8022 foreach (var holeList in _holesByColor.Values)
8023 {
8024 foreach (var hole in holeList)
8025 {
8026 foreach (var faceGlobalIndex in hole.FaceGlobalIndices)
8027 {
8028 if (!_faceIndexToHoleMap.ContainsKey(faceGlobalIndex))
8029 _faceIndexToHoleMap.Add(faceGlobalIndex, hole);
8030 }
8031 }
8032 }
8033
8034 // Reapply ignored state to faces
8035 IgnoredFaces.Clear();
8036 foreach (var face in faces)
8037 {
8038 if (preservedIgnoredFaceIndices.Contains((face.EntityIndex, face.FaceIndex)))
8039 {
8040 IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
8041 face.IsIgnored = true;
8042 }
8043 }
8044
8045 // Reapply ignored state to holes
8046 IgnoredHoles.Clear();
8047 foreach (var holeList in _holesByColor.Values)
8048 {
8049 foreach (var hole in holeList)
8050 {
8051 if (preservedIgnoredHoleIds.Contains(hole.HoleId) || hole.IsIgnored)
8052 {
8053 if (!IgnoredHoles.Contains(hole))
8054 IgnoredHoles.Add(hole);
8055 hole.IsIgnored = true;
8056
8057 // Also mark constituent faces as ignored
8058 var facesInHole = faces
8059 .Where(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex))
8060 .ToList();
8061
8062 foreach (var f in facesInHole)
8063 {
8064 if (!IgnoredFaces.Contains(f))
8065 IgnoredFaces.Add(f);
8066 f.IsIgnored = true;
8067 }
8068 }
8069 }
8070 }
8071
8072 // Update visual representation
8073 if (ShowIgnoredAsTransparent)
8074 {
8075 var ignoredFacesList = IgnoredFaces.ToList();
8076 if (ignoredFacesList.Any())
8077 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(ignoredFacesList);
8078 }
8079
8080 // Refresh tree view and UI
8081 _treeViewHelper.InvalidateCache();
8082 _treeViewHelper.PopulateTreeView(
8083 _facesByColor,
8084 _holesByColor,
8085 _allFacesByColor,
8086 showExteriorOnly: IsExteriorOnlyChecked,
8087 showVisibleOnly: IsVisibleOnlyChecked
8088 );
8089
8090 CanExport = true;
8091 planning_sp?.InitializeToleranceSliders();
8092
8093 int restoredFaceCount = IgnoredFaces.Count;
8094 int restoredHoleCount = IgnoredHoles.Count;
8095
8096 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
8097 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_FacesExtracted")!,
8098 faces.Count,
8099 _facesByColor.Count
8100 ) + (holes.Count > 0 ? $" | {holes.Count} holes detected" : "")
8101 + (restoredFaceCount > 0 || restoredHoleCount > 0
8102 ? $" | Restored {restoredFaceCount} ignored faces, {restoredHoleCount} ignored holes"
8103 : "");
8104
8105 SaveCurrentSession();
8106 }
8107 catch (Exception ex)
8108 {
8109 MessageBox.Show(
8110 (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ErrorMessageBox_ExtractFacesError") ?? "Error updating faces:") + $" {ex.Message}",
8111 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Internal Error",
8112 MessageBoxButton.OK,
8113 MessageBoxImage.Error
8114 );
8115 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ExtractionFailed");
8116 }
8117 }

8205 private void ToggleAllControlPointsVisibility(bool show)
8206 {

8208 {
8209 _pathManager.SetAllApproachPointsVisibility(show);
8210 return;
8211 }
8212
8213 if (_visualsManager == null || _designControl == null) return;
8214
8215 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
8216 {
8217 lock (_designControl.Entities)
8218 {
8219 // Clear existing "Show All" control point spheres (separate from face selection spheres)
8220 foreach (var sphere in _allControlPointSpheres)
8221 {
8222 try { _designControl.Entities.Remove(sphere); } catch { }
8223 }
8224 _allControlPointSpheres.Clear();
8225
8226 if (show && _allFacesByColor != null)
8227 {
8228 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f);
8229
8230 foreach (var face in allFaces)
8231 {
8232 if (!face.IsIgnored && face.ControlPoints != null)
8233 {
8234 foreach (var cp in face.ControlPoints)
8235 {
8236 // Create pink sphere for control points (using a different color to distinguish from face selection)
8237 var sphere = Mesh.CreateSphere(_pinkSphereSize, 12, 12);
8238 sphere.Translate(cp.X, cp.Y, cp.Z);
8239 sphere.Color = System.Drawing.Color.Pink; // Pink to distinguish from face selection (Magenta)
8240 sphere.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
8241 sphere.EntityData = "UI_MARKER";
8242
8243 // Add to separate "Show All" tracking list (NOT _visualsManager.ControlPointSpheres)
8244 _allControlPointSpheres.Add(sphere);
8245 _designControl.Entities.Add(sphere);
8246 }
8247 }
8248 }
8249 }
8250 }
8251
8252 // Regenerate and invalidate to ensure the viewport updates
8253 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
8254 _designControl.Invalidate();
8255 });
8256 }

8286 {

8299 sphere.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
8300
8301 _measurementPointSpheres.Add(sphere);
8302 _designControl.Entities.Add(sphere);
8303 }
8304 }
8305 }
8306 }
8307 }
8308
8309 // Regenerate and invalidate to ensure the viewport updates
8310 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
8311 _designControl.Invalidate();
8312 });

8345 private async Task ExtractOrUpdateFacesAsync()
8346 {
8347 try
8348 {
8349 if (IsExtractingFaces)
8350 {
8351 CancelFaceExtraction();
8352 return;
8353 }
8354
8355 // SUCCESS: Check if path generation is in progress and prompt user
8356 if (_pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource != null && !_pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource.IsCancellationRequested)
8357 {
8358 var result = MessageBox.Show(
8359 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBoxQuestion_CancelGenerationAndUpdateFaces") ?? "Quer cancelar a geração de trajetórias e atualizar as faces?",
8360 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_CancelGenerationTitle") ?? "Cancelar Geração de Trajetórias",
8361 MessageBoxButton.YesNo,
8362 MessageBoxImage.Question);
8363
8364 if (result == MessageBoxResult.Yes)
8365 {
8366 CancelPathGeneration();
8367 // Wait a short moment to allow the background task to respond to cancellation
8368 await Task.Delay(200);
8369 }
8370 else
8371 {
8372 return; // User chose not to cancel, so abort extraction
8373 }
8374 }
8375
8376 int previousEntityCount = 0;
8377 if (_allFacesByColor != null && _allFacesByColor.Count > 0)
8378 {
8379 previousEntityCount = _allFacesByColor.Values
8380 .SelectMany(f => f)
8381 .Select(f => f.EntityIndex)
8382 .DefaultIfEmpty(-1)
8383 .Max() + 1;
8384 }
8385
8386 // No previous extraction or user forces update when faces are up to date -> full extraction
8387 if (_allFacesByColor == null || _allFacesByColor.Count == 0 || previousEntityCount >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
8388 {
8389 await PerformFaceExtractionAsync(false);
8390 _lastExtractedEntityCount = _designControl.Entities.Count;
8391 }
8392 else
8393 {
8394 // Incremental extraction (new entities added)
8395 await PerformFaceExtractionAsync(true, previousEntityCount);
8396 _lastExtractedEntityCount = _designControl.Entities.Count;
8397 }
8398
8399 FacesUpToDate = true; // Mark faces as up-to-date after extraction
8400 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces") ?? "Update Faces";
8401 }
8402 catch (Exception ex)
8403 {
8404 MessageBox.Show(
8405 (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ErrorMessageBox_ExtractFacesError") ??
8406 "Error extracting faces:") + $" {ex.Message}",
8407 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Internal Error",
8408 MessageBoxButton.OK,
8409 MessageBoxImage.Error
8410 );
8411 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ExtractionFailed") ?? "Extraction failed";
8412 }
8413 }
