8421 private async Task PerformFaceExtractionAsync(bool isIncremental, int entityCountBeforeImport = 0)
8422 {
8423 try
8424 {
8425 if (IsExtractingFaces) return;
8426 IsExtractingFaces = true;
8427 _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource?.Dispose();
8428 _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource = new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource();
8429
8430 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
8431
8432 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8433 {
8434 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(16, 207, 200));
8435 EyeshotStatus_Text = isIncremental ?
8436 (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ExtractingNewFaces") ?? "Extracting faces from the new entities") :
8437 (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ExtractingFaces") ?? "Extracting faces...");
8438
8439 // Update text to "Cancel Extraction"
8440 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "CancelExtraction") ?? "Cancelar Extração";
8441 });
8442 await UpdateProgressAsync(0, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_StartingExtraction") ?? "A iniciar extração..."} (0%)");
8443
8444 var entitiesToExtract = new EntityList();
8445 var originalIndices = new List<int>();
8446
8447 if (!isIncremental)
8448 {
8449 await UpdateProgressAsync(1, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ClearingMarkers") ?? "A limpar marcadores..."} (1%)");
8450 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
8451
8452 // await UpdateProgressAsync(2, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ClearingSelection") ?? "A limpar seleção..."} (2%)");
8453 // _treeViewHelper.ClearTreeViewSelection();
8454
8455 await UpdateProgressAsync(3, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ClearingTreeView") ?? "A limpar árvore..."} (3%)");
8456 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() => {
8457 TreeViewItems = new ObservableCollection<TreeViewItem>();
8458 });
8459
8460 await UpdateProgressAsync(4, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ClearingIgnored") ?? "A limpar ignorados..."} (4%)");
8461 _ignoredItemManager.ClearAll();
8462 IgnoredFaces.Clear();
8463 IgnoredHoles.Clear();
8464
8465 for (int i = 0; i < _designControl.Entities.Count; i++)
8466 {
8467 var ent = _designControl.Entities[i];
8468 if (IsModelEntity(ent))
8469 {
8470 entitiesToExtract.Add(ent);
8471 originalIndices.Add(i);
8472 }
8473 }
8474 }
8475 else
8476 {
8477 for (int i = entityCountBeforeImport; i < _designControl.Entities.Count; i++)
8478 {
8479 var ent = _designControl.Entities[i];
8480 if (IsModelEntity(ent))
8481 {
8482 entitiesToExtract.Add(ent);
8483 originalIndices.Add(i);
8484 }
8485 }
8486
8487 if (entitiesToExtract.Count == 0)
8488 {
8489 bool reExtract = false;
8490 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8491 {
8492 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_NoNewEntitiesToExtract") ?? "No new entities to extract faces from.";
8493 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Gray);
8494 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
8495 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle";
8496
8497 string title = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_NoNewEntities_Title") ?? "Warning";
8498 string message = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_NoNewEntities_Message") ?? "There are no new entities to extract faces. Do you want to re-extract faces for the current parts configuration?";
8499
8500 var result = System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(message, title, System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Question);
8501 if (result == System.Windows.MessageBoxResult.OK)
8502 {
8503 reExtract = true;
8504 }
8505 });
8506
8507 if (reExtract)
8508 {
8509 IsExtractingFaces = false;
8510 await PerformFaceExtractionAsync(false);
8511 }
8512 return;
8513 }
8514 }
8515
8516 await UpdateProgressAsync(5, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_PreparingExtraction") ?? "A iniciar extração de faces..."} (5%)", delay: 0);
8517
8518 int nextFaceGlobalIndex = 0;
8519 int nextHoleId = 1;
8520
8521 if (isIncremental && _allFacesByColor != null)
8522 {
8523 nextFaceGlobalIndex = _allFacesByColor.Values
8524 .SelectMany(f => f)
8525 .DefaultIfEmpty()
8526 .Max(f => f?.FaceGlobalIndex ?? 0) + 1;
8527
8528 nextHoleId = _holesByColor.Values
8529 .SelectMany(h => h)
8530 .DefaultIfEmpty()
8531 .Max(h => h?.HoleId ?? 0) + 1;
8532 }
8533
8534 List<CADFace>? extractedFaces = null;
8535 List<CADFace>? nonHoleFaces = null;
8536 List<CADHole>? detectedHoles = null;
8537
8538 await Task.Run(() =>
8539 {
8540 var extractor = new FaceExtractor(entitiesToExtract);
8541 extractedFaces = extractor.ExtractFaces((percentage, faceCount) =>
8542 {
8543 int overallProgress = 5 + (int)(percentage * 0.63);
8544 var dispatcher = Application.Current?.Dispatcher;
8545 if (dispatcher != null && !dispatcher.HasShutdownStarted)
8546 {
8547 try
8548 {
8549 dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
8550 {
8551 Machine_Status_Progress = overallProgress;
8552 string extractingText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ExtractingFaces") ?? "A extrair faces";
8553 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{extractingText}... ({overallProgress}%)";
8554 }, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Normal);
8555 }
8556 catch (TaskCanceledException) { /* Ignored during shutdown */ }
8557 }
8558 }, _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource?.Token ?? default);
8559
8560 if (extractedFaces != null)
8561 {
8562 foreach (var face in extractedFaces)
8563 {
8564 if (isIncremental)
8565 {
8566 face.FaceGlobalIndex += nextFaceGlobalIndex;
8567 }
8568
8569 if (originalIndices.Count > 0)
8570 {
8571 if (face.EntityIndex >= 0 && face.EntityIndex < originalIndices.Count)
8572 face.EntityIndex = originalIndices[face.EntityIndex];
8573 else if (isIncremental)
8574 face.EntityIndex += entityCountBeforeImport;
8575 }
8576
8577 // Ensure ModelFilePath is populated
8578 if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(face.ModelFilePath))
8579 {
8580 face.ModelFilePath = CurrentlyLoadedFilePath;
8581 }
8582 }
8583 }
8584 });
8585
8586 await UpdateProgressAsync(69, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ProcessingFaceData") ?? "A processar dados das faces..."} (69%)");
8587 await UpdateProgressAsync(70, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_StartingHoleDetection") ?? "A iniciar deteção de furos..."} (70%)");
8588
8589 await Task.Run(() =>
8590 {
8591 if (extractedFaces != null)
8592 {
8593 (detectedHoles, nonHoleFaces) = HoleDetector.DetectHoles(extractedFaces, (percentage, holeCount) =>
8594 {
8595 int overallProgress = 70 + (int)(percentage * 0.18);
8596 var dispatcher = Application.Current?.Dispatcher;
8597 if (dispatcher != null && !dispatcher.HasShutdownStarted)
8598 {
8599 try
8600 {
8601 dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
8602 {
8603 Machine_Status_Progress = overallProgress;
8604 string detectingText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_DetectingHoles") ?? "A detetar furos";
8605 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{detectingText}... ({overallProgress}%)";
8606 }, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Normal);
8607 }
8608 catch (TaskCanceledException) { /* Ignored during shutdown */ }
8609 }
8610 }, _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource?.Token ?? default);
8611
8612 if (isIncremental && detectedHoles != null)
8613 {
8614 foreach (var hole in detectedHoles)
8615 {
8616 hole.HoleId = nextHoleId++;
8617 }
8618 }
8619 }
8620 });
8621
8622 await UpdateProgressAsync(90, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_GroupingByColor") ?? "A agrupar por cor..."} (90%)");
8623
8624 var newFacesByColor = GroupFacesByColor(extractedFaces!);
8625 var newNonHoleFacesByColor = GroupFacesByColor(nonHoleFaces!);
8626 var newHolesByColor = GroupHolesByColor(detectedHoles!);
8627
8628 if (!isIncremental)
8629 {
8630 _allFacesByColor = newFacesByColor;
8631 _facesByColor = newNonHoleFacesByColor;
8632 _holesByColor = newHolesByColor;
8633 _faceIndexToHoleMap = new Dictionary<int, CADHole>();
8634 }
8635 else
8636 {
8637 foreach (var kvp in newFacesByColor)
8638 {
8639 if (!_allFacesByColor!.ContainsKey(kvp.Key))
8640 _allFacesByColor[kvp.Key] = new List<CADFace>();
8641 _allFacesByColor[kvp.Key].AddRange(kvp.Value);
8642 }
8643
8644 foreach (var kvp in newNonHoleFacesByColor)
8645 {
8646 if (!_facesByColor.ContainsKey(kvp.Key))
8647 _facesByColor[kvp.Key] = new List<CADFace>();
8648 _facesByColor[kvp.Key].AddRange(kvp.Value);
8649 }
8650
8651 foreach (var kvp in newHolesByColor)
8652 {
8653 if (!_holesByColor.ContainsKey(kvp.Key))
8654 _holesByColor[kvp.Key] = new List<CADHole>();
8655 _holesByColor[kvp.Key].AddRange(kvp.Value);
8656 }
8657
8658 _faceIndexToHoleMap ??= new Dictionary<int, CADHole>();
8659 }
8660
8661 await UpdateProgressAsync(93, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_BuildingHoleMap") ?? "A construir mapa de furos..."} (93%)");
8662 foreach (var holeList in newHolesByColor.Values)
8663 {
8664 foreach (var hole in holeList)
8665 {
8666 foreach (var faceGlobalIndex in hole.FaceGlobalIndices)
8667 {
8668 if (!_faceIndexToHoleMap.ContainsKey(faceGlobalIndex))
8669 _faceIndexToHoleMap.Add(faceGlobalIndex, hole);
8670 }
8671 }
8672 }
8673
8674 // AUTO-IGNORE ONLY PLANAR FACES ALREADY CONFIRMED AS BRIDGES BY HoleDetector
8675 //
8676 // Do not run a second geometric bridge classifier here. HoleDetector already
8677 // performs bridge detection before the optional concave isolated single-face
8678 // fallback and preserves those bridge flags exactly. Reclassifying faces here
8679 // allowed a newly detected open U-shaped hole to make unrelated upper planar
8680 // faces look "sandwiched" between holes.
8681 string filteringFacesMsg = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_FilteringSpecialFaces") ?? "A filtrar faces entre furos...";
8682 await UpdateProgressAsync(93, $"{filteringFacesMsg} (93%)");
8683
8684 var token = _faceExtractionCancellationTokenSource?.Token ?? default;
8685
8686 if (extractedFaces != null)
8687 {
8688 var confirmedBridgeFaces = extractedFaces
8689 .Where(face => face.FaceType == FaceTypeEnum.Planar && face.IsBridgeBetweenHoles)
8690 .Distinct()
8691 .ToList();
8692
8693 foreach (var face in confirmedBridgeFaces)
8694 {
8695 token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
8696 face.IsIgnored = true;
8697 IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
8698 }
8699
8700 if (confirmedBridgeFaces.Count > 0)
8701 {
8702 _ignoredItemManager.ApplyIgnoredStyle(confirmedBridgeFaces);
8703 }
8704 }
8705
8706 // AUTO-IGNORE BASE AVOIDANCE FACES
8707 string ignoringBottomFaceMsg = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_IgnoringBottomFace") ?? "A ignorar face inferior...";
8708 await UpdateProgressAsync(93, $"{ignoringBottomFaceMsg} (93%)");
8709
8710 if (_allFacesByColor != null)
8711 {
8712 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList();
8713 var allDetectedHoles = _holesByColor?.Values.SelectMany(h => h).ToList() ?? new List<CADHole>();
8714 var facesToIgnore = BaseAvoidanceFaceClassifier.FindFacesToIgnore(
8715 allFaces,
8716 allDetectedHoles,
8717 face =>
8718 {
8719 if (_designControl == null ||
8720 face.EntityIndex < 0 ||
8721 face.EntityIndex >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
8722 {
8723 return null;
8724 }
8725
8726 var entity = _designControl.Entities[face.EntityIndex];
8727 return entity as Brep ?? EyeshotGeometryUtils.TryConvertToBrep(entity);
8728 }).ToList();
8729
8730 foreach (var face in facesToIgnore)
8731 {
8732 face.IsIgnored = true;
8733 face.AutoIgnoredByBaseAvoidance = true;
8734 face.MeasurementPoints = new List<Point4D>();
8735 IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
8736 }
8737
8738 if (facesToIgnore.Count > 0)
8739 {
8740 _ignoredItemManager?.ApplyIgnoredStyle(facesToIgnore);
8741 }
8742 }
8743
8744 // AUTO-IGNORE OBSTRUCTED HOLES (not reachable from top due to a smaller bore above on the same axis)
8745 // Mirrors the same call already present in PathManager during path planning.
8746 // Running here ensures obstructed hole faces get the stripe texture immediately
8747 // after Extract Faces, without requiring a full path-planning pass first.
8748 // Activates when HoleDetection_AutoIgnoreObstructedByLarger = True AND any bottom-face avoidance is enabled.
8749 bool autoIgnoreObstructed = false;
8750 bool.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["HoleDetection_AutoIgnoreObstructedByLarger"], out autoIgnoreObstructed);
8751
8752 if (autoIgnoreObstructed && _holesByColor != null && _allFacesByColor != null)
8753 {
8754 var allFacesForObstruction = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList();
8755 var allHolesForObstruction = _holesByColor.Values.SelectMany(h => h).ToList();
8756 var baseAvoidance = Utilities.Algorithms.BaseAvoidanceClearance.EnableForIgnoredBottomFace(
8757 Utilities.Algorithms.BaseAvoidanceClearance.LoadConfig(),
8758 Utilities.Algorithms.BaseAvoidanceFaceClassifier.HasIgnoredBottomFace(allFacesForObstruction));
8759 bool avoidBottom =
8760 baseAvoidance.Enabled ||
8761 (bool.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["Scanner_AvoidBottomFace"], out bool sbAv) && sbAv);
8762
8763 // Mutates hole.IsIgnored and face.IsIgnored in-place for any obstructed hole.
8764 Modules.HoleDetector.AutoIgnoreTopUnreachableHoles(allHolesForObstruction, allFacesForObstruction, avoidBottom);
8765
8766 // Collect faces that were just newly marked ignored by the obstruction check
8767 // and have not already been styled (avoids double-styling bridge/base faces).
8768 var newlyObstructedFaces = allFacesForObstruction
8769 .Where(f => f.IsIgnored && !IgnoredFaces.Contains(f))
8770 .ToList();
8771
8772 foreach (var face in newlyObstructedFaces)
8773 {
8774 face.MeasurementPoints = new List<Point4D>();
8775 IgnoredFaces.Add(face);
8776 }
8777
8778 var newlyObstructedHoles = allHolesForObstruction
8779 .Where(h => h.IsIgnored && !IgnoredHoles.Contains(h))
8780 .ToList();
8781
8782 foreach (var hole in newlyObstructedHoles)
8783 {
8784 IgnoredHoles.Add(hole);
8785 }
8786
8787 if (newlyObstructedFaces.Count > 0)
8788 {
8789 _ignoredItemManager?.ApplyIgnoredStyle(newlyObstructedFaces);
8790 }
8791 }
8792
8793 await UpdateProgressAsync(93, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_GeneratingMeasurementPoints") ?? "A gerar pontos de medição..."} (93%)");
8794 token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
8795 await Task.Run(() =>
8796 {
8797 _pathManager.PopulateMeasurementPointsForFaces(_designControl, isIncremental ? newFacesByColor : _allFacesByColor!, token);
8798 });
8799
8800 bool autoGenerateShellScannerMode = false;
8801 bool.TryParse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["AutoGenerateShellMeshOnScannerMode"], out autoGenerateShellScannerMode);
8802
8803 if (_pathManager != null)
8804 {
8805 bool meshOnExtraction = bool.Parse(ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["MeshCreationOnFaceExtraction"] ?? "True");
8806 bool isScanner = _pathManager.CmmType == Models.CMMType.Scanner;
8807
8808 if (meshOnExtraction && (!isScanner || autoGenerateShellScannerMode))
8809 {
8810 token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
8811 await UpdateProgressAsync(94, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_GeneratingShell") ?? "A gerar malha exterior de navegação..."} (94%)");
8812
8813 // Clear visuals so they don't get included as parts in shell mesh generation
8814 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
8815 {
8816 _visualsManager?.ClearAllMarkers();
8817 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
8818 _designControl?.Invalidate();
8819 });
8820
8821 await _pathManager.GenerateOversizedShellFromDesignAsync(_designControl, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
8822 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8823 {
8824 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShellVisibilityMenuText));
8825 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShellMeshesExist));
8826 });
8827 }
8828 else
8829 {
8830 Debug.WriteLine(" ℹ️ Shell mesh auto-generation is DISABLED via settings or Scanner Mode. Shell mesh will not be created.");
8831 }
8832 }
8833
8834 await UpdateProgressAsync(95, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_InvalidatingCache") ?? "A invalidar cache..."} (95%)");
8835 _treeViewHelper.InvalidateCache();
8836
8837 await UpdateProgressAsync(95, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_UpdatingTreeView") ?? "A atualizar árvore..."} (95%)");
8838 _treeViewHelper.PopulateTreeView(
8839 _facesByColor,
8840 _holesByColor!,
8841 _allFacesByColor!,
8842 showExteriorOnly: IsExteriorOnlyChecked,
8843 showVisibleOnly: IsVisibleOnlyChecked
8844 );
8845
8846 await UpdateProgressAsync(97, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_InitializingControls") ?? "A inicializar controlos..."} (97%)");
8847 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8848 {
8849 CanExport = true;
8850 planning_sp?.InitializeToleranceSliders();
8851 FacesUpToDate = true;
8852
8853 if (ReadBoolAppSetting(BaseAvoidanceShowAfterExtractionSettingKey, true))
8854 {
8855 ShowBaseAvoidancePlanesForLoadedParts();
8856 }
8857 });
8858 await UpdateProgressAsync(100, $"{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ExtractionComplete") ?? "Extração completa!"} (100%)", 1000);
8859
8860 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8861 {
8862 if (isIncremental)
8863 {
8864 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
8865 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_NewFacesAdded") ?? "Added {0} new faces, {1} new holes",
8866 extractedFaces?.Count ?? 0,
8867 detectedHoles?.Count ?? 0
8868 );
8869 }
8870 else
8871 {
8872 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
8873 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_FacesExtracted") ??
8874 "Extracted {0} faces, in {1} color groups.",
8875 extractedFaces?.Count ?? 0, _facesByColor.Count
8876 );
8877 }
8878
8879 measuring_sp?.UpdateMeasurementCounts();
8880
8881 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces");
8882
8883 if (_designControl != null)
8884 {
8885 _designControl.SelectionFilterMode = selectionFilterType.Face | selectionFilterType.Vertex;
8886 _designControl.ActionMode = actionType.SelectVisibleByPickDynamic;
8887 }
8888 });
8889
8890 await Task.Delay(1000);
8891 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8892 {
8893 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Gray);
8894 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
8895 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle";
8896 });
8897
8898 SaveCurrentSession();
8899 }
8900 catch (OperationCanceledException)
8901 {
8902 Debug.WriteLine("Face extraction was cancelled by user.");
8903 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8904 {
8905 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ExtractionCancelled") ?? "Face Extraction Cancelled";
8906 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_ExtractionCancelled") ?? "Face Extraction Cancelled";
8907 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
8908 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Orange);
8909 });
8910 }
8911 catch (Exception ex)
8912 {
8913 MessageBox.Show(
8914 (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ErrorMessageBox_ExtractFacesError") ??
8915 "Error extracting faces:") + $" {ex.Message}",
8916 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Internal Error",
8917 MessageBoxButton.OK,
8918 MessageBoxImage.Error
8919 );
8920 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ExtractionFailed");
8921
8922 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8923 {
8924 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Red);
8925 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
8926 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_Error") ?? "Error";
8927 });
8928 }
8929 finally
8930 {
8931 IsExtractingFaces = false;
8932 await Application.Current.Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
8933 {
8934 Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
8935 // Reset button text appropriately based on whether we have faces or not
8936 ExtractUpdateFacesButton_Text = (_allFacesByColor == null || _allFacesByColor.Count == 0)
8937 ? GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ExtractFaces")
8938 : GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "UpdateFaces");
8939 });
8940 }
8941 }

9016 private void StartFaceToHoleConversion(CADFace face)
9017 {
9018 if (face == null || !IsCylindricalFace(face))
9019 {
9020 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_InvalidFaceForConversion")
9021 ?? "Invalid face for conversion. Face must be cylindrical.";
9022 return;
9023 }
9024
9025 _pendingHoleConversionFace = face;
9026 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_SelectSecondFace")
9027 ?? "Select another cylindrical face with the same radius to complete hole conversion.";
9028 }
9029
9033 private void CompleteFaceToHoleConversion(CADFace secondFace)
9034 {
9035 if (_pendingHoleConversionFace == null || secondFace == null)
9036 {
9037 CancelFaceToHoleConversion();
9038 return;
9039 }
9040
9041 // Validate compatibility using HoleDetector
9042 if (!HoleDetector.CanConvertToHole(_pendingHoleConversionFace, secondFace))
9043 {
9044 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_IncompatibleFaces")
9045 ?? "Selected faces are not compatible. Both faces must be cylindrical with the same radius.";
9046 return;
9047 }
9048
9049 try
9050 {
9051 // Get all faces for context (needed for hole validation)
9052 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor?.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList() ?? new List<CADFace>();
9053
9054 // Get next hole ID
9055 int holeId = GetNextHoleId();
9056
9057 // Create hole using HoleDetector's public method
9058 var newHole = HoleDetector.CreateHoleFromTwoFaces(
9059 _pendingHoleConversionFace,
9060 secondFace,
9061 holeId,
9062 allFaces
9063 );
9064
9065 if (newHole != null)
9066 {
9067 // Add the new hole to the appropriate collection
9068 AddNewHole(newHole);
9069
9070 // Refresh the tree view
9071 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
9072 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
9073
9074 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
9075 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HoleConversionComplete")
9076 ?? "Hole conversion complete. Created Hole {0}.",
9077 newHole.HoleId
9078 );
9079
9080 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
9081 () =>
9082 {
9083 PerformConvertHoleToFaces(newHole);
9084 },
9085 () =>
9086 {
9087 AddNewHole(newHole);
9088 _treeViewHelper?.InvalidateCache();
9089 PopulateTreeViewBasedOnFilter();
9090 },
9091 description: $"Convert faces ({ColorNamer.FormatColorWithRgb(newHole.HoleColor)}) to Hole {newHole.HoleId}",
9092 category: "Hole Management"
9093 ));
9094 }
9095 else
9096 {
9097 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HoleConversionFailed")
9098 ?? "Failed to create hole from selected faces.";
9099 }
9100 }
9101 catch (Exception ex)
9102 {
9103 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(
9104 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HoleConversionError")
9105 ?? "Error during hole conversion: {0}",
9106 ex.Message
9107 );
9108 }
9109 finally
9110 {
9111 _pendingHoleConversionFace = null;
9112 }
9113 }

9128 private void StartManualMarking(object item)
9129 {
9130 if (item is CADFace face)
9131 {
9132 _faceBeingMarkedManually = face;

9134 }
9135 else if (item is CADHole hole)
9136 {
9137 _holeBeingMarkedManually = hole;
9138 _faceBeingMarkedManually = null;
9139 }
9140 else
9141 {
9142 return;
9143 }
9144
9145 _isManualMarkingActive = true;
9146 _manuallyMarkedPoints.Clear();
9147 ClearManualMarkingSpheres();
9148
9149 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ManualMarkingStarted")
9150 ?? "Manual marking mode active. Click on the surface to add measurement points. Right-click to finish.";
9151 }
9152
9156 private void CompleteManualMarking()
9157 {
9158 if (!_isManualMarkingActive)
9159 return;
9160
9161 try
9162 {
9163 if (_faceBeingMarkedManually != null && _manuallyMarkedPoints.Any())
9164 {
9165 var face = _faceBeingMarkedManually;
9166 var oldPoints = face.MeasurementPoints?.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W)).ToList() ?? new List<Point4D>();
9167 var oldHasManual = face.HasManualMeasurementPoints;
9168
9169 var newPoints = _manuallyMarkedPoints.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, 1.0)).ToList();
9170
9171 Action<List<Point4D>, bool> setPointsAction = (pts, hasManual) =>
9172 {
9173 face.MeasurementPoints = pts.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W)).ToList();
9174 face.HasManualMeasurementPoints = hasManual;
9175 if (ShowAllMeasurementPoints)
9176 {
9177 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(false);
9178 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(true);
9179 }
9180 };
9181
9182 setPointsAction(newPoints, true);
9183
9184 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
9185 () => setPointsAction(oldPoints, oldHasManual),
9186 () => setPointsAction(newPoints, true),
9187 description: $"Manual marking on face ({ColorNamer.FormatColorWithRgb(face.FaceColor)})",
9188 category: "Measurement Points"
9189 ));
9190
9191 string message = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ManualMarkingComplete")
9192 ?? "Manual marking complete. {0} measurement points marked.";
9193 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(message, _manuallyMarkedPoints.Count);
9194 }
9195 else if (_holeBeingMarkedManually != null && _manuallyMarkedPoints.Any())
9196 {
9197 var hole = _holeBeingMarkedManually;
9198 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor?.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList() ?? new List<CADFace>();
9199 var holeFaces = allFaces.Where(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)).ToList();
9200
9201 var oldStates = holeFaces.ToDictionary(f => f, f => new
9202 {
9203 Points = f.MeasurementPoints?.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W)).ToList() ?? new List<Point4D>(),
9204 HasManual = f.HasManualMeasurementPoints
9205 });
9206
9207 var newPoints = _manuallyMarkedPoints.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, 1.0)).ToList();
9208
9209 Action<bool> setPointsAction = (isRedo) =>
9210 {
9211 foreach (var face in holeFaces)
9212 {
9213 if (isRedo)
9214 {
9215 face.MeasurementPoints = newPoints.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W)).ToList();
9216 face.HasManualMeasurementPoints = true;
9217 }
9218 else
9219 {
9220 face.MeasurementPoints = oldStates[face].Points.Select(p => new Point4D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z, p.W)).ToList();
9221 face.HasManualMeasurementPoints = oldStates[face].HasManual;
9222 }
9223 }
9224 if (ShowAllMeasurementPoints)
9225 {
9226 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(false);
9227 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(true);
9228 }
9229 };
9230
9231 setPointsAction(true);
9232
9233 UndoManager.PushCommand(new ActionUndoCommand(
9234 () => setPointsAction(false),
9235 () => setPointsAction(true),
9236 description: $"Manual marking on Hole {hole.HoleId} ({ColorNamer.FormatColorWithRgb(hole.HoleColor)})",
9237 category: "Measurement Points"
9238 ));
9239
9240 string message = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ManualMarkingComplete")
9241 ?? "Manual marking complete. {0} measurement points marked.";
9242 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(message, _manuallyMarkedPoints.Count);
9243 }
9244 else
9245 {
9246 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ManualMarkingCancelled")
9247 ?? "Manual marking cancelled - no points marked.";
9248 }
9249
9250 // Refresh measurement point visualization if currently shown
9251 if (ShowAllMeasurementPoints)
9252 {
9253 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(false);
9254 ToggleAllMeasurementPointsVisibility(true);
9255 }
9256 }
9257 finally
9258 {
9259 _isManualMarkingActive = false;
9260 _faceBeingMarkedManually = null;
9261 _holeBeingMarkedManually = null;
9262 _manuallyMarkedPoints.Clear();
9263 ClearManualMarkingSpheres();
9264 _designControl.Invalidate();
9265 SaveCurrentSession();
9266 }
9267 }

9300 private bool IsSpecificContextMenuTargetUnderCursor()
9301 {
9302 if (_designControl == null)
9303 return false;
9304
9305 try
9306 {
9307 var mousePosition = Mouse.GetPosition(_designControl);
9308 if (double.IsNaN(mousePosition.X) ||
9309 double.IsNaN(mousePosition.Y) ||
9310 mousePosition.X < 0 ||
9311 mousePosition.Y < 0 ||
9312 mousePosition.X > _designControl.ActualWidth ||
9313 mousePosition.Y > _designControl.ActualHeight)
9314 {
9315 return false;
9316 }
9317
9318 var screenPoint = new System.Drawing.Point((int)mousePosition.X, (int)mousePosition.Y);
9319 var itemUnderCursor = _designControl.GetItemUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint);
9320 if (itemUnderCursor != null)
9321 return true;
9322
9323 int entityIndex = _designControl.GetEntityUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint);
9324 if (entityIndex < 0 || entityIndex >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
9325 return false;
9326
9327 return IsSpecificContextEntity(_designControl.Entities[entityIndex]);
9328 }
9329 catch (Exception ex)
9330 {
9331 Debug.WriteLine($"Context menu hit-test failed: {ex.Message}");
9332 return false;
9333 }
9334 }
9335
9341 private bool IsSpecificContextEntity(Entity? entity)
9342 {
9343 if (entity == null)
9344 return false;
9345
9346 if (entity.EntityData is WaypointData ||
9347 entity.EntityData is PathSegmentData ||
9348 entity is LinearPath linearPath &&
9349 linearPath.LayerName != null &&
9350 linearPath.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
9351 {
9352 return true;
9353 }
9354
9355 if (_visualsManager?.ControlPointSpheres?.Contains(entity) == true ||
9356 _manualMarkingSpheres.Contains(entity))
9357 {
9358 return true;
9359 }
9360
9361 if (entity.EntityData is string entityData &&
9362 entityData.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
9363 {
9364 return true;
9365 }
9366
9367 if (entity is Brep || entity is Mesh)
9368 {
9369 return !IsDesignerUtilityLayer(entity.LayerName);
9370 }
9371
9372 return false;
9373 }
9374
9380 private static bool IsDesignerUtilityLayer(string? layerName)
9381 {
9382 return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(layerName) &&
9383 (layerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9384 layerName.Contains("IGNORED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9385 layerName.StartsWith("PATH_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9386 layerName.Contains("SIMULATION", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9387 string.Equals(layerName, "MARKERS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9388 string.Equals(layerName, "COLLISION_MARKERS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9389 string.Equals(layerName, "RAYCAST_HITS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9390 string.Equals(layerName, "PROBE_TRACKING", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
9391 string.Equals(layerName, "SCANNER_FOV_VISUALIZATION", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
9392 }

9423 private int GetNextHoleId()
9424 {
9425 int maxId = 0;
9426
9427 if (_holesByColor != null)
9428 {
9429 foreach (var holeList in _holesByColor.Values)
9430 {
9431 foreach (var hole in holeList)
9432 {
9433 if (hole.HoleId > maxId) maxId = hole.HoleId;
9434 }
9435 }
9436 }
9437
9438 return maxId + 1;
9439 }

9444 private void AddNewHole(CADHole hole)
9445 {
9446 // Determine the color key from the constituent faces
9447 string colorKey = "Default";
9448
9449 if (hole.FaceGlobalIndices != null && hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Any() && _allFacesByColor != null)
9450 {
9451 foreach (var kvp in _allFacesByColor)
9452 {
9453 if (kvp.Value.Any(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex)))
9454 {
9455 colorKey = kvp.Key;
9456 break;
9457 }
9458 }
9459 }
9460
9461 // Add to holes collection
9462 if (_holesByColor != null)
9463 {
9464 if (!_holesByColor.ContainsKey(colorKey))
9465 {
9466 _holesByColor[colorKey] = new List<CADHole>();
9467 }
9468
9469 _holesByColor[colorKey].Add(hole);
9470 }
9471
9472 // Update face-to-hole mapping if it exists
9473 if (_faceIndexToHoleMap != null && hole.FaceGlobalIndices != null)
9474 {
9475 foreach (var faceIdx in hole.FaceGlobalIndices)
9476 {
9477 _faceIndexToHoleMap[faceIdx] = hole;
9478 }
9479 }
9480
9481 // Automatically remove constituent faces from _facesByColor
9482 if (hole.FaceGlobalIndices != null && _facesByColor != null)
9483 {
9484 var keysToClean = new List<string>();
9485 foreach (var kvp in _facesByColor)
9486 {
9487 kvp.Value.RemoveAll(f => hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(f.FaceGlobalIndex));
9488 if (kvp.Value.Count == 0)
9489 {
9490 keysToClean.Add(kvp.Key);
9491 }
9492 }
9493 foreach (var key in keysToClean)
9494 {
9495 _facesByColor.Remove(key);
9496 }
9497 }
9498 }

9653 public async Task<bool> GenerateAndVisualizePaths()
9654 {
9655 // Create new cancellation token for this generation
9656 _pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource?.Dispose();
9657 _pathGenerationCancellationTokenSource = new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource();
9658
9659 // Update button text to "Cancel"
9660 var measuring_sp = Application.Current.Windows.OfType<Window>().FirstOrDefault()?
9661 .FindName("Measuring_SidePanelContainer") as Measuring_SidePanel ?? this.measuring_sp;
9662 if (measuring_sp != null)
9663 {
9664 measuring_sp.IsPathGenerationRunning = true;
9665 }
9666
9667 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
9668
9669 // Set progress bar to a subtle light gray color for path generation
9670 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(220, 220, 230));

9949 // Convert scanner paths to the dictionary format expected by the rest of the method.

9964 foreach (var group in pathsByColor)

9966 var points = group
9967 .SelectMany(p => p.Points.Select(sp => sp.Position))
9968 .ToList();

9971 .ToList();

9974 .ToList();

9977 .ToList();

9980 .ToList();

9998 .ToList();
9999 var allUpVectors = scanPaths

10001 .ToList();
10002 var allPointTypes = scanPaths

10010 scannerEntityIndicesByColor[fallbackColor] = scanPaths
10011 .SelectMany(sp => sp.Points.Select(p => p.ParentFace?.EntityIndex ?? sp.Face?.EntityIndex ?? -1))
10012 .ToList();
10013 }

10070 int validationCollisions = -1;

10073 if (selectedCmmType == CMMType.Probe)
10074 {
10075 bool canRunSegmentValidation = _pathManager.CanRunGeneratedPathSegmentCollisionValidation;

10078 segmentValidationSkipped = true;

10081 ?? "Segment collision validation skipped";

10083 else
10084 {
10085 DateTime lastSegmentProgressUpdateUtc = DateTime.MinValue;
10086 Action<int, int, int> segmentValidationProgress = (processed, total, collisions) =>
10087 {
10088 if (total <= 0)
10089 return;
10090
10091 if (processed < total &&
10092 (DateTime.UtcNow - lastSegmentProgressUpdateUtc).TotalMilliseconds < 30)
10093 {
10094 return;
10095 }
10096
10097 lastSegmentProgressUpdateUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
10098 int remaining = Math.Max(0, total - processed);
10099 int mappedPercent = 96 + (int)Math.Round((processed / (double)Math.Max(1, total)) * 3.0);
10100 mappedPercent = Math.Max(96, Math.Min(99, mappedPercent));
10101 string progressFormat = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_SegmentCollisionValidation")
10102 ?? "Validating segment collisions: {0}/{1} checked, {2} left, {3} collisions";
10103 string progressMessage = string.Format(
10104 CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
10105 progressFormat,
10106 processed,
10107 total,
10108 remaining,
10109 collisions);
10110
10111 Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(() =>
10112 {
10113 Machine_Status_Progress = mappedPercent;
10114 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{progressMessage} ({mappedPercent}%)";
10115 });
10116 };

10118 if (measuring_sp != null)

10120 measuring_sp.IsPathGenerationRunning = false;
10121 measuring_sp.IsSegmentCollisionCheckRunning = true;

10128 if (measuring_sp != null)
10129 {
10130 measuring_sp.IsSegmentCollisionCheckRunning = false;

10133
10134 if (!validationResult.Completed)

10138 ?? "Segment collision validation cancelled. Generated paths were kept.";
10139 }

10144 {
10145 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() => _pathManager?.RegeneratePathVisuals());
10146 }
10147 }
10148 }
10149 }

10151 Machine_Status_Progress = 100;

10154 : (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_PathGenerationComplete") ?? "Path generation complete!");
10155 if (selectedCmmType == CMMType.Scanner)

10167 }

10171 }

10175 }
10176 else if (validationCollisions > 0)

10178 successMessage += $"\n{GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathGeneration_CollisionSummary_Count")?.Replace("{0}", validationCollisions.ToString()) ?? $"Warning: {validationCollisions} segments collided."}";
10179 }
10180
10181 string formattedSuccessMessage = string.Format(
10182 CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
10183 successMessage,
10184 plannedPaths.Count,
10185 plannedPaths.Sum(p => p.Value.Count));
10186
10187 EyeshotStatus_Text = formattedSuccessMessage;
10188
10189 // 9. Display path information
10190 ShowPathInfo(formattedSuccessMessage);
10191
10192 // 10. Refresh the tool-color list in Measuring_SidePanel
10193 measuring_sp?.RefreshColorToolList();
10194
10195 // Reset progress bar after completion
10196 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Gray);
10197 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
10198 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle";
10199
10200 SaveCurrentSession();
10201 }
10202 catch (OperationCanceledException)
10203 {

10209 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;

10282 private bool _isModelLoading = false;
10283 private bool _isStartingSimulation = false;
10284 private bool _isStoppingSimulation = false;
10285 private bool _cameraFollowPrimedForSimulation = false;
10286
10290 public async void StartPathSimulation()
10291 {
10292 if (_isStartingSimulation || _isModelLoading || (_pathManager?.IsSimulating ?? false)) return;
10293 if (_pathManager != null && _pathManager.IsProbeCollisionValidationRunning)
10294 {
10295 MessageBox.Show(
10296 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Simulation_Error_ProbeCollisionRunning") ?? "Cannot start simulation while a probe collision check is running. Please wait for it to finish or cancel it.",
10297 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_SimulationErrorTitle") ?? "Simulation Error",
10298 MessageBoxButton.OK,
10299 MessageBoxImage.Warning);
10300 return;
10301 }
10302
10303 _isStartingSimulation = true;
10304 try
10305 {
10306 if (_pathManager == null || !_pathManager.ColorPaths.Any())
10307 {
10308 MessageBox.Show(
10309 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_NoPathsGenerated") ?? "Please generate paths first.",
10310 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_SimulationErrorTitle") ?? "Simulation Error",
10311 MessageBoxButton.OK,
10312 MessageBoxImage.Warning);
10313 return;
10314 }
10315
10316 CMMType selectedCmmType = GetSelectedCmmType();

10323 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "TrajectoryMismatchSimulationTitle") ?? "CMM Type Mismatch",

10326 return;

10329 string startingSimText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "StartingSimulation") ?? "Starting Simulation...";
10330
10331 if (measuring_sp != null)
10332 {
10333 measuring_sp.SimulatePathButton_Text = startingSimText;
10334 }
10335
10336 // Say "Simulation Starting..." on progress bar and text immediately
10337 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(128, 128, 128));
10338 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
10339 Machine_Status_ProgressText = startingSimText;
10340
10341 if (_cameraUtils != null && cameraFollowEnabled && (selectedCmmType == CMMType.Probe || selectedCmmType == CMMType.Scanner))
10342 {
10343 _cameraUtils.StartCameraFollowing();
10344 _cameraFollowPrimedForSimulation = true;
10345 }
10346
10347 // Ensure tools are up to date before simulation
10348 _measuringToolConfig.ReloadConfiguration();
10349 if (_pathManager.ColorPaths != null)
10350 {
10351 foreach (var colorPath in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
10352 {
10353 if (colorPath.PathCmmType == Models.CMMType.Probe || colorPath.PathCmmType == Models.CMMType.Scanner)
10354 {
10355 string currentToolName = _measuringToolConfig.GetToolForColor(colorPath.Color);
10356 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(currentToolName) && colorPath.ToolName != currentToolName)
10357 {
10358 colorPath.ToolName = currentToolName;
10359 }
10360 }
10361 }
10362 }
10363
10364 _pathManager.SimulationSpeed = SimulationSpeed;
10365 HideBaseAvoidancePlaneForCollisionOrSimulation();
10366 await PreloadToolModelsAsync(selectedCmmType == CMMType.Scanner);
10367
10368 System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher?.Invoke(() =>
10369 {
10370 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Simulation_LoadingTool") ?? "Loading tool model";
10371 });
10372 await Task.Delay(100); // Allow UI to render
10373
10374 if (_pathManager.FilterConfig.SimulationHideApproachPoints || _pathManager.FilterConfig.SimulationHideMeasurePoints || _pathManager.FilterConfig.SimulationHidePathLines)
10375 {
10376 System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher?.Invoke(() =>
10377 {
10378 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Arrow;
10379 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Simulation_Optimizing") ?? "Starting Simulation - Optimizing and preparing...";
10380 });
10381 await Task.Delay(100); // Allow UI to render
10382 }
10383
10384 _pathManager.StartSimulation();
10385
10386 System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher?.Invoke(() => { Mouse.OverrideCursor = null; });
10387
10388 SimulationSpeedPanelVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
10389 IsSimulationSeekEnabled = true;
10390 IsSimulationActive = true;
10391 UpdateCameraControlsVisibility();
10392 PauseSimulationVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
10393 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_SimulationStarted") ?? "Simulation started...";
10394 }
10395 catch (Exception ex)
10396 {
10397 string errorMessage = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_ErrorStartingSimulation") ?? "Error starting simulation";
10398 MessageBox.Show(
10399 $"{errorMessage}: {ex.Message}",
10400 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Error",
10401 MessageBoxButton.OK,
10402 MessageBoxImage.Error);
10403
10404 // Set error state
10405 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Red);
10406 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
10407 string errorText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Simulation_Error") ?? "Simulation Error";
10408 Machine_Status_ProgressText = errorText;
10409 }
10410 finally
10411 {
10412 _isStartingSimulation = false;
10413 _cameraFollowPrimedForSimulation = false;
10414 }
10415 }

10423 private System.Drawing.Color NormalizeColorLightness(System.Drawing.Color color, double targetLightness)
10424 {
10425 // Convert RGB to HSL
10426 double r = color.R / 255.0;
10427 double g = color.G / 255.0;
10428 double b = color.B / 255.0;
10429
10430 double max = Math.Max(r, Math.Max(g, b));
10431 double min = Math.Min(r, Math.Min(g, b));
10432 double delta = max - min;
10433
10434 // Calculate Hue
10435 double hue = 0.0;
10436 if (delta != 0)
10437 {
10438 if (max == r)
10439 hue = 60 * (((g - b) / delta) % 6);
10440 else if (max == g)
10441 hue = 60 * (((b - r) / delta) + 2);
10442 else
10443 hue = 60 * (((r - g) / delta) + 4);
10444 }
10445 if (hue < 0) hue += 360;
10446
10447 // Calculate Lightness
10448 double lightness = (max + min) / 2.0;
10449
10450 // Calculate Saturation
10451 double saturation = 0.0;
10452 if (delta != 0)
10453 saturation = delta / (1 - Math.Abs(2 * lightness - 1));
10454
10455 // Set new lightness
10456 lightness = targetLightness;
10457
10458 // Convert HSL back to RGB
10459 double c = (1 - Math.Abs(2 * lightness - 1)) * saturation;
10460 double x = c * (1 - Math.Abs((hue / 60.0) % 2 - 1));
10461 double m = lightness - c / 2.0;
10462
10463 double rPrime = 0, gPrime = 0, bPrime = 0;
10464 if (hue < 60) { rPrime = c; gPrime = x; bPrime = 0; }
10465 else if (hue < 120) { rPrime = x; gPrime = c; bPrime = 0; }
10466 else if (hue < 180) { rPrime = 0; gPrime = c; bPrime = x; }
10467 else if (hue < 240) { rPrime = 0; gPrime = x; bPrime = c; }
10468 else if (hue < 300) { rPrime = x; gPrime = 0; bPrime = c; }
10469 else { rPrime = c; gPrime = 0; bPrime = x; }
10470
10471 byte newR = (byte)((rPrime + m) * 255);
10472 byte newG = (byte)((gPrime + m) * 255);
10473 byte newB = (byte)((bPrime + m) * 255);
10474
10475 return System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(newR, newG, newB);
10476 }

10645 public void SetCustomExecutionOrder(List<string> colorNames)
10646 {
10647 List<Color> colors = new List<Color>();
10648
10649 foreach (string colorName in colorNames)
10650 {
10651 try
10652 {
10653 // Parse the RGB values from the format "Name (R95_G0_B0)" using regex
10654 var colorMatch = Regex.Match(colorName, @"R(\d{1,3})_G(\d{1,3})_B(\d{1,3})");
10655 if (colorMatch.Success)
10656 {
10657 byte r = byte.Parse(colorMatch.Groups[1].Value);
10658 byte g = byte.Parse(colorMatch.Groups[2].Value);
10659 byte b = byte.Parse(colorMatch.Groups[3].Value);
10660
10661 Color color = Color.FromArgb(255, r, g, b);
10662 colors.Add(color);
10663 }
10664 }
10665 catch
10666 {
10667 // Ignore invalid color names
10668 }
10669 }
10670
10671 SetCustomExecutionOrder(colors);
10672 }

10765 private void OnSimulationStopped(object sender, SimulationEventArgs e)
10766 {
10767 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathManager_SimulationCompleted") ?? "Simulation completed.";
10768
10769 // Show the restoring message BEFORE the heavy Eyeshot cleanup freezes the UI
10770 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(128, 128, 128));
10771 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ProbeCollision_RestoringPaths") ?? "Restoring visualization components...";
10772 IsSimulationActive = false;
10773 IsSimulationSeekEnabled = false;
10774 PauseSimulationVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
10775 SimulationSpeedPanelVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
10776 CameraControlsButtonVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
10777 CameraControlsPanelVisibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
10778
10779 // Stop camera following and reset the follow state so a subsequent
10780 // auto-triggered probe collision check starts with a clean slate.
10781 if (_cameraUtils != null)
10782 {
10783 _cameraUtils.StopCameraFollowing();
10784 }
10785 // Reset the follow-enabled flag: after the simulation ends the camera
10786 // is no longer tracking the probe/scanner, so the UI state should reflect that.
10787 // If the user explicitly had follow-on they can re-enable it.
10788 cameraFollowEnabled = false;
10789 NotifyCameraFollowMenuItemsChanged();
10790
10791 // Update cleanup button visibility
10792 UpdateCollisionMarkersVisibility();
10793
10794 // After 1 second, clear the restoring message to Idle
10795 var timer = new System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1) };
10796 timer.Tick += (s, args) =>
10797 {
10798 timer.Stop();
10799 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle";
10800 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
10801 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Gray);
10802 };
10803 timer.Start();
10804 }

11149 private static double DistancePointToLine(Point3D p, Point3D lineOrigin, Vector3D lineDir)
11150 {
11151 Vector3D v = new Vector3D(lineOrigin, p);
11152 Vector3D cross = EyeshotGeometryUtils.CrossProduct(v, lineDir);
11153 double dirLen = Math.Sqrt(lineDir.X * lineDir.X + lineDir.Y * lineDir.Y + lineDir.Z * lineDir.Z);
11154 if (dirLen < 1e-9) return p.DistanceTo(lineOrigin);
11155 return Math.Sqrt(cross.X * cross.X + cross.Y * cross.Y + cross.Z * cross.Z) / dirLen;
11156 }

11248 public async Task<string?> GenerateProgramAsync(DMISPostProcessorSettings? settings = null, string? suggestedFilePath = null)
11249 {
11250 if (_pathManager == null || !_pathManager.HasGeneratedProbePaths())
11251 {
11252 string msg = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "GenerateProgram_NoProbePaths")
11253 ?? "No generated probe paths found. Please generate probe paths before exporting a DMIS program.";
11254 string title = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "GenerateProgram") ?? "Generate DMIS Program";
11255 MessageBox.Show(msg, title, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
11256 return null;
11257 }
11258
11259 try
11260 {
11261 string modelName = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(CurrentlyLoadedFilePath)
11262 ? Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(CurrentlyLoadedFilePath)
11263 : "InspectionModel";
11264
11265 // Ensure settings
11266 settings ??= new DMISPostProcessorSettings
11267 {
11268 ProgramName = $"PROG_{modelName.Replace(" ", "_")}",
11269 TraverseFeedrate = 250.0,
11270 MeasuringFeedrate = 5.0,
11271 ApproachDistance = 5.0,
11272 RetractDistance = 5.0,
11273 SearchDistance = 3.0,
11274 IncludeMachineDefinitions = true,
11275 IncludeSensorDefinitions = true,
11276 GenerateFeatureDefinitions = true,
11277 ProbePathsOnly = true
11278 };
11279
11280 // Automatically populate part bounding box for automated calibration routine if available (supporting single-part and multipart assemblies)
11281 Point3D? partMin = null;
11282 Point3D? partMax = null;
11283 bool hasBounds = TryGetPartBoundsForSource(null, out var bMinAll, out var bMaxAll, out _);
11284 if (hasBounds)
11285 {
11286 partMin = bMinAll;
11287 partMax = bMaxAll;
11288 }
11289 else if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(CurrentlyLoadedFilePath) &&
11290 TryGetPartBoundsForSource(CurrentlyLoadedFilePath, out var bMinSrc, out var bMaxSrc, out _))
11291 {
11292 hasBounds = true;
11293 partMin = bMinSrc;
11294 partMax = bMaxSrc;
11295 }
11296
11297 if (!settings.HasPartBounds && hasBounds && partMin != null && partMax != null)
11298 {
11299 settings.PartBoundsXMin = partMin.X;
11300 settings.PartBoundsXMax = partMax.X;
11301 settings.PartBoundsYMin = partMin.Y;
11302 settings.PartBoundsYMax = partMax.Y;
11303 settings.PartBoundsZMin = partMin.Z;
11304 settings.PartBoundsZMax = partMax.Z;
11305 settings.IncludePartCalibrationRoutine = true;
11306 }
11307
11308 // Get current PathExportDTO
11309 var pathExport = _pathManager.GetPathExportDTO(modelName);
11310
11311 // Check tool correspondence against calibrated CMM probes and standard catalog
11312 var usedToolNames = pathExport.ColorPaths
11313 .Select(cp => cp.ToolName)
11314 .Where(t => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(t))
11315 .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
11316 .ToList();
11317
11318 var unmappedTools = new List<string>();
11319 foreach (var tool in usedToolNames)
11320 {
11321 bool isCatalog = CmmStandardToolCatalog.StandardMontages.Any(m =>
11322 string.Equals(m.MontageId, tool, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
11323 bool isStylus = ToolModelLoader.IsStandaloneStylusTool(tool);
11324 bool isMapped = settings.ToolMappings.ContainsKey(tool);
11325 bool isDefault = string.Equals(tool, MeasuringToolTypes.DefaultTool, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
11326
11327 string montagesFolder = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "3DModels", "Machine_Tools", "Cmm_Montages", tool);
11328 bool hasMontageFolder = Directory.Exists(montagesFolder);
11329
11330 if (!isCatalog && !isStylus && !isMapped && !hasMontageFolder && !isDefault)
11331 {
11332 unmappedTools.Add(tool);
11333 }
11334 }
11335
11336 if (unmappedTools.Count > 0)
11337 {
11338 string toolList = string.Join("\n - ", unmappedTools);
11339 string warningTemplate = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "GenerateProgram_ToolCorrespondenceWarning")
11340 ?? "The following tool definitions in your inspection path do not have a calibrated CMM probe correspondence:\n\n - {0}\n\nWould you like to export an Autonomous Standard DMIS program (with auto-defined kinematics and styli) to run on any CMM out of the box?\n\nSelect 'Yes' for Autonomous Standard DMIS, or 'No' to cancel and map your tools.";
11341 string warningMessage = string.Format(warningTemplate, toolList);
11342
11343 var choice = MessageBox.Show(
11344 warningMessage,
11345 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "GenerateProgram_ChooseExportType") ?? "DMIS Program Mode Selection",
11346 MessageBoxButton.YesNo,
11347 MessageBoxImage.Question);
11348
11349 if (choice != MessageBoxResult.Yes)
11350 {
11351 if (measuring_sp != null)
11352 {
11353 measuring_sp.AppendLog("[DMIS Post-Processor] Program export cancelled by user to configure tool mappings.");
11354 }
11355 return null;
11356 }
11357
11358 // Auto-configure standard tool definitions for unmapped tools in autonomous mode
11359 foreach (var unmapped in unmappedTools)
11360 {
11361 if (!settings.ToolMappings.ContainsKey(unmapped))
11362 {
11363 var montage = CmmStandardToolCatalog.ResolveToolMontage(unmapped);
11364 settings.ToolMappings[unmapped] = new CmmToolMapping
11365 {
11366 AppToolName = unmapped,
11367 TargetCmmSensorLabel = montage.MontageId,
11368 TipRadius = montage.Stylus.BallDiameter / 2.0,
11369 StylusLength = montage.Stylus.OverallLength,
11370 ExtensionLength = montage.Extension?.Length ?? 0.0,
11371 RackSlot = montage.DefaultRackSlot > 0 ? montage.DefaultRackSlot : 1
11372 };
11373 }
11374 }
11375 }
11376
11377 string timestamp = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss");
11378 string defaultFileName = $"Program_{modelName.Replace(" ", "_")}_{timestamp}.dmi";
11379
11380 string destinationPath = suggestedFilePath ?? string.Empty;
11381
11382 if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(destinationPath))
11383 {
11384 var saveDialog = new SaveFileDialog
11385 {
11386 Title = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "GenerateProgram_DialogTitle") ?? "Save DMIS 5.3 Inspection Program",
11387 Filter = "DMIS Program Files (*.dmi)|*.dmi|DMIS Standard Files (*.dmis)|*.dmis|Text Files (*.txt)|*.txt|All Files (*.*)|*.*",
11388 FileName = defaultFileName,
11389 DefaultExt = ".dmi",
11390 OverwritePrompt = false
11391 };
11392
11393 bool? result = saveDialog.ShowDialog();
11394 if (result != true)
11395 {
11396 return null; // User cancelled
11397 }
11398 destinationPath = saveDialog.FileName;
11399
11400 if (File.Exists(destinationPath))
11401 {
11402 string filePrompt = string.Format(
11403 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_FileAlreadyExists") ?? "The file '{0}' already exists.\n\nDo you want to overwrite it?",
11404 Path.GetFileName(destinationPath));
11405 string filePromptTitle = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_FileAlreadyExistsTitle") ?? "File Already Exists";
11406
11407 if (MessageBox.Show(filePrompt, filePromptTitle, MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Warning) != MessageBoxResult.Yes)
11408 {
11409 return null;
11410 }
11411 }
11412 }
11413
11414 // Execute DMIS Post-Processing
11415 var postProcessor = new DMISPostProcessor();
11416 var (success, outputFile, errorMsg) = postProcessor.PostProcessToFile(pathExport, destinationPath, settings);
11417
11418 if (!success)
11419 {
11420 MessageBox.Show(
11421 $"Error generating DMIS program: {errorMsg}",
11422 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "GenerateProgram") ?? "Generate DMIS Program",
11423 MessageBoxButton.OK,
11424 MessageBoxImage.Error);
11425 return null;
11426 }
11427
11428 // Also save an automated archive copy in AppData
11429 try
11430 {
11431 string archiveDir = Path.Combine(AppDataFolder, "ProgramsGenerated", timestamp);
11432 if (!Directory.Exists(archiveDir))
11433 {
11434 Directory.CreateDirectory(archiveDir);
11435 }
11436 string archiveFile = Path.Combine(archiveDir, defaultFileName);
11437 File.Copy(destinationPath, archiveFile, true);
11438 }
11439 catch (Exception ex)
11440 {
11441 Debug.WriteLine($"Failed to write archive copy of DMIS program: {ex.Message}");
11442 }
11443
11444 // Append notification to measuring log
11445 if (measuring_sp != null)
11446 {
11447 measuring_sp.AppendLog($"[DMIS Post-Processor] Program successfully exported to: {destinationPath}");
11448 }
11449
11450 EyeshotStatus_Text = $"DMIS Program generated: {Path.GetFileName(destinationPath)}";
11451
11452 // Inform the user and offer to open destination directory
11453 string successMsgTemplate = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "GenerateProgram_Success")
11454 ?? "DMIS 5.3 inspection program generated successfully at:\n{0}\n\nWould you like to open the output folder?";
11455 string formattedSuccessMsg = string.Format(successMsgTemplate, destinationPath);
11456
11457 var promptResult = MessageBox.Show(
11458 formattedSuccessMsg,
11459 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "GenerateProgram") ?? "Generate DMIS Program",
11460 MessageBoxButton.YesNo,
11461 MessageBoxImage.Information);
11462
11463 if (promptResult == MessageBoxResult.Yes)
11464 {
11465 string? dir = Path.GetDirectoryName(destinationPath);
11466 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dir) && Directory.Exists(dir))
11467 {
11468 Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo
11469 {
11470 FileName = dir,
11471 UseShellExecute = true
11472 });
11473 }
11474 }
11475
11476 return destinationPath;
11477 }
11478 catch (Exception ex)
11479 {
11480 Debug.WriteLine($"Exception in GenerateProgramAsync: {ex.Message}");
11481 MessageBox.Show(
11482 $"Failed to generate program: {ex.Message}",
11483 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "GenerateProgram") ?? "Generate DMIS Program",
11484 MessageBoxButton.OK,
11485 MessageBoxImage.Error);
11486 return null;
11487 }
11488 }

11497 public static string? GetXMLElementValue(XmlDocument doc, string key)
11498 {
11499 // Check if the document is null
11500 if (doc.DocumentElement == null)
11501 {
11502 return null; // or handle the error appropriately
11503 }
11504
11505 if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(key))
11506 {
11507 return null;
11508 }
11509
11510 try
11511 {
11512 // Use XPath to find the element with the specified key
11513 XmlNode? node = doc.SelectSingleNode($"//{key}");
11514 return node?.Attributes?["Value"]?.Value; // Return the value or an empty string if not found
11515 }
11516 catch (System.Xml.XPath.XPathException)
11517 {
11518 // Invalid key for XPath (e.g. status text containing spaces/special chars)
11519 return null;
11520 }
11521 }
11522
11523 // Method to convert a SecureString to a plain string
11529 private string? SecureStringToString(SecureString secureString)
11530 {
11531 IntPtr unmanagedString = IntPtr.Zero;
11532
11533 try
11534 {
11535 unmanagedString = Marshal.SecureStringToGlobalAllocUnicode(secureString);
11536 return Marshal.PtrToStringUni(unmanagedString);
11537 }
11538 finally
11539 {
11540 Marshal.ZeroFreeGlobalAllocUnicode(unmanagedString);
11541 }
11542 }
11543
11544 // Method to convert a plain string to a SecureString
11550 private SecureString ConvertToSecureString(string plainString)
11551 {
11552 SecureString secureString = new SecureString();
11553
11554 foreach (char c in plainString)
11555 {
11556 secureString.AppendChar(c);
11557 }
11558
11559 secureString.MakeReadOnly();
11560 return secureString;
11561 }

11568 private void PerformManualPicking(System.Drawing.Point mousePos, Entity entity)
11569 {
11570 try
11571 {
11572 Point3D cameraTarget = _designControl.Camera.Target;
11573 Point3D cameraEye = _designControl.Camera.Location;
11574 Vector3D cameraDirection = new Vector3D(
11575 cameraTarget.X - cameraEye.X,
11576 cameraTarget.Y - cameraEye.Y,
11577 cameraTarget.Z - cameraEye.Z);
11578
11579 EyeshotGeometryUtils.NormalizeVector(ref cameraDirection);
11580
11581 Point3D intersectionPoint = Point3D.Origin;
11582 bool foundIntersection = false;
11583
11584 if (entity is Mesh mesh)
11585 {
11586 foundIntersection = EyeshotGeometryUtils.IntersectWithMesh(mesh, cameraEye, cameraDirection, out intersectionPoint);
11587 }
11588 else if (entity is Brep brep)
11589 {
11590 foundIntersection = EyeshotGeometryUtils.IntersectWithBrep(brep, cameraEye, cameraDirection, out intersectionPoint);
11591 }
11592
11593 if (foundIntersection && (intersectionPoint != null) && EyeshotGeometryUtils.IsValidWorldPosition(intersectionPoint))
11594 {
11595 CurrentPointCoords = $"X: {intersectionPoint.X:F3}, Y: {intersectionPoint.Y:F3}, Z: {intersectionPoint.Z:F3}";
11596 if (IsModelEntity(entity))
11597 {
11598 Point3D partOrigin = GetPartOrigin(entity);
11599 CurrentRelativePointCoords = $"X: {(intersectionPoint.X - partOrigin.X):F3}, Y: {(intersectionPoint.Y - partOrigin.Y):F3}, Z: {(intersectionPoint.Z - partOrigin.Z):F3}";
11600 }
11601 }
11602 }
11603 catch (Exception ex)
11604 {
11605 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_ManualPickingError")!, ex.Message);
11606 }
11607 }
11608
11612 private Point3D GetPartOrigin(Entity partEntity)
11613 {
11614 if (partEntity == null) return Point3D.Origin;
11615
11616 Point3D origin = partEntity.BoxMin ?? Point3D.Origin;
11617
11618 if (_designControl == null || _designControl.Entities == null) return origin;
11619
11620 BlockReference? associatedOrigin = null;
11621 double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
11622
11623 string? sourcePath = partEntity.EntityData as string;
11624 bool hasSourcePath = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sourcePath);
11625 string? targetOriginData = hasSourcePath ? $"PART_ORIGIN:{sourcePath}" : null;
11626
11627 foreach (var e in _designControl.Entities)
11628 {
11629 if (e.EntityData is string str && str.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN"))
11630 {
11631 if (hasSourcePath && string.Equals(str, targetOriginData, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
11632 {
11633 if (e is BlockReference specificBr)
11634 {
11635 return specificBr.InsertionPoint;
11636 }
11637 }
11638
11639 if (e is BlockReference br)
11640 {
11641 double dist = br.InsertionPoint.DistanceTo(origin);
11642 if (dist < minDistance)
11643 {
11644 minDistance = dist;
11645 associatedOrigin = br;
11646 }
11647 }
11648 }
11649 }
11650
11651 if (associatedOrigin != null)
11652 {
11653 return associatedOrigin.InsertionPoint;
11654 }
11655
11656 return origin;
11657 }
11658
11662 private bool IsModelEntity(Entity ent)
11663 {
11664 if (ent == null) return false;
11665 if (IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntity(ent)) return false;
11666
11667 if (ent.GetType().Name == "SimulationBlockReference") return false;
11668
11669 // 1. Check for system EntityData identifiers
11670 if (ent.EntityData is string data)
11671 {
11672 if (data == "PART_ORIGIN" ||
11673 data == "SECTION_VISUAL" ||
11674 data == "IgnoredOverlay_Ref" ||
11675 data == "COMPACT_PATH_VISUAL" ||
11676 data.StartsWith("BASE_AVOIDANCE"))
11677 return false;
11678 }
11679 else if (ent.EntityData != null)
11680 {
11681 // If it's an object (like CADHole or CADFace or WaypointData), it's a system marker
11682 return false;
11683 }
11684
11685 // 2. Check for system layers (PathManager and SdfShellGenerator use these)
11686 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ent.LayerName))
11687 {
11688 string layer = ent.LayerName.ToUpper();
11689 if (layer.StartsWith("PATH_") ||
11690 layer.StartsWith("PROBE_") ||
11691 layer.StartsWith("SCANNER_") ||
11692 layer.StartsWith("COLLISION_") ||
11693 layer.StartsWith("RAYCAST_") ||
11694 layer.StartsWith("SHELL_") || // Skip SDF shells
11695 layer.Contains("SIMULATION") ||
11696 layer.Contains("MARKERS"))
11697 return false;
11698 }
11699
11700 // 3. Only process 3D geometric entities that can reasonably contain faces
11701 return ent is Mesh || ent is Brep || ent is Solid || ent is BlockReference;
11702 }

11707 private Dictionary<string, List<CADFace>> GroupFacesByColor(List<CADFace> faces)

11775 private void HandleDesignControlSelectionChanged(object parameter)
11776 {
11777 if (!(_designControl.IsLoaded) || isUpdatingSelection || !(parameter is devDept.Eyeshot.Control.SelectionChangedEventArgs e)) return;
11778
11779 if (_waitingForSectionPartSelection)
11780 {
11781 var candidates = GetSectionCandidateParts();
11782 var selectedPart = candidates.FirstOrDefault(ent => ent.Selected);
11783
11784 // Fallback if the raw entity was not flagged as selected yet, extract from AddedItems wrapper
11785 if (selectedPart == null && e.AddedItems != null && e.AddedItems.Count > 0)
11786 {
11787 var first = e.AddedItems[0];
11788 if (first != null)
11789 {
11790 var firstType = first.GetType();
11791
11792 Entity? rawEnt = (firstType.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(first) as Entity)
11793 ?? (firstType.GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(first) as Entity)
11794 ?? (firstType.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(first) is object inner ?
11795 (inner.GetType().GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(inner) as Entity ?? inner.GetType().GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(inner) as Entity) : null);
11796
11797 // Eyeshot Selection sometimes directly gives Entity
11798 var firstObj = first as object;
11799 if (rawEnt == null && firstObj is Entity eEnt)
11800 rawEnt = eEnt;
11801
11802 if (rawEnt != null && candidates.Contains(rawEnt))
11803 {
11804 selectedPart = rawEnt;
11805 // Do not force rawEnt.Selected = true to preserve face/vertex selection
11806 }
11807 }
11808 }
11809
11810 if (selectedPart != null)
11811 {
11812 _waitingForSectionPartSelection = false;
11813 SectionViewOverlayVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
11814 UpdateSectionPlaneMaxAndPos();
11815 SectionPlanePosition = SectionPlaneMaxPosition;
11816 UpdateSectionPlane();
11817
11818 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0 && _designControl.Viewports[0].ToolBars.Count > 0)
11819 {
11820 var btn = _designControl.Viewports[0].ToolBars[0].Buttons.FirstOrDefault(b => b.Name == "SectionViewMain") as ToolBarButton;
11821 if (btn != null) btn.Pushed = true;
11822 }
11823 }
11824 return;
11825 }
11826
11827 // Check if selection change only involves path entities (waypoints, segments, dragging spheres)
11828 bool onlyPathEntities = true;
11829 if (e != null)
11830 {
11831 if (e.AddedItems != null && e.AddedItems.Count > 0)
11832 {
11833 foreach (var item in e.AddedItems)
11834 {
11835 var ent = GetEntityFromSelectionItem(item);
11836 if (ent == null || !(ent.EntityData is WaypointData || ent.EntityData is PathSegmentData || ent == _draggingSphere || (ent is LinearPath && ent.LayerName != null && ent.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX))))
11837 {
11838 onlyPathEntities = false;
11839 break;
11840 }
11841 }
11842 }
11843 if (onlyPathEntities && e.RemovedItems != null && e.RemovedItems.Count > 0)
11844 {
11845 foreach (var item in e.RemovedItems)
11846 {
11847 var ent = GetEntityFromSelectionItem(item);
11848 if (ent == null || !(ent.EntityData is WaypointData || ent.EntityData is PathSegmentData || ent == _draggingSphere || (ent is LinearPath && ent.LayerName != null && ent.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX))))
11849 {
11850 onlyPathEntities = false;
11851 break;
11852 }
11853 }
11854 }
11855 if (e.AddedItems?.Count == 0 && e.RemovedItems?.Count == 0)
11856 {
11857 onlyPathEntities = true;
11858 }
11859 }
11860 else
11861 {
11862 onlyPathEntities = false;
11863 }
11864
11865 if (onlyPathEntities)
11866 {
11867 if (e?.AddedItems != null && e.AddedItems.Count > 0)
11868 {
11869 var item = e.AddedItems[0];
11870 var ent = GetEntityFromSelectionItem(item);
11871 if (ent != null)
11872 {
11873 if (ent.EntityData is PathSegmentData segmentData && segmentData.Path != null)
11874 {
11875 var segmentEntity = segmentData.Path.SegmentEntities?.FirstOrDefault(s => ReferenceEquals(s.EntityData, segmentData));
11876 if (segmentEntity != null)
11877 _treeViewHelper.SelectPathSegmentInTree(segmentEntity);
11878 }
11879 else if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData waypointData && waypointData.Path != null)
11880 {
11881 if (waypointData.PointIndex >= 0 && waypointData.PointIndex < waypointData.Path.Points.Count)
11882 {
11883 var pt = waypointData.Path.Points[waypointData.PointIndex];
11884 if (pt != null)
11885 _treeViewHelper.SelectPathPointInTree(pt);
11886 }
11887 }
11888 else if (ent is LinearPath pathEntity && pathEntity.LayerName != null && pathEntity.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX))
11889 {
11890 _treeViewHelper.SelectPathSegmentInTree(pathEntity);
11891 }
11892 }
11893 }
11894 return;
11895 }
11896
11897 try
11898 {
11899 isUpdatingSelection = true;
11900 _treeViewHelper.ClearTreeViewSelection();
11901 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers(); // Clear ALL markers when selection changes
11902
11903 if (e?.AddedItems == null || e.AddedItems.Count == 0) return;
11904
11905 // Complex Eyeshot selection details extraction (kept largely as-is due to Eyeshot's API)
11906 var first = e.AddedItems[0];
11907 if (first == null) return;
11908
11909 var firstType = first.GetType();
11910 string firstTypeName = firstType.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
11911
11912 Entity? selEntity = (firstType.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(first) as Entity)
11913 ?? (firstType.GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(first) as Entity)
11914 ?? (firstType.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(first) is object inner ?
11915 (inner.GetType().GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(inner) as Entity ?? inner.GetType().GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(inner) as Entity) : null);
11916
11917 int subIndex = (int?)(firstType.GetProperty("Index")?.GetValue(first)
11918 ?? firstType.GetProperty("FaceIndex")?.GetValue(first)
11919 ?? firstType.GetProperty("VertexIndex")?.GetValue(first)
11920 ?? firstType.GetProperty("SubIndex")?.GetValue(first)) ?? -1;
11921
11922 if (selEntity == null) return;
11923
11924 int entityIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(selEntity);
11925 if (entityIndex < 0) return;
11926
11927 // Flatten all faces for easy lookup
11928 // FIX: Changed from _facesByColor to _allFacesByColor to include hole faces in selection lookup.
11929 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(l => l).ToList();
11930 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = null;
11931
11932 if (firstTypeName.Contains("face") || firstTypeName.Contains("selectedface"))
11933 {
11934 var match = allFaces.FirstOrDefault(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex && f.FaceIndex == subIndex);
11935 if (match != null)
11936 {
11937 _treeViewHelper.SelectFaceInTree(match);
11938 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(match);
11939 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(match);
11940 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = match;
11941
11942 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(match);
11943 if (parentHole != null)
11944 {
11945 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
11946 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(parentHole); // Also select the hole in the tree
11947 }
11948 }
11949 else
11950 {
11951 var fallback = allFaces.FirstOrDefault(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex);
11952 if (fallback != null)
11953 {
11954 _treeViewHelper.SelectFaceInTree(fallback);
11955 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(fallback);
11956 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(fallback);
11957 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = fallback;
11958
11959 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(fallback);
11960 if (parentHole != null)
11961 {
11962 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
11963 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(parentHole);
11964 }
11965 }
11966 }
11967 }
11968 else if (firstTypeName.Contains("vertex") || firstTypeName.Contains("selectedvertex"))
11969 {
11970 if (subIndex >= 0)
11971 {
11972 var facesWithVertex = allFaces.Where(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex && f.KeyPoints.Any(k => k.VertexIndex == subIndex)).ToList();
11973 if (facesWithVertex.Count > 0)
11974 {
11975 var face = facesWithVertex.First();
11976 _treeViewHelper.SelectVertexInTree(face, subIndex);
11977 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(face, highlightVertexIndex: subIndex);
11978 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(face);
11979 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = face;
11980
11981 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(face);
11982 if (parentHole != null)
11983 {
11984 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
11985 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(parentHole);
11986 }
11987 }
11988 else
11989 {
11990 var fallback = allFaces.FirstOrDefault(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex);
11991 if (fallback != null)
11992 {
11993 _treeViewHelper.SelectFaceInTree(fallback);
11994 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(fallback);
11995 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(fallback);
11996 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = fallback;
11997
11998 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(fallback);
11999 if (parentHole != null)
12000 {
12001 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
12002 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(parentHole);
12003 }
12004 }
12005 }
12006 }
12007 }
12008 else // Generic entity selection fallback
12009 {
12010 var firstFaceOfEntity = allFaces.FirstOrDefault(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex);
12011 if (firstFaceOfEntity != null)
12012 {
12013 _treeViewHelper.SelectFaceInTree(firstFaceOfEntity);
12014 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(firstFaceOfEntity);
12015 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(firstFaceOfEntity);
12016 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = firstFaceOfEntity;
12017
12018 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(firstFaceOfEntity);
12019 if (parentHole != null)
12020 {
12021 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
12022 _treeViewHelper.SelectHoleInTree(parentHole);
12023 }
12024 }
12025 }
12026 }
12027 catch (Exception ex)
12028 {
12029 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_SelectionSyncError")!, ex.Message);
12030 }
12031 finally
12032 {
12033 isUpdatingSelection = false;
12034 _designControl.Invalidate();
12035 }
12036 }

12043 private Entity? GetEntityFromSelectionItem(object item)
12044 {
12045 if (item == null) return null;
12046 if (item is Entity ent) return ent;
12047 var type = item.GetType();
12048 Entity? rawEnt = (type.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(item) as Entity)
12049 ?? (type.GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(item) as Entity);
12050 if (rawEnt == null)
12051 {
12052 var itemProp = type.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(item);
12053 if (itemProp != null)
12054 {
12055 rawEnt = itemProp.GetType().GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(itemProp) as Entity
12056 ?? itemProp.GetType().GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(itemProp) as Entity;
12057 }
12058 }
12059 return rawEnt;
12060 }

12062 private Entity? GetBaseAvoidanceVisualEntityAtIndex(int entityIndex)
12063 {
12064 if (_designControl == null || entityIndex < 0 || entityIndex >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
12065 return null;
12066
12067 Entity entity = _designControl.Entities[entityIndex];
12068 return IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntity(entity) ? entity : null;

12071 private Entity? GetBaseAvoidanceVisualEntityUnderMouse(System.Drawing.Point screenPoint)
12072 {
12073 if (_designControl == null)
12074 return null;
12075
12076 Entity? visualEntity = GetBaseAvoidanceVisualEntityAtIndex(_designControl.GetEntityUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint));
12077 if (visualEntity != null)
12078 return visualEntity;
12079
12080 Entity? selectionEntity = GetEntityFromSelectionItem(_designControl.GetItemUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint));
12081 if (IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntity(selectionEntity))
12082 return selectionEntity;
12083
12084 var originalSelectionFilter = _designControl.SelectionFilterMode;
12085 try
12086 {
12087 _designControl.SelectionFilterMode = selectionFilterType.Entity;
12088
12089 visualEntity = GetBaseAvoidanceVisualEntityAtIndex(_designControl.GetEntityUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint));
12090 if (visualEntity != null)
12091 return visualEntity;
12092
12093 selectionEntity = GetEntityFromSelectionItem(_designControl.GetItemUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint));
12094 if (IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntity(selectionEntity))
12095 return selectionEntity;
12096 }
12097 finally
12098 {
12099 _designControl.SelectionFilterMode = originalSelectionFilter;
12100 }
12101
12102 return null;
12103 }
