12111 private void HandleDesignControlMouseDown(object parameter)
12112 {
12113 if (parameter is not System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e) return;
12114
12115 _visualsManager?.ClearZoomHighlights();
12116
12117 if (e.ChangedButton == System.Windows.Input.MouseButton.Left)
12118 {
12119 if (_previewToolEntity != null && !IsPointRotationPanelOpen)
12120 {
12121 HideToolPreview();
12122 }
12123 }
12124
12125 if (_activeContextMenu != null || _justClosedContextMenu)
12126 {
12127 if (_activeContextMenu != null)
12128 {
12129 _activeContextMenu.IsOpen = false;
12130 _activeContextMenu = null;
12131 }
12132 _justClosedContextMenu = false;
12133 e.Handled = true;
12134 return;
12135 }
12136
12137 var screenPoint = new System.Drawing.Point((int)e.GetPosition(_designControl).X, (int)e.GetPosition(_designControl).Y);
12138
12139 // --- Right-Click Handling for Context Menus ---
12140 if (e.RightButton == System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonState.Pressed)
12141 {
12142 // Identify the part right-clicked
12143 _lastRightClickedPart = null;
12144 var rightClickItem = _designControl.GetItemUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint);
12145 if (rightClickItem != null)
12146 {
12147 var rcItemType = rightClickItem.GetType();
12148 Entity? rcEntity = (rcItemType.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(rightClickItem) as Entity)
12149 ?? (rcItemType.GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(rightClickItem) as Entity);
12150 if (rcEntity != null && !IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntity(rcEntity) && (rcEntity is Brep || rcEntity is Mesh))
12151 {
12152 if (rcEntity.LayerName == null || !(
12153 rcEntity.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_") ||
12154 rcEntity.LayerName.Contains("IGNORED") ||
12155 rcEntity.LayerName.StartsWith("PATH_") ||
12156 rcEntity.LayerName.Contains("SIMULATION") ||
12157 rcEntity.LayerName == "MARKERS" ||
12158 rcEntity.LayerName == "COLLISION_MARKERS" ||
12159 rcEntity.LayerName == "RAYCAST_HITS" ||
12160 rcEntity.LayerName == "PROBE_TRACKING" ||
12161 rcEntity.LayerName == "SCANNER_FOV_VISUALIZATION"
12162 ))
12163 {
12164 _lastRightClickedPart = rcEntity;
12165 }
12166 }
12167 }
12168
12169 if (_isCustomDragging)
12170 {
12171 ShowCustomDraggingContextMenu(screenPoint);
12172 e.Handled = true;
12173 return;
12174 }
12175
12176 if (_waitingForSectionPartSelection)
12177 {
12178 DeactivateSectionView();
12179 e.Handled = true;
12180 return;
12181 }
12182
12183 // Priority -1: If manual marking is active, show context menu with "Complete Marking" option
12184 if (_isManualMarkingActive)
12185 {
12186 ShowManualMarkingContextMenu();
12187 e.Handled = true;
12188 return;
12189 }
12190
12191 // Priority 0: If simulation is running, let the default Design ContextMenu handle it
12192 if (_pathManager != null && _pathManager.IsSimulating)
12193 {
12194 return;
12195 }
12196
12197 Entity? baseAvoidanceVisualEntity = GetBaseAvoidanceVisualEntityUnderMouse(screenPoint);
12198 if (baseAvoidanceVisualEntity != null)
12199 {
12200 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
12201 baseAvoidanceVisualEntity.Selected = true;
12202 _designControl.Invalidate();
12203 ShowBaseAvoidancePlaneContextMenu(baseAvoidanceVisualEntity);
12204 e.Handled = true;
12205 return;
12206 }
12207
12208 // Check if clicking on a manual marking sphere - prevent context menu
12209 int entityUnderMouse = _designControl.GetEntityUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint);
12210 if (entityUnderMouse >= 0 && entityUnderMouse < _designControl.Entities.Count)
12211 {
12212 var mouseEntity = _designControl.Entities[entityUnderMouse];
12213 if (_manualMarkingSpheres.Contains(mouseEntity))
12214 {
12215 e.Handled = true;
12216 return; // Don't show context menu for manual marking spheres
12217 }
12218 }
12219
12220 // First, check if a control point sphere, path line or waypoint was clicked.
12221 Entity? clickedEntity = null;
12222 int entityUnderMouseIdx = _designControl.GetEntityUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint);
12223 if (entityUnderMouseIdx >= 0 && entityUnderMouseIdx < _designControl.Entities.Count)
12224 {
12225 clickedEntity = _designControl.Entities[entityUnderMouseIdx];
12226 }
12227
12228 if (clickedEntity != null && IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntity(clickedEntity))
12229 {
12230 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
12231 clickedEntity.Selected = true;
12232 _designControl.Invalidate();
12233 ShowBaseAvoidancePlaneContextMenu(clickedEntity);
12234 e.Handled = true;
12235 return;
12236 }
12237
12238 bool clickedPathOrControlEntity =
12239 clickedEntity?.EntityData is WaypointData ||
12240 (clickedEntity != null && _visualsManager?.ControlPointSpheres.Contains(clickedEntity) == true) ||
12241 (clickedEntity is LinearPath pathEntity &&
12242 pathEntity.LayerName != null &&
12243 pathEntity.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX));
12244
12245 if (!clickedPathOrControlEntity)
12246 {
12247 clickedEntity = null;
12248 }
12249
12250 if (clickedEntity != null)
12251 {
12252
12253 // If the clicked entity is a control point, show the context menu for its parent face.
12254 if (_visualsManager?.ControlPointSpheres.Contains(clickedEntity) == true)
12255 {
12256 var parentFace = _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace;
12257 if (parentFace != null)
12258 {
12259 if (_visualsManager.ControlPointSelectionEnabled)
12260 {
12261 int pointIndex = _visualsManager.ControlPointSpheres.IndexOf(clickedEntity);
12262 var pointsToUse = (parentFace.MeasurementPoints != null && parentFace.MeasurementPoints.Any()) ? parentFace.MeasurementPoints : parentFace.ControlPoints;
12263 if (pointIndex >= 0 && pointIndex < pointsToUse.Count)
12264 _treeViewHelper.NavigateToMeasurementPointInTree(parentFace, pointIndex);
12265 }
12266
12267 // If the face belongs to a hole, show the hole's context menu. Otherwise, show the face's menu.
12268 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(parentFace);
12269 ShowContextMenuFor(parentHole ?? (object)parentFace);
12270 e.Handled = true; // Mark as handled to prevent further processing and Eyeshot's default menu.
12271 return;
12272 }
12273 }
12274
12275 // Waypoint marker (Sphere/Point) right-click for context menu
12276 if (clickedEntity.EntityData is WaypointData wpData)
12277 {
12278 bool isMeasure = wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count && wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex];
12279 bool isScanPoint = wpData.Path.PointTypes != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count && string.Equals(wpData.Path.PointTypes[wpData.PointIndex], "scanpoints", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
12280 if (isMeasure && !isScanPoint)
12281 {
12282 CADFace? parentFace = null;
12283 if (_allFacesByColor != null)
12284 {
12285 var wpPos = wpData.OriginalPosition;
12286 parentFace = _allFacesByColor.Values
12287 .SelectMany(f => f)
12288 .FirstOrDefault(f => f.FaceColor.ToArgb() == wpData.Path.Color.ToArgb() &&
12289 f.MeasurementPoints != null &&
12290 f.MeasurementPoints.Any(mp => Point3D.Distance(new Point3D(mp.X, mp.Y, mp.Z), wpPos) < 1.0));
12291 }
12292 if (parentFace != null)
12293 {
12294 _treeViewHelper.NavigateToMeasurementPointInTree(parentFace, wpData.PointIndex);
12295 }
12296 }
12297
12298 // Select the clicked entity in the viewport
12299 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
12300 clickedEntity.Selected = true;
12301 _designControl.Invalidate();
12302
12303 ShowContextMenuForWaypoint(clickedEntity, wpData);
12304
12305 // Sync path TreeView to this point
12306 if (wpData.Path != null && wpData.PointIndex >= 0 && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.Points.Count)
12307 {
12308 var pt = wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex];
12309 if (pt != null)
12310 _treeViewHelper.SelectPathPointInTree(pt);
12311 }
12312 e.Handled = true;
12313 return;
12314 }
12315
12316 if (clickedEntity is LinearPath pathLine && pathLine.LayerName != null && pathLine.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX))
12317 {
12318 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
12319 pathLine.Selected = true;
12320 _designControl.Invalidate();
12321
12322 // Sync path TreeView to this segment
12323 _treeViewHelper.SelectPathSegmentInTree(pathLine);
12324
12325 _rightClickScreenPoint = screenPoint;
12326 var contextMenu = new System.Windows.Controls.ContextMenu();
12327 var createIntermediaryPointItem = new System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem
12328 {
12329 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_CreateIntermediaryPoint") ?? "Create Intermediary Point",
12330 Icon = new System.Windows.Controls.TextBlock { Text = "⌖", FontSize = 17, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center }
12331 };
12332 contextMenu.PlacementTarget = _designControl;
12333 contextMenu.Placement = System.Windows.Controls.Primitives.PlacementMode.MousePoint;
12334
12335 createIntermediaryPointItem.Click += (s, args) =>
12336 {
12337 if (_pathManager == null) return;
12338 var projResult = _pathManager.GetPathLineProjectionPoint(pathLine, _rightClickScreenPoint, _designControl);
12339 if (projResult.path != null && projResult.projectionPoint != null)
12340 {
12341 var colorPath = projResult.path;
12342 var pos = projResult.projectionPoint;
12343 _tempInsertPath = colorPath;
12344 _tempInsertIndex = projResult.insertIndex;
12345 _tempInsertPosition = pos;
12346 _isCreatingIntermediaryPoint = true;
12347
12348 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = colorPath.CloneState();
12349 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = new List<(ColorPath Path, ColorPath OldState)>();
12350
12351 // Find overlapping bridges
12352 Point3D p1 = colorPath.Points[_tempInsertIndex - 1];
12353 Point3D p2 = colorPath.Points[_tempInsertIndex];
12354 if (colorPath.PointTypes != null && colorPath.PointTypes[_tempInsertIndex - 1] == "Bridge" && (_tempInsertIndex < colorPath.PointTypes.Count && colorPath.PointTypes[_tempInsertIndex] == "Bridge"))
12355 {
12356 if (_pathManager.ColorPaths != null)
12357 {
12358 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
12359 {
12360 var otherPath = kvp.Value;
12361 if (otherPath == colorPath) continue;
12362
12363 for (int i = 0; i < otherPath.Points.Count - 1; i++)
12364 {
12365 if (otherPath.PointTypes != null && otherPath.PointTypes[i] == "Bridge" && otherPath.PointTypes[i + 1] == "Bridge")
12366 {
12367 if ((otherPath.Points[i].DistanceTo(p1) < 1e-4 && otherPath.Points[i + 1].DistanceTo(p2) < 1e-4) ||
12368 (otherPath.Points[i].DistanceTo(p2) < 1e-4 && otherPath.Points[i + 1].DistanceTo(p1) < 1e-4))
12369 {
12370 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Add((otherPath, otherPath.CloneState()));
12371
12372 break;
12373 }
12374 }
12375 }
12376 }
12377 }
12378 }

12380 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
12381 pathLine.Selected = false;
12382 if (pathLine.EntityData is PathSegmentData psd &&
12383 psd.Path?.PointTypes != null &&
12384 psd.StartIndex < psd.Path.PointTypes.Count &&
12385 psd.EndIndex < psd.Path.PointTypes.Count &&
12386 psd.Path.PointTypes[psd.StartIndex] == "Bridge" &&
12387 psd.Path.PointTypes[psd.EndIndex] == "Bridge")
12388 {
12389 _designControl.Entities.Remove(pathLine);
12390 }
12391
12392 // Create temporary dragging sphere
12393 _draggingSphere = devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Mesh.CreateSphere(0.45, 8, 8);
12394 _draggingSphere.Color = System.Drawing.Color.LimeGreen;
12395 _draggingSphere.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
12396 _draggingSphere.Translate(pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z);
12397 _draggingSphere.Selected = true;
12398 _designControl.Entities.Add(_draggingSphere);
12399 _draggingSpherePosition = (Point3D)pos.Clone();
12400 _manipulatingEntity = _draggingSphere;
12401
12402 _initialTriadTrans = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateTranslation(pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z);
12403 var triadTrans = _initialTriadTrans;
12404
12405 _isCustomDragging = false;
12406 _draggingMeasurePointFace = null;
12407 _draggingMeasurePointBrep = null;
12408
12409 _designControl.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(() =>
12410 {
12411 ConfigureWaypointManipulator(false);
12412 _designControl.Invalidate();
12413 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Enable(_initialTriadTrans, false);
12414 _designControl.Invalidate();
12415 ConfigureWaypointManipulator(false);
12416
12417
12418 }), System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Background);
12419 }
12420 };
12421 contextMenu.Items.Add(createIntermediaryPointItem);
12422
12423 if (pathLine.EntityData is PathSegmentData segmentData)
12424 {
12425 var zoomToPathSegmentItem = new System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem
12426 {
12427 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ZoomToPathSegment") ?? "Zoom To Path",
12428 Command = ZoomToPathSegmentCommand,
12429 CommandParameter = pathLine,
12430 Icon = new System.Windows.Controls.TextBlock { Text = "🔍", FontSize = 12, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center },
12431 ToolTip = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_ZoomToPathSegment_ToolTip") ?? "Zoom the view to this generated path segment."
12432 };
12433 contextMenu.Items.Add(zoomToPathSegmentItem);
12434
12435 var checkSegmentCollisionItem = new System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem
12436 {
12437 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_CheckThisPathSegmentCollision") ?? "Check Segment Collisions for this segment",
12438 Command = CheckPathSegmentCollisionCommand,
12439 CommandParameter = segmentData,
12440 Icon = new System.Windows.Controls.TextBlock { Text = "⚠", FontSize = 12, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center },
12441 ToolTip = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_CheckThisPathSegmentCollision_ToolTip") ?? "Run segment collision validation only for this path segment."
12442 };
12443 contextMenu.Items.Add(checkSegmentCollisionItem);
12444 }
12445
12446 // Find the first main part entity in the design to add generic menus below
12447 Entity? partEntity = _designControl.Entities.FirstOrDefault(ent => (ent is Brep || ent is Mesh) &&
12448 (ent.LayerName == null || !(
12449 ent.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_") ||
12450 ent.LayerName.Contains("IGNORED") ||
12451 ent.LayerName.StartsWith("PATH_") ||
12452 ent.LayerName.Contains("SIMULATION") ||
12453 ent.LayerName == "MARKERS" ||
12454 ent.LayerName == "COLLISION_MARKERS" ||
12455 ent.LayerName == "RAYCAST_HITS" ||
12456 ent.LayerName == "PROBE_TRACKING" ||
12457 ent.LayerName == "SCANNER_FOV_VISUALIZATION"
12458 )));
12459
12460 if (partEntity != null)
12461 {
12462 contextMenu.Items.Add(new Separator());
12463 AddManipulateAndMoveMenuItems(contextMenu, partEntity);
12464 }
12465
12466 RegisterAndOpenContextMenu(contextMenu);
12467 e.Handled = true;
12468 return;
12469 }
12470 }
12471
12472 // If a special item wasn't clicked, proceed to identify other item types like faces or vertices.
12473 var selItem = _designControl.GetItemUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint);
12474 if (selItem == null)
12475 {
12476 e.Handled = true;
12477 return;
12478 }
12479
12480 // Use reflection to robustly get the underlying Entity from the wrapped selection object.
12481 var itemType = selItem.GetType();
12482 Entity? selEntity = (itemType.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(selItem) as Entity)
12483 ?? (itemType.GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(selItem) as Entity);
12484
12485 if (selEntity == null) return;
12486
12487 if (IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntity(selEntity))
12488 {
12489 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
12490 selEntity.Selected = true;
12491 _designControl.Invalidate();
12492 ShowBaseAvoidancePlaneContextMenu(selEntity);
12493 e.Handled = true;
12494 return;
12495 }
12496
12497 // Robustly extract the sub-item index (e.g., face index or vertex index).
12498 int subIndex = (int?)(itemType.GetProperty("Index")?.GetValue(selItem)
12499 ?? itemType.GetProperty("FaceIndex")?.GetValue(selItem)
12500 ?? itemType.GetProperty("VertexIndex")?.GetValue(selItem)) ?? -1;
12501
12502 if (subIndex < 0) return;
12503
12504 // Find the entity's index in the main design control's entity collection.
12505 int entityIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(selEntity);
12506 if (entityIndex < 0) return;
12507
12508 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(l => l).ToList();
12509 string itemTypeName = itemType.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
12510
12511 // Priority 1: Check if a VERTEX was clicked.
12512 if (itemTypeName.Contains("vertex") && subIndex >= 0)
12513 {
12514 // Find the specific FacePoint object corresponding to the clicked vertex.
12515 var clickedVertex = allFaces.Where(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex)
12516 .SelectMany(f => f.KeyPoints)
12517 .FirstOrDefault(p => p.VertexIndex == subIndex);
12518
12519 if (clickedVertex != null)
12520 {
12521 ShowContextMenuFor(clickedVertex);
12522 }
12523 }
12524 // Priority 2: If not a vertex, check if a FACE was clicked.
12525 else if (itemTypeName.Contains("face") && subIndex >= 0)
12526 {
12527 // Find the CADFace object corresponding to the clicked face.
12528 var clickedFace = allFaces.FirstOrDefault(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex && f.FaceIndex == subIndex);
12529 if (clickedFace != null)
12530 {
12531 // Determine if the face is part of a larger feature like a hole.
12532 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(clickedFace);
12533 // Show the context menu for the hole if it exists; otherwise, for the face itself.
12534 ShowContextMenuFor(parentHole ?? (object)clickedFace);
12535 }
12536 else
12537 {
12538 ShowContextMenuFor(selEntity);
12539 }
12540 }
12541 else
12542 {
12543 // Unextracted face or generic entity click
12544 ShowContextMenuFor(selEntity);
12545 }
12546
12547 e.Handled = true; // Prevent Eyeshot's default context menu from appearing.
12548 return;
12549 }
12550
12551 // --- Left-Click Handling for Selection and Manual Marking ---
12552 try
12553 {
12554 if (_isCustomDragging && e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
12555 {
12556 Point3D worldPos = _designControl.ScreenToWorld(screenPoint);
12557 Point3D? clickedPt = null;
12558 if (_draggingFaceMesh != null)
12559 {
12560 Point3D rayStart;
12561 Vector3D rayDir;
12562 if (_designControl.Camera.ProjectionMode == devDept.Eyeshot.projectionType.Perspective)
12563 {
12564 rayStart = _designControl.Camera.Location;
12565 rayDir = new Vector3D(rayStart, worldPos);
12566 rayDir.Normalize();
12567 }
12568 else
12569 {
12570 rayDir = new Vector3D(
12571 _designControl.Camera.Target.X - _designControl.Camera.Location.X,
12572 _designControl.Camera.Target.Y - _designControl.Camera.Location.Y,
12573 _designControl.Camera.Target.Z - _designControl.Camera.Location.Z);
12574 rayDir.Normalize();
12575 rayStart = worldPos - rayDir * 100000.0;
12576 }
12577 Point3D intersectPt;
12578 if (EyeshotGeometryUtils.IntersectWithMesh(_draggingFaceMesh, rayStart, rayDir, out intersectPt))
12579 {
12580 clickedPt = intersectPt;
12581 }
12582 else
12583 {
12584 clickedPt = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToMesh(worldPos, _draggingFaceMesh);
12585 }
12586 }
12587 else if (_draggingMeasurePointBrep != null && _draggingMeasurePointFace != null)
12588 {
12589 clickedPt = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(worldPos, _draggingMeasurePointBrep, _draggingMeasurePointFace.FaceIndex);
12590 }
12591 else
12592 {
12593 Entity? targetPart;
12594 Vector3D newNormal;
12595 clickedPt = SnapToClosestPartSurface(worldPos, out newNormal, out targetPart);
12596 }
12597
12598 if (clickedPt != null)
12599 {
12600 if (_draggingSphere != null && _draggingSpherePosition != null)
12601 {
12602 Vector3D sphereTrans = new Vector3D(_draggingSpherePosition, clickedPt);
12603 _draggingSphere.Translate(sphereTrans);
12604 _draggingSpherePosition = (Point3D)clickedPt.Clone();
12605 _designControl.Invalidate();
12606 }
12607
12608 if (_manipulatingEntity != null && _manipulatingEntity.EntityData is WaypointData dragWp)
12609 {
12610 ApplySharedWaypointPosition(dragWp, clickedPt);
12611 }
12612
12613 _designControl.CaptureMouse();
12614 }
12615 e.Handled = true;
12616 return;
12617 }
12618
12619 // Left-click on a waypoint: only select or navigate, do not trigger movements immediately
12620 // Removed LeftClick waypoint navigation to avoid issues clicking on parts
12621
12622 if (_waitingForSectionPartSelection && e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
12623 {
12624 int entityIndex = _designControl.GetEntityUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint);
12625 if (entityIndex >= 0 && entityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
12626 {
12627 var candidateEnt = _designControl.Entities[entityIndex];
12628 var candidates = GetSectionCandidateParts();
12629
12630 if (candidates.Contains(candidateEnt))
12631 {
12632 _waitingForSectionPartSelection = false;
12633
12634 // _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
12635 // candidateEnt.Selected = true;
12636
12637 SectionViewOverlayVisibility = Visibility.Visible;
12638 UpdateSectionPlaneMaxAndPos();
12639 SectionPlanePosition = SectionPlaneMaxPosition;
12640 UpdateSectionPlane();
12641
12642 // Fix visual state of button
12643 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0 && _designControl.Viewports[0].ToolBars.Count > 0)
12644 {
12645 var btn = _designControl.Viewports[0].ToolBars[0].Buttons.FirstOrDefault(b => b.Name == "SectionViewMain") as ToolBarButton;
12646 if (btn != null) btn.Pushed = true;
12647 }
12648
12649 e.Handled = true;
12650 return;
12651 }
12652 }
12653 }
12654
12655 // Priority: If manual marking is active, add point on left-click
12656 if (_isManualMarkingActive && e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
12657 {
12658 Point3D? worldPoint = _designControl.ScreenToWorld(screenPoint);
12659 if (worldPoint != null && EyeshotGeometryUtils.IsValidWorldPosition(worldPoint))
12660 {
12661 // Verify the point is on the correct face/hole
12662 var clickedItem = _designControl.GetItemUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint);
12663 if (clickedItem != null)
12664 {
12665 var itemType = clickedItem.GetType();
12666 Entity? selEntity = (itemType.GetProperty("Item")?.GetValue(clickedItem) as Entity)
12667 ?? (itemType.GetProperty("Entity")?.GetValue(clickedItem) as Entity);
12668
12669 if (selEntity != null)
12670 {
12671 int entityIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(selEntity);
12672 int faceIndex = (int?)(itemType.GetProperty("Index")?.GetValue(clickedItem)
12673 ?? itemType.GetProperty("FaceIndex")?.GetValue(clickedItem)) ?? -1;
12674
12675 bool isCorrectFace = false;
12676
12677 if (_faceBeingMarkedManually != null)
12678 {
12679 isCorrectFace = (_faceBeingMarkedManually.EntityIndex == entityIndex &&
12680 _faceBeingMarkedManually.FaceIndex == faceIndex);
12681 }
12682 else if (_holeBeingMarkedManually != null)
12683 {
12684 var allFaces = _allFacesByColor?.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList() ?? new List<CADFace>();
12685 var clickedFace = allFaces.FirstOrDefault(f => f.EntityIndex == entityIndex && f.FaceIndex == faceIndex);
12686 if (clickedFace != null)
12687 {
12688 isCorrectFace = _holeBeingMarkedManually.FaceGlobalIndices.Contains(clickedFace.FaceGlobalIndex);
12689 }
12690 }
12691
12692 if (isCorrectFace)
12693 {
12694 AddManualMeasurementPoint(worldPoint);
12695 e.Handled = true;
12696 return;
12697 }
12698 }
12699 }
12700 }
12701 e.Handled = true;
12702 return;
12703 }
12704
12705 // If the click was not a right-click, handle standard selection logic.
12706 int idx = _designControl.GetEntityUnderMouseCursor(screenPoint);
12707
12708 // If the user clicks on empty space, clear all selections.
12709 if (idx < 0)
12710 {
12711 // Do not deselect if the middle mouse button was used (typically for camera rotation).
12712 if (e.ChangedButton != System.Windows.Input.MouseButton.Middle)
12713 {
12714 _visualsManager?.ClearAllMarkers();
12715 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
12716 _treeViewHelper.ClearTreeViewSelection();
12717 }
12718 return;
12719 }
12720
12721 if (idx >= _designControl.Entities.Count) return;
12722
12723 var ent = _designControl.Entities[idx];
12724
12725 // First, a face is selected, and its measurement points are shown.
12726 // ControlPointSpheres left-click navigation was moved to right-click.
12727 }
12728 catch (Exception ex)
12729 {
12730 EyeshotStatus_Text = $"Error during manual picking: {ex.Message}";
12731 }
12732 }

12738 private void HandleDesignControlMouseMove(object parameter)
12739 {
12740 if (!(parameter is MouseEventArgs e)) return;
12741
12742 try
12743 {
12744 CurrentPointCoords = string.Empty;
12745 CurrentRelativePointCoords = string.Empty;
12746
12747 System.Drawing.Point mousePos = new System.Drawing.Point((int)e.GetPosition(_designControl).X, (int)e.GetPosition(_designControl).Y);
12748 Point3D worldPos = _designControl.ScreenToWorld(mousePos);
12749
12750 if (_isCustomDragging && _manipulatingEntity != null && _manipulatingEntity.EntityData is WaypointData wpData && worldPos != null)
12751 {
12752 // Project the point onto the face surface
12753 Point3D? snappedPt = null;
12754 if (_draggingMeasurePointBrep != null && _draggingMeasurePointFace != null)
12755 {
12756 if (_draggingFaceMesh != null)
12757 {
12758 Point3D rayStart;
12759 Vector3D rayDir;
12760 if (_designControl.Camera.ProjectionMode == devDept.Eyeshot.projectionType.Perspective)
12761 {
12762 rayStart = _designControl.Camera.Location;
12763 rayDir = new Vector3D(rayStart, worldPos);
12764 rayDir.Normalize();
12765 }
12766 else
12767 {
12768 rayDir = new Vector3D(
12769 _designControl.Camera.Target.X - _designControl.Camera.Location.X,
12770 _designControl.Camera.Target.Y - _designControl.Camera.Location.Y,
12771 _designControl.Camera.Target.Z - _designControl.Camera.Location.Z);
12772 rayDir.Normalize();
12773 rayStart = worldPos - rayDir * 100000.0;
12774 }
12775 Point3D intersectPt;
12776 if (EyeshotGeometryUtils.IntersectWithMesh(_draggingFaceMesh, rayStart, rayDir, out intersectPt))
12777 {
12778 snappedPt = intersectPt;
12779 }
12780 else
12781 {
12782 snappedPt = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToMesh(worldPos, _draggingFaceMesh);
12783 }
12784 }
12785 else
12786 {
12787 snappedPt = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(worldPos, _draggingMeasurePointBrep, _draggingMeasurePointFace.FaceIndex);
12788 }
12789 }
12790 else
12791 {
12792 // Fallback to snapping to closest part surface
12793 Entity? targetPart;
12794 Vector3D newNormal;
12795 snappedPt = SnapToClosestPartSurface(worldPos, out newNormal, out targetPart);
12796 }
12797
12798 if (_draggingSphere != null && _draggingSpherePosition != null && snappedPt != null)
12799 {
12800 Vector3D sphereTrans = new Vector3D(_draggingSpherePosition, snappedPt);
12801 _draggingSphere.Translate(sphereTrans);
12802 _draggingSpherePosition = (Point3D)snappedPt.Clone();
12803
12804 ApplySharedWaypointPosition(wpData, snappedPt);
12805 }
12806
12807 _designControl.Invalidate();
12808 }
12809 else if (_designControl != null && _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible && _manipulatingEntity != null && _manipulatingEntity.EntityData is WaypointData dragWp && !_isCustomDragging)
12810 {
12811 var trans = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Transformation;
12812 if (trans == null)
12813 {
12814 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
12815 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
12816 _designControl.Invalidate();
12817 _manipulatingEntity = null;
12818 return;
12819 }
12820 if (trans != null && _initialTriadTrans != null)
12821 {
12822 Point3D currentPt = (Point3D)dragWp.OriginalPosition.Clone();
12823 currentPt.TransformBy(trans);
12824 currentPt = ConstrainSharedWaypointPosition(dragWp, currentPt);
12825
12826 // If it's an approach point, project/constrain it along the normal of the associated measure point
12827 bool isApproach = false;
12828 int mIdx = -1;
12829 if (dragWp.Path.IsMeasure != null)
12830 {
12831 if (dragWp.PointIndex + 1 < dragWp.Path.Points.Count && dragWp.Path.IsMeasure[dragWp.PointIndex + 1])
12832 {
12833 isApproach = true;
12834 mIdx = dragWp.PointIndex + 1;
12835 }
12836 else if (dragWp.PointIndex > 0 && dragWp.Path.IsMeasure[dragWp.PointIndex - 1])
12837 {
12838 isApproach = true;
12839 mIdx = dragWp.PointIndex - 1;
12840 }
12841 }
12842
12843 if (isApproach && mIdx != -1)
12844 {
12845 Point3D measurePt = dragWp.Path.Points[mIdx];
12846 Vector3D normal = dragWp.Path.Normals[mIdx];
12847 if (normal.LengthSquared < 1e-6) normal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
12848 normal.Normalize();
12849
12850 double t = Vector3D.Dot(new Vector3D(measurePt, currentPt), normal);
12851 t = Math.Max(0.0, t); // Cannot go below the surface (inside the part)
12852 currentPt = measurePt + normal * t;
12853 }
12854
12855 ApplySharedWaypointPosition(dragWp, currentPt);
12856
12857 _designControl.Invalidate();
12858 }
12859 }
12860
12861 int entityIndex = _designControl!.GetEntityUnderMouseCursor(mousePos);
12862
12863 if (entityIndex >= 0 && entityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
12864 {
12865 if ((worldPos != null) && EyeshotGeometryUtils.IsValidWorldPosition(worldPos))
12866 {
12867 CurrentPointCoords = $"X: {worldPos.X:F3}, Y: {worldPos.Y:F3}, Z: {worldPos.Z:F3}";
12868 Entity hoveredEntity = _designControl.Entities[entityIndex];
12869 if (IsModelEntity(hoveredEntity))
12870 {
12871 Point3D partOrigin = GetPartOrigin(hoveredEntity);
12872 CurrentRelativePointCoords = $"X: {(worldPos.X - partOrigin.X):F3}, Y: {(worldPos.Y - partOrigin.Y):F3}, Z: {(worldPos.Z - partOrigin.Z):F3}";
12873 }
12874 }
12875 else
12876 {
12877 PerformManualPicking(mousePos, _designControl.Entities[entityIndex]);
12878 }
12879 }
12880 else
12881 {
12882 if ((worldPos != null) && EyeshotGeometryUtils.IsValidWorldPosition(worldPos))
12883 {
12884 CurrentPointCoords = $"X: {worldPos.X:F3}, Y: {worldPos.Y:F3}, Z: {worldPos.Z:F3}";
12885 }
12886 }
12887 }
12888 catch { /* Suppressing common mouse move errors for smoother experience */ }
12889 }

12899 private void HandleTreeViewSelectedItemChanged(object? selectedItem)
12900 {
12901 if (isUpdatingSelection || selectedItem == null) return;
12902
12903 try
12904 {
12905 isUpdatingSelection = true;
12906 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
12907
12908 _designControl.SelectionFilterMode = selectionFilterType.Face | selectionFilterType.Vertex;
12909 _designControl.ActionMode = actionType.SelectVisibleByPickDynamic;
12910
12911 // Caso: nó de cor ou grupo (sem Tag)
12912 if (selectedItem is TreeViewItem tvi && tvi.Tag == null)
12913 {
12914 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
12915 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
12916 _designControl.Invalidate();
12917 return;
12918 }
12919
12920 // Caso: Face selecionada
12921 if (selectedItem is TreeViewItem faceTvi && faceTvi.Tag is CADFace cadFace)
12922 {
12923 if (cadFace.EntityIndex < 0 || cadFace.EntityIndex >= _designControl.Entities.Count)
12924 {
12925 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_InvalidEntityIndexFace");
12926 return;
12927 }
12928 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
12929 var entObj = _designControl.Entities[cadFace.EntityIndex];
12930 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(cadFace);
12931 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(cadFace);
12932 _visualsManager.HighlightFaceVisualFallback(entObj as Brep, cadFace.FaceIndex);
12933 _designControl.Invalidate();
12934 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_FaceHighlightApplied");
12935 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = cadFace;
12936
12937 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(cadFace);
12938 if (parentHole != null)
12939 {
12940 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
12941 }
12942 return;
12943 }
12944
12945 // Caso: Vértice selecionado
12946 if (selectedItem is TreeViewItem vertexTvi && vertexTvi.Tag is FacePoint fp)
12947 {
12948 CADFace? parentFace = FindParentFaceForVertex(vertexTvi) ?? FindParentFaceForVertexPoint(fp);
12949 if (parentFace != null && parentFace.EntityIndex >= 0 && parentFace.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
12950 {
12951 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
12952 var entObj = _designControl.Entities[parentFace.EntityIndex];
12953 if (fp.VertexIndex >= 0 && entObj is Brep brepForVertex)
12954 {
12955 try
12956 {
12957 var t = brepForVertex.GetType();
12958 var setVertex = t.GetMethod("SetVertexSelection", new Type[] { typeof(int), typeof(bool) })
12959 ?? t.GetMethod("SetVertexSelection", new Type[] { typeof(int) });
12960
12961 if (setVertex != null)
12962 {
12963 try
12964 {
12965 setVertex.Invoke(brepForVertex, new object[] { fp.VertexIndex, true });
12966 }
12967 catch
12968 {
12969 setVertex.Invoke(brepForVertex, new object[] { fp.VertexIndex });
12970 }
12971 }
12972 }
12973 catch { /* ignore */ }
12974 }
12975 _visualsManager.ShowCornerMarkersForFace(parentFace, highlightVertexIndex: fp.VertexIndex);
12976 _visualsManager.ShowControlPointsForFace(parentFace);
12977 _visualsManager.ShowZoomVertexHighlight(new devDept.Geometry.Point3D(fp.X, fp.Y, fp.Z), cubeSize: EyeshotVisualsManager.PreviewVertexCubeSize);
12978 _selectionUtils.TryRefreshDesignControlSelection();
12979 _designControl.Invalidate();
12980 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace = parentFace;
12981
12982 var parentHole = FindParentHoleForFace(parentFace);
12983 if (parentHole != null)
12984 {
12985 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(parentHole);
12986 }
12987 }
12988 else
12989 {
12990 _visualsManager.ShowZoomVertexHighlight(new devDept.Geometry.Point3D(fp.X, fp.Y, fp.Z), cubeSize: EyeshotVisualsManager.PreviewVertexCubeSize);
12991 _designControl.Invalidate();
12992 }
12993 return;
12994 }
12995
12996 // Caso: Ponto de controle selecionado
12997 if (selectedItem is TreeViewItem cpTvi && cpTvi.Tag is Point4D controlPoint)
12998 {
12999 _visualsManager.ShowTemporaryControlPointSphere(controlPoint);
13000 _designControl.Invalidate();
13001 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HighlightingControlPoint")!, controlPoint.X, controlPoint.Y, controlPoint.Z);
13002 return;
13003 }
13004
13005 // Caso: Furo selecionado
13006 if (selectedItem is TreeViewItem holeTvi && holeTvi.Tag is CADHole cadHole)
13007 {
13008 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
13009 _visualsManager.ShowHoleCenterAndDepth(cadHole);
13010 _designControl.Invalidate();
13011 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_HighlightingHole")!, cadHole.HoleId);
13012 return;
13013 }
13014
13015 // Default: limpa seleção
13016 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
13017 _visualsManager.ClearAllMarkers();
13018 _designControl.Invalidate();
13019 }
13020 catch (Exception ex)
13021 {
13022 EyeshotStatus_Text = string.Format(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Eyeshot_TreeViewSelectionError")!, ex.Message);
13023 }
13024 finally
13025 {
13026 isUpdatingSelection = false;
13027 }
13028 }

13036 private CADFace? FindParentFaceForVertex(TreeViewItem vertexTvi)
13037 {
13038 if (vertexTvi == null) return null;
13039
13040 // Assuming parent is a "Vertices" header, and its parent is the CADFace
13041 if (vertexTvi.Parent is TreeViewItem keyPointsHeader)
13042 {
13043 string headerText = keyPointsHeader.Header?.ToString() ?? "";
13044 string localizedVertices = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "TreeView_Vertices") ?? "Vertices";
13045
13046 if (headerText.StartsWith("Vertices", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13047 headerText.StartsWith("Vértices", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13048 headerText.Contains(localizedVertices, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13049 headerText.Contains("Vertic", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
13050 {
13051 if (keyPointsHeader.Parent is TreeViewItem faceTvi && faceTvi.Tag is CADFace cadFace)
13052 {
13053 return cadFace;
13054 }
13055 }
13056 }
13057 return null;
13058 }

13099 };

13104
13105 var alignTriadItem = new MenuItem
13106 {
13107 Header = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_AlignTriadWithGrid") ?? "Align triad with origin grid",
13108 Command = AlignTriadWithOriginGridCommand,
13109 CommandParameter = item,
13110 Icon = new TextBlock { Text = "📐", FontSize = 11, Padding = new Thickness(2, 0, 0, 0) },
13111 ToolTip = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_AlignTriadWithGrid_ToolTip") ?? "Aligns the triad axes with the part bounding box grid sides."
13112 };

13116 contextMenu.Items.Add(new Separator());
13117
13118 // Find if this entity is being manipulated
13119 bool isManipulating = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible && _isPartManipulating;
13120 bool hasStoredPosition = false;
13121 if (_originalPositions.TryGetValue(partEntity, out var originalData) && originalData.Entities.Count > 0)
13122 {
13123 var trans = originalData.Entities[0].trans;
13124 if (trans != null)
13125 {
13126 // Check if trans is not Identity
13127 bool isIdentity = true;
13128 for (int row = 0; row < 4; row++)
13129 {
13130 for (int col = 0; col < 4; col++)
13131 {
13132 double expected = (row == col) ? 1.0 : 0.0;
13133 if (Math.Abs(trans[row, col] - expected) > 1e-6)
13134 {
13135 isIdentity = false;
13136 break;
13137 }
13138 }
13139 if (!isIdentity) break;
13140 }
13141 if (!isIdentity)
13142 {
13143 hasStoredPosition = true;
13144 }
13145 }
13146 }

13148 if (isManipulating)

13212 };

13308 {

13317 private void CleanUpOverlappingOriginGrids()
13318 {
13319 if (_designControl == null || _designControl.Viewports.Count == 0) return;
13320
13321 var gridsToRemove = _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids
13322 .Skip(1) // Skip main grid
13323 .Where(g => g != null &&
13324 Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.X) < 1.0 &&
13325 Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.Y) < 1.0 &&
13326 Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.Z) < 1.0)
13327 .ToList();
13328
13329 foreach (var g in gridsToRemove)
13330 {
13331 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Remove(g);
13332 }
13333
13334 // Remove orphan origin grids whose origin doesn't match any active PART_ORIGIN entity
13335 var partOrigins = _designControl.Entities
13336 .OfType<BlockReference>()
13337 .Where(e => e.EntityData is string tag && tag.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
13338 .ToList();
13339
13340 var orphanGrids = _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids
13341 .Skip(1)
13342 .Where(g => g != null && !partOrigins.Any(po => po.InsertionPoint.DistanceTo(g.Plane.Origin) < 1.0))
13343 .ToList();
13344
13345 foreach (var og in orphanGrids)
13346 {
13347 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Remove(og);
13348 }
13349 }

13381 private void AddCmmBoundingBoxVisuals()
13382 {
13383 if (_designControl == null || !IsCmmBoundingBoxEnabled) return;
13384
13385 RemoveCmmBoundingBoxVisuals();
13386 EnsureCmmBoundingBoxLayerExists();
13387
13388 double halfX = CmmBoundingBoxSizeX / 2.0;
13389 double halfY = CmmBoundingBoxSizeY / 2.0;
13390 double cmmZ = CmmBoundingBoxSizeZ;
13391
13392 Point3D p0 = new Point3D(-halfX, -halfY, 0);
13393 Point3D p1 = new Point3D(halfX, -halfY, 0);
13394 Point3D p2 = new Point3D(halfX, halfY, 0);
13395 Point3D p3 = new Point3D(-halfX, halfY, 0);
13396 Point3D p4 = new Point3D(-halfX, -halfY, cmmZ);
13397 Point3D p5 = new Point3D(halfX, -halfY, cmmZ);
13398 Point3D p6 = new Point3D(halfX, halfY, cmmZ);
13399 Point3D p7 = new Point3D(-halfX, halfY, cmmZ);
13400
13401 var points = new Point3D[]
13402 {
13403 p0, p1, p2, p3, p0,
13404 p4, p5, p6, p7, p4,
13405 p5, p1,
13406 p2, p6,
13407 p7, p3
13408 };
13409
13410 var boxLinePath = new devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.LinearPath(points)
13411 {
13412 Color = System.Drawing.Color.Black,
13413 ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity,
13414 LineWeight = 2,
13415 LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity,
13416 LayerName = CmmBoundingBoxLayerName,
13417 EntityData = CmmBoundingBoxTag,
13418 Selectable = false,
13419 Visible = _showCmmBoundingBox
13420 };
13421
13422 _designControl.Entities.Add(boxLinePath);
13423 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
13424 _designControl.Invalidate();
13425 }

13441 public ICommand ToggleOriginGridsCommand => toggleOriginGridsCommand ??= new DelegateCommand(() =>
13442 {
13443 showOriginGrids = !showOriginGrids;
13444 OnPropertyChanged(nameof(OriginGridVisibilityMenuText));
13445 if (_designControl != null && _designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
13446 {
13447 if (showOriginGrids)
13448 {
13449 // Remove existing grids (except main grid)
13450 ClearOriginGrids();
13451
13452 // Remove existing PART_ORIGIN entities
13453 var oldOrigins = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.EntityData as string != null && (e.EntityData as string)!.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN")).ToList();
13454 foreach (var o in oldOrigins)
13455 {
13456 _designControl.Entities.Remove(o);
13457 }
13458
13459 // Re-add for each file path
13460 var cadEntities = _designControl.Entities.Where(IsValidPartEntity).ToList();
13461 var groupedByPath = cadEntities.GroupBy(e => GetPartSourceKey(e) ?? "", StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
13462
13463 foreach (var group in groupedByPath)
13464 {
13465 if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(group.Key))
13466 continue;
13467
13468 AddPartOrigins(group, group.Key);
13469 }
13470 }
13471 else
13472 {
13473 // Skip the first grid which is the main scene grid
13474 for (int i = 1; i < _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Count; i++)
13475 {
13476 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids[i].Visible = false;
13477 }
13478
13479 var partOrigins = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.EntityData as string != null && (e.EntityData as string)!.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN"));
13480 foreach (var origin in partOrigins)
13481 {
13482 origin.Visible = false;
13483 }
13484 }
13485
13486 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
13487 _designControl.Invalidate();
13488 }
13489 });

13495 private bool IsValidPartEntity(Entity e)
13496 {
13497 if (e is not Brep && e is not Mesh) return false;
13498 if (IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntity(e)) return false;
13499 if (IsCmmBoundingBoxVisualEntity(e)) return false;
13500
13501 string? partSource = GetPartSourceKey(e);
13502 if (partSource == null) return false;
13503
13504 string? layerName = e.LayerName;
13505 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(layerName))
13506 {
13507 if (layerName.Equals("MARKERS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13508 layerName.Equals("PROBE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13509 layerName.Equals("TRACKING", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13510 layerName.Equals("COLLISION_MARKER", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13511 layerName.Equals("SCANNER", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13512 layerName.Equals("SCANNER_FOV", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13513 layerName.Equals("RAYCAST_HITS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13514 layerName.StartsWith("PATH_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13515 layerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13516 layerName.StartsWith("MEASUREMENT_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13517 layerName.Equals(BaseAvoidanceVisualLayerName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13518 layerName.Equals(CmmBoundingBoxLayerName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13519 layerName.Equals("VERIFICATION", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
13520 {
13521 return false;
13522 }
13523 }
13524
13525 return true;
13526 }

13540 private bool TryGetPartBoundsForSource(string? sourcePath, out Point3D min, out Point3D max, out double maxDim)
13541 {
13542 min = new Point3D(double.MaxValue, double.MaxValue, double.MaxValue);
13543 max = new Point3D(double.MinValue, double.MinValue, double.MinValue);
13544 maxDim = 0;
13545
13546 if (_designControl == null)
13547 return false;
13548
13549 IEnumerable<Entity> entities = _designControl.Entities.Where(IsValidPartEntity);
13550 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sourcePath))
13551 {
13552 entities = entities.Where(e => string.Equals(GetPartSourceKey(e), sourcePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
13553 }
13554
13555 var parts = entities.ToList();
13556 if (!parts.Any())
13557 return false;
13558
13559 foreach (var ent in parts)
13560 {
13561 ent.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
13562 if (ent.BoxMin.X < min.X) min.X = ent.BoxMin.X;
13563 if (ent.BoxMin.Y < min.Y) min.Y = ent.BoxMin.Y;
13564 if (ent.BoxMin.Z < min.Z) min.Z = ent.BoxMin.Z;
13565
13566 if (ent.BoxMax.X > max.X) max.X = ent.BoxMax.X;
13567 if (ent.BoxMax.Y > max.Y) max.Y = ent.BoxMax.Y;
13568 if (ent.BoxMax.Z > max.Z) max.Z = ent.BoxMax.Z;
13569 }
13570
13571 maxDim = Math.Max(Math.Max(50, max.X - min.X), Math.Max(50, max.Y - min.Y));
13572 maxDim = Math.Ceiling(maxDim / 10.0) * 10.0;
13573 return true;
13574 }
13575
13576 private bool TryGetPartBoundsForEntity(Entity entity, out Point3D min, out Point3D max, out double maxDim)
13577 {
13578 min = new Point3D(double.MaxValue, double.MaxValue, double.MaxValue);
13579 max = new Point3D(double.MinValue, double.MinValue, double.MinValue);
13580 maxDim = 0.0;
13581
13582 if (entity == null || IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntity(entity))
13583 return false;
13584
13585 entity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
13586 min = entity.BoxMin;
13587 max = entity.BoxMax;
13588 if (min == null || max == null)
13589 return false;
13590
13591 maxDim = Math.Max(Math.Max(50, max.X - min.X), Math.Max(50, max.Y - min.Y));
13592 maxDim = Math.Ceiling(maxDim / 10.0) * 10.0;
13593 return true;
13594 }

13622 private static (Point3D Position, Text.alignmentType Alignment) GetBaseAvoidanceLabelPlacement(
13623 Point3D min,
13624 double planeSize,
13625 double outsideOffset,
13626 double z)
13627 {
13628 string placement = (ConfigurationManager.AppSettings[BaseAvoidanceLabelPlacementSettingKey] ?? "TopRight").Trim();
13629 double maxX = min.X + planeSize;
13630 double maxY = min.Y + planeSize;
13631
13632 return placement.Equals("BottomLeft", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
13633 ? (new Point3D(min.X, min.Y - outsideOffset, z), Text.alignmentType.MiddleLeft)
13634 : placement.Equals("TopLeft", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
13635 ? (new Point3D(min.X, maxY + outsideOffset, z), Text.alignmentType.MiddleLeft)
13636 : placement.Equals("BottomRight", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
13637 ? (new Point3D(maxX, min.Y - outsideOffset, z), Text.alignmentType.MiddleRight)
13638 : (new Point3D(maxX, maxY + outsideOffset, z), Text.alignmentType.MiddleRight);
13639 }

13641 private void AddBaseAvoidancePlaneVisuals(Point3D min, double maxDim, string? sourcePath)
13642 {
13643 if (_designControl == null)
13644 return;
13645
13646 var config = BaseAvoidanceClearance.LoadConfig();
13647 if (!config.Enabled || config.SafeHeight <= 0)
13648 return;
13649
13650 RemoveBaseAvoidanceVisuals(sourcePath);
13651 EnsureBaseAvoidanceLayerExists();
13652
13653 double z = min.Z + config.SafeHeight;
13654 var pts = new[]
13655 {
13656 new Point3D(min.X, min.Y, z),
13657 new Point3D(min.X + maxDim, min.Y, z),
13658 new Point3D(min.X + maxDim, min.Y + maxDim, z),
13659 new Point3D(min.X, min.Y + maxDim, z)
13660 };
13661 var triangles = new[]
13662 {
13663 new devDept.Geometry.IndexTriangle(0, 1, 2),
13664 new devDept.Geometry.IndexTriangle(0, 2, 3)
13665 };
13666
13667 var basePlaneMesh = new Mesh(pts, triangles)
13668 {
13669 Color = System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(96, 255, 0, 0),
13670 ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity,
13671 LayerName = BaseAvoidanceVisualLayerName,
13672 EntityData = BuildBaseAvoidanceTag(BaseAvoidancePlaneEntityDataPrefix, sourcePath),
13673 Selectable = true
13674 };
13675 _designControl.Entities.Add(basePlaneMesh);
13676
13677 double textHeight = Math.Max(1.0, Math.Min(4.0, maxDim / 60.0));
13678 double textOutsideOffset = Math.Max(textHeight * 2.5, maxDim * 0.025) - 2;
13679 double textZOffset = 0;
13680 string label = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "BaseAvoidancePlane_Label") ?? "Base avoidance plane";
13681 var labelPlacement = GetBaseAvoidanceLabelPlacement(min, maxDim, textOutsideOffset, z + textZOffset);
13682 var textPosition = labelPlacement.Position;
13683 var textEntity = new Text(textPosition, label, textHeight)
13684 {
13685 Color = System.Drawing.Color.Maroon,
13686 ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity,
13687 LayerName = BaseAvoidanceVisualLayerName,
13688 EntityData = BuildBaseAvoidanceTag(BaseAvoidanceLabelEntityDataPrefix, sourcePath),
13689 Selectable = true
13690 };
13691 textEntity.Alignment = labelPlacement.Alignment;
13692 _designControl.Entities.Add(textEntity);
13693 }

13700 private void AddPartOrigins(IEnumerable<Entity>? specificEntities = null, string? sourcePath = null)
13701 {
13702 if (_designControl == null) return;
13703
13704 IEnumerable<Entity> entitiesToProcess;
13705 if (specificEntities != null)
13706 {
13707 entitiesToProcess = specificEntities.Where(IsValidPartEntity);
13708 }
13709 else
13710 {
13711 entitiesToProcess = _designControl.Entities.Where(IsValidPartEntity);
13712 }
13713
13714 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourcePath))
13715 {
13716 entitiesToProcess = entitiesToProcess.Where(e => string.Equals(GetPartSourceKey(e), sourcePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
13717 }
13718
13719 if (!entitiesToProcess.Any()) return;
13720
13721 Point3D min = new Point3D(double.MaxValue, double.MaxValue, double.MaxValue);
13722 Point3D max = new Point3D(double.MinValue, double.MinValue, double.MinValue);
13723
13724 foreach (var ent in entitiesToProcess)
13725 {
13726 ent.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
13727 if (ent.BoxMin.X < min.X) min.X = ent.BoxMin.X;
13728 if (ent.BoxMin.Y < min.Y) min.Y = ent.BoxMin.Y;
13729 if (ent.BoxMin.Z < min.Z) min.Z = ent.BoxMin.Z;
13730
13731 if (ent.BoxMax.X > max.X) max.X = ent.BoxMax.X;
13732 if (ent.BoxMax.Y > max.Y) max.Y = ent.BoxMax.Y;
13733 if (ent.BoxMax.Z > max.Z) max.Z = ent.BoxMax.Z;
13734 }
13735
13736 // Clean up any existing origin symbol and grid for this specific source path first to prevent duplication
13737 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourcePath))
13738 {
13739 string originTag = $"PART_ORIGIN:{sourcePath}";
13740 var existingOrigins = _designControl.Entities
13741 .Where(e => e.EntityData is string tag && string.Equals(tag, originTag, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
13742 .ToList();
13743
13744 foreach (var o in existingOrigins)
13745 {
13746 if (o is BlockReference oldBr && _designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
13747 {
13748 var oldMin = oldBr.InsertionPoint;
13749 var gridToRemove = _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids
13750 .Skip(1) // Skip main grid
13751 .FirstOrDefault(g => Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.X - oldMin.X) < 1.0 &&
13752 Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.Y - oldMin.Y) < 1.0 &&
13753 Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.Z - oldMin.Z) < 1.0);
13754 if (gridToRemove != null)
13755 {
13756 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Remove(gridToRemove);
13757 }
13758 }
13759 _designControl.Entities.Remove(o);
13760 }
13761 }
13762 else
13763 {
13764 var existingOrigins = _designControl.Entities
13765 .Where(e => e.EntityData is string tag && string.Equals(tag, "PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
13766 .ToList();
13767
13768 foreach (var o in existingOrigins)
13769 {
13770 if (o is BlockReference oldBr && _designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
13771 {
13772 var oldMin = oldBr.InsertionPoint;
13773 var gridToRemove = _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids
13774 .Skip(1)
13775 .FirstOrDefault(g => Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.X - oldMin.X) < 1.0 &&
13776 Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.Y - oldMin.Y) < 1.0 &&
13777 Math.Abs(g.Plane.Origin.Z - oldMin.Z) < 1.0);
13778 if (gridToRemove != null)
13779 {
13780 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Remove(gridToRemove);
13781 }
13782 }
13783 _designControl.Entities.Remove(o);
13784 }
13785 }
13786
13787 string baseBlockName = "OriginSymbol";
13788 if (!_designControl.Blocks.Contains(baseBlockName))
13789 {
13790 var b = new Block(baseBlockName);
13791 var l1 = new devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Line(0, 0, 0, 20, 0, 0) { Color = System.Drawing.Color.Red, ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity, LineWeight = 2, LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity };
13792 var l2 = new devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Line(0, 0, 0, 0, 20, 0) { Color = System.Drawing.Color.Green, ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity, LineWeight = 2, LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity };
13793 var l3 = new devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Line(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 20) { Color = System.Drawing.Color.Blue, ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity, LineWeight = 2, LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity };
13794 b.Entities.Add(l1);
13795 b.Entities.Add(l2);
13796 b.Entities.Add(l3);
13797 _designControl.Blocks.Add(b);
13798 }
13799
13800 var br = new BlockReference(min.X, min.Y, min.Z, baseBlockName, 1);
13801 br.EntityData = string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourcePath) ? "PART_ORIGIN" : $"PART_ORIGIN:{sourcePath}";
13802 _designControl.Entities.Add(br);
13803
13804 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
13805 {
13806 var grid = new devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid();
13807 grid.Plane = new Plane(min, Vector3D.AxisX, Vector3D.AxisY);
13808 grid.Step = 10;
13809 grid.Min = new Point2D(0, 0);
13810
13811 double maxDim = Math.Max(Math.Max(50, max.X - min.X), Math.Max(50, max.Y - min.Y));
13812 maxDim = Math.Ceiling(maxDim / 10.0) * 10.0;
13813 grid.Max = new Point2D(maxDim, maxDim);
13814
13815 grid.Lighting = false;
13816 grid.Visible = showOriginGrids;
13817 _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Add(grid);
13818
13819 if (ReadBoolAppSetting(BaseAvoidanceShowOnImportSettingKey, false))
13820 {
13821 AddBaseAvoidancePlaneVisuals(min, maxDim, sourcePath);
13822 }
13823 }
13824 }

13831 private bool IsSectionCandidateEntity(Entity ent)
13832 {
13833 if (ent is not Brep && ent is not Mesh) return false;
13834
13835 if (_manualMarkingSpheres.Contains(ent) ||
13836 _measurementPointSpheres.Contains(ent) ||
13837 _allControlPointSpheres.Contains(ent) ||
13838 _visualsManager.ControlPointSpheres.Contains(ent))
13839 {
13840 return false;
13841 }
13842
13843 if (ent.EntityData is string entityData)
13844 {
13845 if (entityData == "PART_ORIGIN" ||
13846 entityData == "SECTION_VISUAL" ||
13847 entityData == "IgnoredOverlay_Ref")
13848 {
13849 return false;
13850 }
13851 }
13852
13853 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ent.LayerName))
13854 {
13855 if (ent.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13856 ent.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13857 ent.LayerName.Contains("IGNORED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
13858 ent.LayerName.Equals("SECTION_VISUAL", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
13859 {
13860 return false;
13861 }
13862 }
13863
13864 return true;
13865 }

13873 private (CADFace Face, Brep Brep) FindClosestFace(Point3D pt)
13874 {
13875 CADFace? closestFace = null;
13876 Brep? closestBrep = null;
13877 double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
13878
13879 if (_allFacesByColor != null)
13880 {
13881 foreach (var face in _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f))
13882 {
13883 if (face.EntityIndex >= 0 && face.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
13884 {
13885 var brep = _designControl.Entities[face.EntityIndex] as Brep;
13886 if (brep != null)
13887 {
13888 Point3D projected = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(pt, brep, face.FaceIndex);
13889 double dist = pt.DistanceTo(projected);
13890 if (dist < minDistance)
13891 {
13892 minDistance = dist;
13893 closestFace = face;
13894 closestBrep = brep;
13895 }
13896 }
13897 }
13898 }
13899 }
13900
13901 if (closestFace == null && _designControl != null && _designControl.Entities != null)
13902 {
13903 for (int entIdx = 0; entIdx < _designControl.Entities.Count; entIdx++)
13904 {
13905 if (_designControl.Entities[entIdx] is Brep brep)
13906 {
13907 for (int faceIdx = 0; faceIdx < brep.Faces.Length; faceIdx++)
13908 {
13909 try
13910 {
13911 Point3D projected = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(pt, brep, faceIdx);
13912 double dist = pt.DistanceTo(projected);
13913 if (dist < minDistance)
13914 {
13915 minDistance = dist;
13916 closestBrep = brep;
13917 closestFace = new CADFace
13918 {
13919 EntityIndex = entIdx,
13920 FaceIndex = faceIdx,
13921 FaceColor = brep.Faces[faceIdx].Color ?? System.Drawing.Color.White
13922 };
13923 }
13924 }
13925 catch { }
13926 }
13927 }
13928 }
13929 }
13930
13931 return (closestFace!, closestBrep!);
13932 }
13933
13941 private Point3D SnapToClosestPartSurface(Point3D point, out Vector3D normal, out Entity? closestPart)
13942 {
13943 closestPart = null;
13944 normal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
13945 Point3D bestSnappedPoint = (Point3D)point.Clone();
13946 double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
13947
13948 var parts = GetSectionCandidateParts();
13949 foreach (var part in parts)
13950 {
13951 Point3D snappedPt = (Point3D)point.Clone();
13952 Vector3D partNormal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
13953 bool success = false;
13954
13955 try
13956 {
13957 if (part is Brep brep)
13958 {
13959 // Convert BREP to mesh for closest-point search
13960 var brepMesh = brep.ConvertToMesh();
13961 if (brepMesh != null && brepMesh.Triangles != null && brepMesh.Vertices != null)
13962 {
13963 double closestDist = double.MaxValue;
13964 int bestTriIdx = -1;
13965 Point3D bestClosest = point;
13966
13967 for (int ti = 0; ti < brepMesh.Triangles.Length; ti++)
13968 {
13969 var tri = brepMesh.Triangles[ti];
13970 var tv1 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V1];
13971 var tv2 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V2];
13972 var tv3 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V3];
13973 var cp = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ClosestPointOnTriangle(point, tv1, tv2, tv3);
13974 double d = point.DistanceTo(cp);
13975 if (d < closestDist)
13976 {
13977 closestDist = d;
13978 bestClosest = cp;
13979 bestTriIdx = ti;
13980 }
13981 }
13982
13983 snappedPt = bestClosest;
13984
13985 // Get face normal using Brep API; fall back to mesh triangle cross product
13986 if (bestTriIdx >= 0)
13987 {
13988 bool gotNormal = false;
13989 for (int fi = 0; fi < brep.Faces.Length; fi++)
13990 {
13991 try
13992 {
13993 var fn = brep.Faces[fi].Normal(snappedPt);
13994 if (fn != null && fn.Length > 1e-6)
13995 {
13996 partNormal = fn;
13997 partNormal.Normalize();
13998 gotNormal = true;
13999 break;
14000 }
14001 }
14002 catch { }
14003 }
14004 if (!gotNormal)
14005 {
14006 var tri = brepMesh.Triangles[bestTriIdx];
14007 var tv1 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V1];
14008 var tv2 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V2];
14009 var tv3 = brepMesh.Vertices[tri.V3];
14010 var e1 = new Vector3D(tv1, tv2);
14011 var e2 = new Vector3D(tv1, tv3);
14012 partNormal = Vector3D.Cross(e1, e2);
14013 if (partNormal.Length > 1e-6) partNormal.Normalize();
14014 }
14015 }
14016 success = true;
14017 }
14018 }
14019 else if (part is Mesh mesh)
14020 {
14021 if (mesh.Triangles != null && mesh.Vertices != null)
14022 {
14023 double closestDist = double.MaxValue;
14024 int bestTriIdx = -1;
14025 Point3D bestClosest = point;
14026
14027 for (int ti = 0; ti < mesh.Triangles.Length; ti++)
14028 {
14029 var tri = mesh.Triangles[ti];
14030 var tv1 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V1];
14031 var tv2 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V2];
14032 var tv3 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V3];
14033 var cp = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ClosestPointOnTriangle(point, tv1, tv2, tv3);
14034 double d = point.DistanceTo(cp);
14035 if (d < closestDist)
14036 {
14037 closestDist = d;
14038 bestClosest = cp;
14039 bestTriIdx = ti;
14040 }
14041 }
14042
14043 snappedPt = bestClosest;
14044
14045 if (bestTriIdx >= 0)
14046 {
14047 var tri = mesh.Triangles[bestTriIdx];
14048 var tv1 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V1];
14049 var tv2 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V2];
14050 var tv3 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V3];
14051 var e1 = new Vector3D(tv1, tv2);
14052 var e2 = new Vector3D(tv1, tv3);
14053 partNormal = Vector3D.Cross(e1, e2);
14054 if (partNormal.Length > 1e-6) partNormal.Normalize();
14055 }
14056 success = true;
14057 }
14058 }
14059 }
14060 catch (Exception ex)
14061 {
14062 Debug.WriteLine($"SnapToClosestPartSurface: skipping part {part?.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
14063 }
14064
14065 if (success)
14066 {
14067 double dist = point.DistanceTo(snappedPt);
14068 if (dist < minDistance)
14069 {
14070 minDistance = dist;
14071 bestSnappedPoint = snappedPt;
14072 normal = partNormal;
14073 closestPart = part;
14074 }
14075 }
14076 }
14077
14078 return bestSnappedPoint;
14079 }

14085 private List<Entity> GetSectionCandidateParts()
14086 {
14087 if (_designControl == null || _designControl.Entities == null) return new List<Entity>();
14088 return _designControl.Entities.Where(IsSectionCandidateEntity).ToList();

14096 private Entity? GetClosestPart(List<Entity> parts)
14097 {
14098 if (parts == null || !parts.Any() || _designControl == null) return null;
14099
14100 var cameraLoc = _designControl.Camera.Location;
14101 double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
14102 Entity? closestPart = null;
14103
14104 foreach (var p in parts)
14105 {
14106 p.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
14107 Point3D center = new Point3D(
14108 (p.BoxMin.X + p.BoxMax.X) / 2,
14109 (p.BoxMin.Y + p.BoxMax.Y) / 2,
14110 (p.BoxMin.Z + p.BoxMax.Z) / 2);
14111 double dist = center.DistanceTo(cameraLoc);
14112 if (dist < minDistance)
14113 {
14114 minDistance = dist;
14115 closestPart = p;
14116 }
14117 }
14118 return closestPart;
14119 }
14120
14125 private Entity? GetTargetPartForSection()
14126 {
14127 var parts = GetSectionCandidateParts();
14128 if (!parts.Any()) return null;
14129
14130 // 1. Priority: Currently selected part
14131 var targetPart = parts.FirstOrDefault(ent => ent.Selected);
14132
14133 // 2. Fallback: Face the user last clicked
14134 if (targetPart == null && _visualsManager?.CurrentSelectedFace != null &&
14135 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace.EntityIndex >= 0 &&
14136 _visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
14137 {
14138 var faceEntity = _designControl.Entities[_visualsManager.CurrentSelectedFace.EntityIndex];
14139 if (parts.Contains(faceEntity))
14140 {
14141 targetPart = faceEntity;
14142 }
14143 }
14144
14145 // 3. Fallback: Closest part to camera
14146 return targetPart ?? GetClosestPart(parts);
14147 }

14269 private void UpdateSectionPlane()
14270 {
14271 if (_designControl == null || SectionViewOverlayVisibility != Visibility.Visible) return;
14272
14273 var parts = GetSectionCandidateParts();
14274 if (!parts.Any()) return;
14275 var targetPart = GetTargetPartForSection();
14276 if (targetPart == null) return;
14277
14278 targetPart.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
14279
14280 // Hide other parts to isolate section view
14281 foreach (var part in parts)
14282 {
14283 if (part != targetPart)
14284 {
14285 if (!_preSectionVisibility.ContainsKey(part))
14286 {
14287 _preSectionVisibility[part] = part.Visible;
14288 }
14289 part.Visible = false;
14290 }
14291 }
14292
14293 var min = targetPart.BoxMin;
14294 var size = targetPart.BoxSize;
14295
14296 // Hide other origins and grids
14297 var origins = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => (e.EntityData as string) == "PART_ORIGIN").ToList();
14298 foreach (var origin in origins)
14299 {
14300 if (origin is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference br)
14301 {
14302 bool isTargetOrigin = Math.Abs(br.InsertionPoint.X - min.X) < 1 &&
14303 Math.Abs(br.InsertionPoint.Y - min.Y) < 1 &&
14304 Math.Abs(br.InsertionPoint.Z - min.Z) < 1;
14305 if (!isTargetOrigin)
14306 {
14307 if (!_preSectionVisibility.ContainsKey(origin))
14308 _preSectionVisibility[origin] = origin.Visible;
14309 origin.Visible = false;
14310 }
14311 }
14312 }
14313
14314 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
14315 {
14316 foreach (var grid in _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids)
14317 {
14318 if (grid == _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids[0]) continue; // Skip main grid
14319
14320 bool isTargetGrid = Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.X - min.X) < 1 &&
14321 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Y - min.Y) < 1 &&
14322 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Z - min.Z) < 1;
14323 if (!isTargetGrid)
14324 {
14325 if (!_preSectionGridVisibility.ContainsKey(grid))
14326 _preSectionGridVisibility[grid] = grid.Visible;
14327 grid.Visible = false;
14328 }
14329 }
14330 }
14331
14332 Plane plane;
14333 Point3D planeOrigin;
14334 double planeWidth, planeHeight;
14335
14336 switch (sectionPlaneAxis)
14337 {
14338 case "X":
14339 planeOrigin = new Point3D(min.X + SectionPlanePosition, min.Y, min.Z);
14340 plane = new Plane(planeOrigin, Vector3D.AxisY, Vector3D.AxisZ);
14341 SectionPlaneMaxPosition = size.X;
14342 planeWidth = size.Y + 20; // 10 padding on each side based on grid
14343 planeHeight = size.Z + 20;
14344 break;
14345 case "Y":
14346 planeOrigin = new Point3D(min.X, min.Y + SectionPlanePosition, min.Z);
14347 plane = new Plane(planeOrigin, Vector3D.AxisX, Vector3D.AxisZ);
14348 SectionPlaneMaxPosition = size.Y;
14349 planeWidth = size.X + 20;
14350 planeHeight = size.Z + 20;
14351 break;
14352 case "Z":
14353 default:
14354 planeOrigin = new Point3D(min.X, min.Y, min.Z + SectionPlanePosition);
14355 plane = new Plane(planeOrigin, Vector3D.AxisX, Vector3D.AxisY);
14356 SectionPlaneMaxPosition = size.Z;
14357 planeWidth = size.X + 20;
14358 planeHeight = size.Y + 20;
14359 break;
14360 }
14361
14362 if (_designControl.ClippingPlane1 != null)
14363 {
14364 _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Plane = plane;
14365 _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Capping = false;
14366 _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Active = true;
14367 }
14368
14369 // Optional: Draw a visual boundary for the plane
14370 _designControl.Invalidate();
14371 _ignoredItemManager?.SyncVisibility();
14372
14373 // Auto-update section view window if it's open
14374 if (_activeSectionWindow != null && _activeSectionWindow.IsLoaded)
14375 {
14376 ShowSectionViewWindow();
14377 }
14378 }
14379
14385 private void ObjectManipulator_SectionPlaneDrag(object sender, devDept.Eyeshot.Control.ObjectManipulator.ObjectManipulatorEventArgs e)
14386 {
14387 if (_designControl == null || SectionViewOverlayVisibility != Visibility.Visible || _designControl.ClippingPlane1 == null) return;
14388
14389 // Extract the new translation from the manipulator
14390 var newTrans = _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Transformation;
14391
14392 // Extract position based on axis
14393 double newPosition = 0;
14394 var targetPart = GetTargetPartForSection();
14395 if (targetPart == null) return;
14396
14397 targetPart.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
14398 var min = targetPart.BoxMin;
14399
14400 switch (sectionPlaneAxis)
14401 {
14402 case "X":
14403 newPosition = newTrans.Matrix[0, 3] - min.X;
14404 break;
14405 case "Y":
14406 newPosition = newTrans.Matrix[1, 3] - min.Y;
14407 break;
14408 case "Z":
14409 default:
14410 newPosition = newTrans.Matrix[2, 3] - min.Z;
14411 break;
14412 }
14413
14414 // Set the value via property to trigger UI updates and plane sync
14415 SectionPlanePosition = newPosition;
14416
14417 // Update the clipping plane position
14418 var currentPlane = _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Plane;
14419 currentPlane.Origin = new Point3D(newTrans.Matrix[0, 3], newTrans.Matrix[1, 3], newTrans.Matrix[2, 3]);
14420 _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Plane = currentPlane;
14421
14422 // Ensure SectionViewWindow updates in real-time if open
14423 if (_activeSectionWindow != null && _activeSectionWindow.IsLoaded)
14424 {
14425 ShowSectionViewWindow();
14426 }
14427
14428 var oldVisual = _designControl.Entities.FirstOrDefault(ent => ent.EntityData as string == "SECTION_VISUAL") as devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Mesh;
14429 if (oldVisual != null)
14430 {
14431 _designControl.Entities.Remove(oldVisual);
14432
14433 double pWidth = 0, pHeight = 0;
14434 switch (sectionPlaneAxis)
14435 {
14436 case "X": pWidth = targetPart.BoxSize.Y + 20; pHeight = targetPart.BoxSize.Z + 20; break;
14437 case "Y": pWidth = targetPart.BoxSize.X + 20; pHeight = targetPart.BoxSize.Z + 20; break;
14438 case "Z": default: pWidth = targetPart.BoxSize.X + 20; pHeight = targetPart.BoxSize.Y + 20; break;
14439 }
14440 var p1 = currentPlane.Origin;
14441 var p2 = currentPlane.Origin + currentPlane.AxisX * pWidth;
14442 var p3 = currentPlane.Origin + currentPlane.AxisX * pWidth + currentPlane.AxisY * pHeight;
14443 var p4 = currentPlane.Origin + currentPlane.AxisY * pHeight;
14444
14445 devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.LinearPath lp = new devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.LinearPath(p1, p2, p3, p4, p1);
14446 var visualPlane = lp.ExtrudeAsMesh(currentPlane.AxisZ * 0.2, 0.01, devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Mesh.natureType.Plain);
14447 visualPlane.Translate(currentPlane.AxisZ * -0.1);
14448
14449 visualPlane.EntityData = "SECTION_VISUAL";
14450 visualPlane.LayerName = "SECTION_VISUAL";
14451 visualPlane.Color = System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(100, System.Drawing.Color.Red);
14452 visualPlane.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
14453 _designControl.Entities.Add(visualPlane);
14454 }
14455
14456 _designControl.Invalidate();
14457 }
14458
14459 private SectionViewWindow? _activeSectionWindow = null;
14460 private List<LinearDim>? _lastSectionMeasurements = null;
14461 private devDept.Geometry.Plane? _lastSectionPlane = null;
14462
14466 private void ShowSectionViewWindow()
14467 {
14468 try
14469 {
14470 // Calculate section curves
14471 var plane = _designControl.ClippingPlane1.Plane;
14472 var curves = new List<ICurve>();
14473
14474 var targetPart = GetTargetPartForSection();
14475 if (targetPart == null) return;
14476 int targetEntityIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(targetPart);
14477
14478 var cadFaces = _allFacesByColor.Values.SelectMany(f => f).ToList();
14479 var cadFacesToProcess = cadFaces.Where(f => f.EntityIndex == targetEntityIndex).ToList();
14480 bool generatedAny = false;
14481
14482 if (cadFacesToProcess.Any())
14483 {
14484 var ent = _designControl.Entities[targetEntityIndex];
14485 if (ent is Brep brep)
14486 {
14487 var clone = (Brep)brep.Clone();
14488 try { clone.Regen(0.1); } catch { }
14489
14490 foreach (var cadFace in cadFacesToProcess)
14491 {
14492 if (cadFace.FaceIndex >= 0 && cadFace.FaceIndex < clone.Faces.Length)
14493 {
14494 var face = clone.Faces[cadFace.FaceIndex];
14495 var mesh = face.ConvertToMesh();
14496 if (mesh != null)
14497 {
14498 var sectionCurves = mesh.Section(plane, 0.01);
14499 if (sectionCurves != null && sectionCurves.Length > 0)
14500 {
14501 foreach (var curve in sectionCurves)
14502 {
14503 if (curve is Entity curveEnt)
14504 {
14505 curveEnt.Color = cadFace.FaceColor;
14506 curveEnt.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
14507 curveEnt.LineWeight = 2;
14508 curveEnt.LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
14509
14510 // Store CADHole or CADFace for Context Menu
14511 if (_faceIndexToHoleMap != null && _faceIndexToHoleMap.TryGetValue(cadFace.FaceGlobalIndex, out var cadHole))
14512 curveEnt.EntityData = cadHole;
14513 else
14514 curveEnt.EntityData = cadFace;
14515
14516 curves.Add(curve);
14517 }
14518 }
14519 generatedAny = true;
14520 }
14521 }
14522 }
14523 }
14524 }
14525 }
14526 else
14527 {
14528 // Fallback: faces not yet extracted
14529 if (targetPart is Brep brep)
14530 {
14531 var clone = (Brep)brep.Clone();
14532 try { clone.Regen(0.1); } catch { }
14533
14534 for (int fIdx = 0; fIdx < clone.Faces.Length; fIdx++)
14535 {
14536 var face = clone.Faces[fIdx];
14537 var mesh = face.ConvertToMesh();
14538 if (mesh == null) continue;
14539
14540 var sectionCurves = mesh.Section(plane, 0.01);
14541 if (sectionCurves == null || sectionCurves.Length == 0) continue;
14542
14543 // Use the face's own color, or fall back to the entity color
14544 var faceColor = face.Color ?? targetPart.Color;
14545
14546 foreach (var curve in sectionCurves)
14547 {
14548 if (curve is Entity curveEnt)
14549 {
14550 curveEnt.Color = faceColor;
14551 curveEnt.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
14552 curveEnt.LineWeight = 2;
14553 curveEnt.LineWeightMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
14554 // No EntityData — faces haven't been extracted yet, so no properties to show
14555 curves.Add(curve);
14556 }
14557 }
14558 generatedAny = true;
14559 }
14560 }
14561 else if (targetPart is Mesh mesh)
14562 {
14563 var sectionCurves = mesh.Section(plane, 0.01);
14564 if (sectionCurves != null) { curves.AddRange(sectionCurves); generatedAny = true; }
14565 }
14566 }
14567
14568 if (!generatedAny)
14569 {
14570 MessageBox.Show(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_EmptySectionViewSlice") ?? "No section curves generated. The plane might not intersect any part.", "Section View", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
14571 return;
14572 }
14573
14574 var existingWindow = _activeSectionWindow;
14575 if (existingWindow != null && existingWindow.IsLoaded)
14576 {
14577 existingWindow.UpdateCurves(curves, plane);
14578 }
14579 else
14580 {
14581 // Check if we have saved measurements for this exact plane
14582 List<LinearDim>? dimsToRestore = null;
14583 if (_lastSectionPlane != null && plane.Equals(_lastSectionPlane))
14584 {
14585 dimsToRestore = _lastSectionMeasurements;
14586 }
14587
14588 // Create and show the new window
14589 _activeSectionWindow = new SectionViewWindow(this, curves, DocLanguage, plane, (dims) =>
14590 {
14591 // Clone dimensions before the window (and its entities) are disposed
14592 _lastSectionMeasurements = dims.Select(d => (LinearDim)d.Clone()).ToList();
14593 _lastSectionPlane = plane;
14594 Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(DeactivateSectionView);
14595 }, dimsToRestore);
14596
14597 _activeSectionWindow.Owner = MainParent;
14598 _activeSectionWindow.Show();
14599 _activeSectionWindow.Closed += SectionWindow_Closed;
14600 }
14601 }
14602 catch (Exception ex)
14603 {
14604 Debug.WriteLine($"Error in ShowSectionViewWindow: {ex.Message}");
14605 MessageBox.Show($"Failed to open Section View:\n{ex.Message}\n\n{ex.StackTrace}", GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Section View Error", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
14606 }
14607 }

14616 _activeSectionWindow = null;
14617 MainParent.Activate();
14618 }
