14698 private enum SharedWaypointMovementKind
14699 {
14700 ApproachAxis,
14701 Surface,
14702 Unrestricted
14703 }
14704
14705 private sealed class SharedWaypointMovementChoice
14706 {
14707 public SharedWaypointMovementKind Kind { get; init; }
14708 public Vector3D Axis { get; init; } = new Vector3D(0, 0, 1);
14709 public List<WaypointReference> References { get; } = new List<WaypointReference>();
14710 public string Label { get; set; } = string.Empty;
14711 public string ToolTip { get; set; } = string.Empty;
14712 }
14713
14714 private static bool TryGetApproachMeasurementIndex(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, out int measurementIndex)
14715 {
14716 measurementIndex = -1;
14717 if (path == null || path.Points == null || path.IsMeasure == null ||
14718 pointIndex < 0 || pointIndex >= path.Points.Count)
14719 {
14720 return false;
14721 }
14722
14723 if (path.PointTypes != null && pointIndex < path.PointTypes.Count &&
14724 string.Equals(path.PointTypes[pointIndex], "scanpoints", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
14725 {
14726 return false;
14727 }
14728
14729 if (pointIndex < path.IsMeasure.Count && path.IsMeasure[pointIndex])
14730 return false;
14731
14732 if (pointIndex + 1 < path.Points.Count &&
14733 pointIndex + 1 < path.IsMeasure.Count &&
14734 path.IsMeasure[pointIndex + 1])
14735 {
14736 measurementIndex = pointIndex + 1;
14737 return true;
14738 }
14739
14740 if (pointIndex > 0 && pointIndex - 1 < path.IsMeasure.Count && path.IsMeasure[pointIndex - 1])
14741 {
14742 measurementIndex = pointIndex - 1;
14743 return true;
14744 }
14745
14746 return false;
14747 }
14748
14749 private static List<WaypointReference> GetValidWaypointReferences(WaypointData waypointData)
14750 {
14751 var result = new List<WaypointReference>();
14752 foreach (var reference in waypointData.GetReferences())
14753 {
14754 if (reference.Path == null || reference.Path.Points == null ||
14755 reference.PointIndex < 0 || reference.PointIndex >= reference.Path.Points.Count)
14756 {
14757 continue;
14758 }
14759
14760 if (!result.Any(existing =>
14761 ReferenceEquals(existing.Path, reference.Path) &&
14762 existing.PointIndex == reference.PointIndex))
14763 {
14764 result.Add(reference);
14765 }
14766 }
14767
14768 return result;
14769 }
14770
14771 private static bool IsSurfaceMeasurementReference(WaypointReference reference)
14772 {
14773 if (reference.Path.IsMeasure == null ||
14774 reference.PointIndex >= reference.Path.IsMeasure.Count ||
14775 !reference.Path.IsMeasure[reference.PointIndex])
14776 {
14777 return false;
14778 }
14779
14780 return reference.Path.PointTypes == null ||
14781 reference.PointIndex >= reference.Path.PointTypes.Count ||
14782 !string.Equals(
14783 reference.Path.PointTypes[reference.PointIndex],
14784 "scanpoints",
14785 StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
14786 }
14787
14788 private static bool HasSurfaceMeasurementReference(WaypointData waypointData)
14789 {
14790 return GetValidWaypointReferences(waypointData).Any(IsSurfaceMeasurementReference);
14791 }
14792
14798 private List<SharedWaypointMovementChoice> BuildSharedWaypointMovementChoices(
14799 WaypointData waypointData)
14800 {
14801 var constrainedGroups = new List<SharedWaypointMovementChoice>();
14802 var unrestrictedReferences = new List<WaypointReference>();
14803 double toleranceDegrees = Math.Clamp(
14804 _pathManager?.FilterConfig.MeasureAngleToleranceDegrees ?? 1.0,
14805 0.0,
14806 5.0);
14807
14808 foreach (var reference in GetValidWaypointReferences(waypointData))
14809 {
14810 SharedWaypointMovementKind kind;
14811 Vector3D axis;
14812
14813 if (TryGetApproachMeasurementIndex(
14814 reference.Path,
14815 reference.PointIndex,
14816 out int measurementIndex))
14817 {
14818 kind = SharedWaypointMovementKind.ApproachAxis;
14819 axis = measurementIndex < reference.Path.Normals.Count
14820 ? (Vector3D)reference.Path.Normals[measurementIndex].Clone()
14821 : new Vector3D(0, 0, 1);
14822 }
14823 else if (IsSurfaceMeasurementReference(reference))
14824 {
14825 kind = SharedWaypointMovementKind.Surface;
14826 axis = reference.PointIndex < reference.Path.Normals.Count
14827 ? (Vector3D)reference.Path.Normals[reference.PointIndex].Clone()
14828 : new Vector3D(0, 0, 1);
14829 }
14830 else
14831 {
14832 unrestrictedReferences.Add(reference);
14833 continue;
14834 }
14835
14836 if (axis.LengthSquared < 1e-12)
14837 axis = new Vector3D(0, 0, 1);
14838 axis.Normalize();
14839
14840 var compatibleGroup = constrainedGroups.FirstOrDefault(group =>
14841 group.Kind == kind &&
14842 (kind == SharedWaypointMovementKind.ApproachAxis
14843 ? GetDirectedAxisAngleDegrees(group.Axis, axis)
14844 : GetUndirectedAxisAngleDegrees(group.Axis, axis)) <= toleranceDegrees + 1e-9);
14845 if (compatibleGroup == null)
14846 {
14847 compatibleGroup = new SharedWaypointMovementChoice
14848 {
14849 Kind = kind,
14850 Axis = axis
14851 };
14852 constrainedGroups.Add(compatibleGroup);
14853 }
14854
14855 compatibleGroup.References.Add(reference);
14856 }
14857
14858 // Preserve the existing least-freedom behavior when there is only one
14859 // constrained group: unrestricted coincident waypoints move with it. When
14860 // several incompatible axes exist, leave unrestricted points as their own
14861 // explicit choice rather than assigning them to an arbitrary axis.
14862 if (constrainedGroups.Count == 0)
14863 {
14864 if (unrestrictedReferences.Count > 0)
14865 {
14866 var unrestrictedGroup = new SharedWaypointMovementChoice
14867 {
14868 Kind = SharedWaypointMovementKind.Unrestricted
14869 };
14870 unrestrictedGroup.References.AddRange(unrestrictedReferences);
14871 constrainedGroups.Add(unrestrictedGroup);
14872 }
14873 }
14874 else if (constrainedGroups.Count == 1)
14875 {
14876 constrainedGroups[0].References.AddRange(unrestrictedReferences);
14877 }
14878 else if (unrestrictedReferences.Count > 0)
14879 {
14880 var unrestrictedGroup = new SharedWaypointMovementChoice
14881 {
14882 Kind = SharedWaypointMovementKind.Unrestricted
14883 };
14884 unrestrictedGroup.References.AddRange(unrestrictedReferences);
14885 constrainedGroups.Add(unrestrictedGroup);
14886 }
14887
14888 foreach (var group in constrainedGroups)
14889 {
14890 string occurrenceDescription = DescribeWaypointMovementOccurrences(group.References);
14891 switch (group.Kind)
14892 {
14893 case SharedWaypointMovementKind.ApproachAxis:
14894 group.Label = $"Approach axis — {occurrenceDescription} — {FormatMovementAxis(group.Axis)}";
14895 group.ToolTip = "Detach this compatible approach-axis group and move it along the displayed axis.";
14896 break;
14897 case SharedWaypointMovementKind.Surface:
14898 group.Label = $"Surface movement — {occurrenceDescription} — {FormatMovementAxis(group.Axis)}";
14899 group.ToolTip = "Detach this compatible surface group and move it on its measurement surface.";
14900 break;
14901 default:
14902 group.Label = $"Unrestricted — {occurrenceDescription}";
14903 group.ToolTip = "Detach these unrestricted occurrences and move them independently.";
14904 break;
14905 }
14906 }
14907
14908 return constrainedGroups;
14909 }
14910
14911 private static double GetUndirectedAxisAngleDegrees(Vector3D first, Vector3D second)
14912 {
14913 double dot = Math.Clamp(Vector3D.Dot(first, second), -1.0, 1.0);
14914 return Math.Acos(Math.Abs(dot)) * 180.0 / Math.PI;
14915 }
14916
14917 private static double GetDirectedAxisAngleDegrees(Vector3D first, Vector3D second)
14918 {
14919 double dot = Math.Clamp(Vector3D.Dot(first, second), -1.0, 1.0);
14920 return Math.Acos(dot) * 180.0 / Math.PI;
14921 }
14922
14923 private static string DescribeWaypointMovementOccurrences(
14924 IReadOnlyCollection<WaypointReference> references)
14925 {
14926 var first = references.First();
14927 Color color = first.Path.Color;
14928 string colorName = color.IsNamedColor
14929 ? color.Name
14930 : $"RGB {color.R},{color.G},{color.B}";
14931 string firstOccurrence = $"{colorName} point {first.PointIndex + 1}";
14932 return references.Count == 1
14933 ? firstOccurrence
14934 : $"{firstOccurrence} + {references.Count - 1} compatible";
14935 }
14936
14937 private static string FormatMovementAxis(Vector3D axis)
14938 {
14939 return string.Format(
14940 CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
14941 "axis ({0:0.###}, {1:0.###}, {2:0.###})",
14942 axis.X,
14943 axis.Y,
14944 axis.Z);
14945 }
14946
14952 private bool TryGetSharedWaypointMovementAxis(
14953 WaypointData waypointData,
14954 out Vector3D movementAxis,
14955 out bool incompatible)
14956 {
14957 movementAxis = Vector3D.AxisZ;
14958 incompatible = false;
14959 var constrainedAxes = new List<Vector3D>();
14960 var surfaceNormals = new List<Vector3D>();
14961
14962 foreach (var reference in GetValidWaypointReferences(waypointData))
14963 {
14964 if (IsSurfaceMeasurementReference(reference))
14965 {
14966 Vector3D surfaceNormal = reference.PointIndex < reference.Path.Normals.Count
14967 ? (Vector3D)reference.Path.Normals[reference.PointIndex].Clone()
14968 : Vector3D.AxisZ;
14969 if (surfaceNormal.LengthSquared < 1e-12)
14970 surfaceNormal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
14971 surfaceNormal.Normalize();
14972 surfaceNormals.Add(surfaceNormal);
14973 }
14974
14975 if (!TryGetApproachMeasurementIndex(reference.Path, reference.PointIndex, out int measurementIndex))
14976 continue;
14977
14978 Vector3D axis = measurementIndex < reference.Path.Normals.Count
14979 ? (Vector3D)reference.Path.Normals[measurementIndex].Clone()
14980 : Vector3D.AxisZ;
14981 if (axis.LengthSquared < 1e-12)
14982 axis = Vector3D.AxisZ;
14983 axis.Normalize();
14984 constrainedAxes.Add(axis);
14985 }
14986
14987 double toleranceDegrees = Math.Clamp(
14988 _pathManager?.FilterConfig.MeasureAngleToleranceDegrees ?? 1.0,
14989 0.0,
14990 5.0);
14991
14992 if (surfaceNormals.Count > 1)
14993 {
14994 Vector3D firstSurfaceNormal = surfaceNormals[0];
14995 if (surfaceNormals.Skip(1).Any(normal =>
14996 Math.Acos(Math.Abs(Math.Clamp(Vector3D.Dot(firstSurfaceNormal, normal), -1.0, 1.0))) * 180.0 / Math.PI >
14997 toleranceDegrees + 1e-9))
14998 {
14999 incompatible = true;
15000 return false;
15001 }
15002 }
15003
15004 if (constrainedAxes.Count == 0)
15005 return false;
15006
15007 // A point cannot safely be kept both on an unknown trimmed face and on an
15008 // approach axis. Keep the visual reuse, but do not expose an unsafe motion.
15009 if (surfaceNormals.Count > 0)
15010 {
15011 incompatible = true;
15012 return true;
15013 }
15014
15015 Vector3D referenceAxis = constrainedAxes[0];
15016 Vector3D sum = new Vector3D(referenceAxis.X, referenceAxis.Y, referenceAxis.Z);
15017 for (int i = 1; i < constrainedAxes.Count; i++)
15018 {
15019 Vector3D candidate = constrainedAxes[i];
15020 double dot = Math.Clamp(Vector3D.Dot(referenceAxis, candidate), -1.0, 1.0);
15021 double axisAngleDegrees = Math.Acos(dot) * 180.0 / Math.PI;
15022 if (axisAngleDegrees > toleranceDegrees + 1e-9)
15023 {
15024 incompatible = true;
15025 return true;
15026 }
15027 sum += candidate;
15028 }
15029
15030 if (sum.LengthSquared < 1e-12)
15031 sum = referenceAxis;
15032 sum.Normalize();
15033 movementAxis = sum;
15034 return true;
15035 }
15036
15037 private Point3D ConstrainSharedWaypointPosition(WaypointData waypointData, Point3D candidate)
15038 {
15039 if (!TryGetSharedWaypointMovementAxis(waypointData, out Vector3D axis, out bool incompatible) || incompatible)
15040 return candidate;
15041
15042 Point3D origin = waypointData.OriginalPosition ?? waypointData.Path.Points[waypointData.PointIndex];
15043 double requestedDistance = Vector3D.Dot(new Vector3D(origin, candidate), axis);
15044 double minimumDistance = double.NegativeInfinity;
15045 double maximumDistance = double.PositiveInfinity;
15046
15047 foreach (var reference in GetValidWaypointReferences(waypointData))
15048 {
15049 if (!TryGetApproachMeasurementIndex(reference.Path, reference.PointIndex, out int measurementIndex))
15050 continue;
15051
15052 Point3D measurementPoint = reference.Path.Points[measurementIndex];
15053 Vector3D normal = measurementIndex < reference.Path.Normals.Count
15054 ? (Vector3D)reference.Path.Normals[measurementIndex].Clone()
15055 : Vector3D.AxisZ;
15056 if (normal.LengthSquared < 1e-12)
15057 normal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
15058 normal.Normalize();
15059
15060 double initialHeight = Vector3D.Dot(new Vector3D(measurementPoint, origin), normal);
15061 double coefficient = Vector3D.Dot(axis, normal);
15062 if (Math.Abs(coefficient) < 1e-12)
15063 continue;
15064
15065 double boundary = -initialHeight / coefficient;
15066 if (coefficient > 0.0)
15067 minimumDistance = Math.Max(minimumDistance, boundary);
15068 else
15069 maximumDistance = Math.Min(maximumDistance, boundary);
15070 }
15071
15072 if (minimumDistance <= maximumDistance)
15073 requestedDistance = Math.Clamp(requestedDistance, minimumDistance, maximumDistance);
15074 else
15075 requestedDistance = 0.0;
15076
15077 return origin + axis * requestedDistance;
15078 }
15079
15080 private void ApplySharedWaypointPosition(WaypointData waypointData, Point3D position)
15081 {
15082 var affectedPaths = new HashSet<ColorPath>();
15083 foreach (var reference in GetValidWaypointReferences(waypointData))
15084 {
15085 reference.Path.Points[reference.PointIndex] = (Point3D)position.Clone();
15086 affectedPaths.Add(reference.Path);
15087 }
15088
15089 foreach (var path in affectedPaths)
15090 {
15091 if (path.PathEntity != null)
15092 {
15093 path.PathEntity.Vertices = path.Points.ToArray();
15094 path.PathEntity.Regen(0.1);
15095 }
15096 _pathManager?.UpdatePathSegmentVertices(path);
15097 }
15098 }
15099
15100 private void SetPathPointPositionWithSharedOccurrences(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, Point3D position)
15101 {
15102 Entity? sharedMarker = path.WaypointEntities?.FirstOrDefault(entity =>
15103 entity.EntityData is WaypointData data && data.GetReferences().Any(reference =>
15104 ReferenceEquals(reference.Path, path) && reference.PointIndex == pointIndex));
15105
15106 if (sharedMarker?.EntityData is WaypointData sharedData)
15107 ApplySharedWaypointPosition(sharedData, position);
15108 else if (pointIndex >= 0 && pointIndex < path.Points.Count)
15109 path.Points[pointIndex] = (Point3D)position.Clone();
15110 }
15111
15112 private void UpdateOtherSharedSurfaceMeasurementOccurrences(
15113 WaypointData waypointData,
15114 Point3D originalPosition,
15115 Point3D snappedPosition,
15116 bool primaryWasSurfaceMeasurement)
15117 {
15118 var references = GetValidWaypointReferences(waypointData);
15119 var firstSurfaceReference = references.FirstOrDefault(IsSurfaceMeasurementReference);
15120 if (firstSurfaceReference == null)
15121 return;
15122
15123 Vector3D sharedSurfaceNormal = firstSurfaceReference.PointIndex < firstSurfaceReference.Path.Normals.Count
15124 ? (Vector3D)firstSurfaceReference.Path.Normals[firstSurfaceReference.PointIndex].Clone()
15125 : Vector3D.AxisZ;
15126
15127 if (_draggingMeasurePointBrep != null && _draggingMeasurePointFace != null)
15128 {
15129 try
15130 {
15131 Vector3D exactNormal = _draggingMeasurePointBrep.Faces[_draggingMeasurePointFace.FaceIndex].Normal(snappedPosition);
15132 if (exactNormal != null && exactNormal.LengthSquared > 1e-12)
15133 sharedSurfaceNormal = exactNormal;
15134 }
15135 catch
15136 {
15137 // Retain the generated normal when exact evaluation is unavailable.
15138 }
15139 }
15140
15141 if (sharedSurfaceNormal.LengthSquared < 1e-12)
15142 sharedSurfaceNormal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
15143 sharedSurfaceNormal.Normalize();
15144
15145 foreach (var reference in references.Where(IsSurfaceMeasurementReference))
15146 {
15147 if (primaryWasSurfaceMeasurement &&
15148 ReferenceEquals(reference.Path, waypointData.Path) &&
15149 reference.PointIndex == waypointData.PointIndex)
15150 {
15151 continue;
15152 }
15153
15154 Vector3D occurrenceNormal = new Vector3D(
15155 sharedSurfaceNormal.X,
15156 sharedSurfaceNormal.Y,
15157 sharedSurfaceNormal.Z);
15158 if (reference.PointIndex < reference.Path.Normals.Count &&
15159 Vector3D.Dot(occurrenceNormal, reference.Path.Normals[reference.PointIndex]) < 0.0)
15160 {
15161 occurrenceNormal = new Vector3D(
15162 -occurrenceNormal.X,
15163 -occurrenceNormal.Y,
15164 -occurrenceNormal.Z);
15165 }
15166 reference.Path.Normals[reference.PointIndex] = occurrenceNormal;
15167
15168 foreach (int neighborIndex in new[] { reference.PointIndex - 1, reference.PointIndex + 1 })
15169 {
15170 if (!TryGetApproachMeasurementIndex(reference.Path, neighborIndex, out int measurementIndex) ||
15171 measurementIndex != reference.PointIndex)
15172 {
15173 continue;
15174 }
15175
15176 bool belongsToMeasurement = true;
15177 if (reference.Path.OriginalPoints != null &&
15178 reference.PointIndex < reference.Path.OriginalPoints.Count &&
15179 neighborIndex >= 0 && neighborIndex < reference.Path.OriginalPoints.Count)
15180 {
15181 belongsToMeasurement = reference.Path.OriginalPoints[neighborIndex]
15182 .DistanceTo(reference.Path.OriginalPoints[reference.PointIndex]) <= 100.0;
15183 }
15184 if (!belongsToMeasurement)
15185 continue;
15186
15187 Point3D originalApproachPosition = _indirectlyMovedSharedPoints?
15188 .FirstOrDefault(item =>
15189 ReferenceEquals(item.Path, reference.Path) && item.PointIndex == neighborIndex)
15190 .OldPosition ?? reference.Path.Points[neighborIndex];
15191 double offsetDistance = originalApproachPosition.DistanceTo(originalPosition);
15192 if (offsetDistance < 0.001)
15193 offsetDistance = 15.0;
15194 Point3D approachPosition = snappedPosition + occurrenceNormal * offsetDistance;
15195 SetPathPointPositionWithSharedOccurrences(reference.Path, neighborIndex, approachPosition);
15196 reference.Path.Normals[neighborIndex] = occurrenceNormal;
15197 }
15198 }
15199 }
15200
15201 private void CaptureSharedSurfaceDependentPoints(WaypointData waypointData)
15202 {
15203 _indirectlyMovedSharedPoints ??= new List<(ColorPath Path, int PointIndex, Point3D OldPosition)>();
15204
15205 foreach (var measurementReference in GetValidWaypointReferences(waypointData)
15206 .Where(IsSurfaceMeasurementReference))
15207 {
15208 foreach (int neighborIndex in new[]
15209 {
15210 measurementReference.PointIndex - 1,
15211 measurementReference.PointIndex + 1
15212 })
15213 {
15214 if (!TryGetApproachMeasurementIndex(
15215 measurementReference.Path,
15216 neighborIndex,
15217 out int measurementIndex) ||
15218 measurementIndex != measurementReference.PointIndex)
15219 {
15220 continue;
15221 }
15222
15223 Entity? marker = measurementReference.Path.WaypointEntities?.FirstOrDefault(entity =>
15224 entity.EntityData is WaypointData markerData && markerData.GetReferences().Any(reference =>
15225 ReferenceEquals(reference.Path, measurementReference.Path) &&
15226 reference.PointIndex == neighborIndex));
15227
15228 var dependentReferences = marker?.EntityData is WaypointData sharedData
15229 ? GetValidWaypointReferences(sharedData)
15230 : new List<WaypointReference>
15231 {
15232 new WaypointReference
15233 {
15234 Path = measurementReference.Path,
15235 PointIndex = neighborIndex
15236 }
15237 };
15238
15239 foreach (var dependent in dependentReferences)
15240 {
15241 if (_indirectlyMovedSharedPoints.Any(item =>
15242 ReferenceEquals(item.Path, dependent.Path) &&
15243 item.PointIndex == dependent.PointIndex))
15244 {
15245 continue;
15246 }
15247
15248 _indirectlyMovedSharedPoints.Add((
15249 dependent.Path,
15250 dependent.PointIndex,
15251 (Point3D)dependent.Path.Points[dependent.PointIndex].Clone()));
15252
15253 if (!ReferenceEquals(dependent.Path, waypointData.Path) &&
15254 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo != null &&
15255 !_otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Any(item =>
15256 ReferenceEquals(item.Path, dependent.Path)))
15257 {
15258 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Add((
15259 dependent.Path,
15260 dependent.Path.CloneState()));
15261 }
15262 }
15263 }
15264 }
15265 }

15270 private void ManipulateObject(object parameter)
15271 {
15272 try
15273 {
15274 // Identify the main part entity
15275 Entity? partEntity = ResolvePartEntity(parameter);
15276 if (partEntity == null) return;
15277
15278 if (partEntity.EntityData is WaypointData)
15279 {
15280 // Waypoints should be moved via direct mouse dragging. Using ObjectManipulator on them
15281 // is blocked to prevent accidental trajectory recalculation logic.
15282 return;
15283 }
15284
15285 _isPartManipulating = true;
15286 _pathManager?.SavePathSnapshot();
15287
15288 var allParts = _designControl.Entities.Where(IsValidPartEntity).ToList();
15289 bool isMultiPart = allParts.Count > 1;
15290 var shellMeshEntities = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.LayerName != null && e.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
15291 bool hasShellMesh = shellMeshEntities.Count > 0;
15292 bool moveAllParts = false;
15293
15294 if (isMultiPart && hasShellMesh)
15295 {
15296 var result = MessageBox.Show(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBoxQuestion_MoveAllPartsWithShell") ?? "You are moving a part in a multiple part setup. Do you want to move all the parts together? If you choose 'No' to move only this part, the generated shell mesh will become broken and will require regenerating.", "SmartFitSystems", MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Question);
15297 moveAllParts = result == MessageBoxResult.Yes;
15298 }
15299
15300 var associatedEntities = GetManipulationEntitiesForPart(partEntity);
15301 if (moveAllParts)
15302 {
15303 foreach (var part in allParts)
15304 {
15305 var assoc = GetManipulationEntitiesForPart(part);
15306 foreach (var a in assoc)
15307 {
15308 if (!associatedEntities.Contains(a))
15309 associatedEntities.Add(a);
15310 }
15311 }
15312 }
15313
15314 // Always include shell mesh entities so the manipulator captures and moves them
15315 // via Apply(), regardless of whether all parts are being moved together or not.
15316 foreach (var shellMeshEntity in shellMeshEntities)
15317 {
15318 if (!associatedEntities.Contains(shellMeshEntity))
15319 associatedEntities.Add(shellMeshEntity);
15320 }
15321
15322 var entitiesToManipulate = associatedEntities
15323 .Where(e => e != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(e))
15324 .Distinct()
15325 .ToList();
15326
15327 // Select all associated entities
15328 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
15329 foreach (var ent in entitiesToManipulate)
15330 {
15331 ent.Selected = true;
15332 }
15333
15334 // Calculate manipulator position - Align with Bounding Box min or Part Origin for CNC origin representation
15335 partEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
15336 Point3D partOrigin = partEntity.BoxMin;
15337
15338 var originEntity = associatedEntities.FirstOrDefault(e => IsPartOriginEntityForPart(e, partEntity));
15339 if (originEntity is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference brOrigin)
15340 {
15341 partOrigin = brOrigin.InsertionPoint;
15342 }
15343
15344 // Enable manipulator at partOrigin
15345 _initialTriadTrans = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateTranslation(partOrigin.X, partOrigin.Y, partOrigin.Z);
15346 _manipulatingEntity = partEntity;
15347
15348 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateX.Visible = true;
15349 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateX.Selectable = true;
15350 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateY.Visible = true;
15351 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateY.Selectable = true;
15352 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateZ.Visible = true;
15353 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateZ.Selectable = true;
15354
15355 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateX.Visible = true;
15356 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateX.Selectable = true;
15357 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateY.Visible = true;
15358 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateY.Selectable = true;
15359 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateZ.Visible = true;
15360 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateZ.Selectable = true;
15361
15362 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Ball.Visible = true;
15363 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Ball.Selectable = true;
15364
15365 _designControl.Invalidate();
15366 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Enable(_initialTriadTrans, false);
15367
15368 }
15369 catch (Exception ex)
15370 {
15371 Debug.WriteLine($"Error in ManipulateObject: {ex.Message}");
15372 }
15373 }

15380 private static bool IsBridgeManipulationType(string? pointType) =>
15381 string.Equals(pointType, "Bridge", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
15382 string.Equals(pointType, "BridgeIntermediary", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

15389 private static bool IsPathVisualEntity(Entity ent) =>
15390 ent.EntityData is WaypointData ||
15391 ent.EntityData is PathSegmentData ||
15392 (ent.LayerName != null && ent.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX));

15399 private static bool IsBridgePathVisualEntity(Entity ent)
15400 {
15401 if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData waypointData)
15402 return IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(waypointData.Path, waypointData.PointIndex));
15403
15404 if (ent.EntityData is PathSegmentData segmentData)
15405 {
15406 return IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(segmentData.Path, segmentData.StartIndex)) ||
15407 IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(segmentData.Path, segmentData.EndIndex));
15408 }
15409
15410 return false;
15411 }

15418 private List<Entity> GetManipulationEntitiesForPart(Entity partEntity)
15419 {
15420 var entities = GetAssociatedEntities(partEntity);
15421 int partIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(partEntity);
15422 if (partIndex >= 0)
15423 {
15424 RepairMissingPathPointOwnershipFromModelGeometry();
15425 var fallbackColors = GetExclusiveFallbackColorsForPart(partIndex);
15426 entities.AddRange(GetPartPathVisualEntities(partIndex, fallbackColors));
15427 }
15428
15429 return entities.Where(e => e != null).Distinct().ToList();
15430 }

15438 private List<Entity> GetPartPathVisualEntities(int partIndex, HashSet<Color> exclusiveFallbackColors)
15439 {
15440 var result = new List<Entity>();
15441 if (_pathManager == null || _pathManager.ColorPaths == null || !_pathManager.ColorPaths.Any())
15442 return result;
15443
15444 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
15445 {
15446 if (ent == null)
15447 continue;
15448
15449 if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData waypointData)
15450 {
15451 if (IsNonBridgePathPointForPart(waypointData.Path, waypointData.PointIndex, partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors))
15452 result.Add(ent);
15453 }
15454 else if (ent.EntityData is PathSegmentData segmentData)
15455 {
15456 if (IsNonBridgePathSegmentForPart(segmentData.Path, segmentData.StartIndex, segmentData.EndIndex, partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors))
15457 {
15458 result.Add(ent);
15459 }
15460 }
15461 }
15462
15463 return result;
15464 }

15472 private HashSet<Color> GetPathColorsForPart(int partIndex, HashSet<Color> exclusiveFallbackColors)
15473 {
15474 var colors = new HashSet<Color>();
15475 if (_pathManager == null || _pathManager.ColorPaths == null)
15476 return colors;
15477
15478 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
15479 {
15480 var path = kvp.Value;
15481 if (path.Points == null)
15482 continue;
15483
15484 if (HasUsablePathPointOwnership(path))
15485 {
15486 if (path.PointEntityIndices.Any(idx => idx == partIndex))
15487 colors.Add(kvp.Key);
15488 }
15489 else if (ColorSetContains(exclusiveFallbackColors, kvp.Key) ||
15490 ColorSetContains(exclusiveFallbackColors, path.Color))
15491 {
15492 colors.Add(kvp.Key);
15493 }
15494 }
15495
15496 return colors;
15497 }

15552 .Select(face => face.EntityIndex)

15554 .Distinct()
15555 .ToList();

15576 private static bool IsNonBridgePathSegmentForPart(ColorPath path, int startIndex, int endIndex, int partIndex, HashSet<Color> exclusiveFallbackColors)
15577 {
15578 if (path == null ||
15579 path.Points == null ||
15580 startIndex < 0 ||
15581 endIndex < 0 ||
15582 startIndex >= path.Points.Count ||
15583 endIndex >= path.Points.Count)
15584 {
15585 return false;
15586 }
15587
15588 if (IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, startIndex)) ||
15589 IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, endIndex)))
15590 return false;
15591
15592 bool startPertinent = IsNonBridgePathPointForPart(path, startIndex, partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors);
15593 bool endPertinent = IsNonBridgePathPointForPart(path, endIndex, partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors);
15594 if (!startPertinent && !endPertinent)
15595 return false;
15596
15597 return !IsPathPointOwnedByAnotherPart(path, startIndex, partIndex) &&
15598 !IsPathPointOwnedByAnotherPart(path, endIndex, partIndex);
15599 }
15600
15609 private static bool IsNonBridgePathPointForPart(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, int partIndex, HashSet<Color> exclusiveFallbackColors)
15610 {
15611 if (path == null ||
15612 path.Points == null ||
15613 pointIndex < 0 ||
15614 pointIndex >= path.Points.Count)
15615 {
15616 return false;
15617 }
15618
15619 if (IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, pointIndex)))
15620 return false;
15621
15622 return IsPathPointPertinentToPart(path, pointIndex, partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors);
15623 }
15624
15633 private static bool IsPathPointPertinentToPart(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, int partIndex, HashSet<Color> exclusiveFallbackColors)
15634 {
15635 if (path == null ||
15636 path.Points == null ||
15637 pointIndex < 0 ||
15638 pointIndex >= path.Points.Count)
15639 {
15640 return false;
15641 }
15642
15643 if (HasUsablePathPointOwnership(path))
15644 {
15645 int ownerIndex = GetPathPointOwnerIndex(path, pointIndex);
15646 if (ownerIndex == partIndex)
15647 return true;
15648 if (ownerIndex >= 0)
15649 return false;
15650
15651 return IsUnownedPointInsidePartRun(path, pointIndex, partIndex);
15652 }
15653
15654 return ColorSetContains(exclusiveFallbackColors, path.Color);
15655 }
15656
15664 private static bool IsUnownedPointInsidePartRun(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, int partIndex)
15665 {
15666 if (path.Points == null ||
15667 pointIndex < 0 ||
15668 pointIndex >= path.Points.Count ||
15669 IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, pointIndex)))
15670 {
15671 return false;
15672 }
15673
15674 int runStart = pointIndex;
15675 while (runStart > 0 && !IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, runStart - 1)))
15676 runStart--;
15677
15678 int runEnd = pointIndex;
15679 while (runEnd + 1 < path.Points.Count && !IsBridgeManipulationType(GetPathPointType(path, runEnd + 1)))
15680 runEnd++;
15681
15682 bool runHasSelectedPart = false;
15683 bool runHasOtherPart = false;
15684 for (int i = runStart; i <= runEnd; i++)
15685 {
15686 int ownerIndex = GetPathPointOwnerIndex(path, i);
15687 if (ownerIndex == partIndex)
15688 runHasSelectedPart = true;
15689 else if (ownerIndex >= 0)
15690 runHasOtherPart = true;
15691 }
15692
15693 return runHasSelectedPart && !runHasOtherPart;
15694 }
15695
15703 private static bool IsPathPointOwnedByAnotherPart(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, int partIndex)
15704 {
15705 int ownerIndex = GetPathPointOwnerIndex(path, pointIndex);
15706 return ownerIndex >= 0 && ownerIndex != partIndex;
15707 }

15715 private static int GetPathPointOwnerIndex(ColorPath path, int pointIndex)
15716 {

15721 : -1;

15729 private static bool HasUsablePathPointOwnership(ColorPath path)
15730 {
15731 return path?.Points != null &&
15732 path.PointEntityIndices != null &&
15733 path.PointEntityIndices.Count == path.Points.Count &&
15734 path.PointEntityIndices.Any(index => index >= 0);
15735 }

15743 private static string? GetPathPointType(ColorPath path, int pointIndex)

15746 pointIndex >= 0 &&

15749 : null;

15768 private void RestorePathStates(Dictionary<Color, ColorPath> oldStates, HashSet<Color> colorsToRestore)
15769 {
15770 if (_pathManager == null || _pathManager.ColorPaths == null || oldStates == null)

15772
15773 foreach (var color in colorsToRestore)
15774 {
15775 if (!TryGetColorMatchedPathState(oldStates, color, out var oldState, out var stateColor))
15776 continue;
15777
15778 if (TryGetColorMatchedCurrentPath(color, out _, out var currentPath))
15779 currentPath.RestoreState(oldState);
15780 else
15781 _pathManager.ColorPaths[stateColor] = oldState.CloneState();
15782 }
15783 }

15799 private static void CaptureOriginalObjectPathStates(
15800 OriginalObjectPositionState state,
15801 Dictionary<Color, ColorPath>? pathStates,
15802 HashSet<Color>? pathColors)
15803 {
15804 if (state == null || pathStates == null || pathStates.Count == 0)
15805 return;
15806
15807 var colors = pathColors != null && pathColors.Count > 0
15808 ? pathColors
15809 : new HashSet<Color>(pathStates.Keys);
15810
15811 foreach (var color in colors)
15812 {
15813 if (!TryGetColorMatchedPathState(pathStates, color, out var pathState, out var stateColor))
15814 continue;
15815
15816 if (!state.PathStates.Keys.Any(existing => existing.ToArgb() == stateColor.ToArgb()))
15817 state.PathStates[stateColor] = pathState.CloneState();
15818
15819 if (!state.PathColors.Any(existing => existing.ToArgb() == stateColor.ToArgb()))
15820 state.PathColors.Add(stateColor);
15821 }

15882 private static bool TryGetColorMatchedPathState(
15883 Dictionary<Color, ColorPath> states,
15884 Color color,
15885 out ColorPath pathState,
15886 out Color stateColor)
15887 {
15888 if (states.TryGetValue(color, out pathState!))
15889 {
15890 stateColor = color;
15891 return true;
15892 }
15893
15894 foreach (var kvp in states)
15895 {
15896 if (kvp.Key.ToArgb() == color.ToArgb())
15897 {
15898 stateColor = kvp.Key;
15899 pathState = kvp.Value;
15900 return true;
15901 }
15902 }
15903
15904 stateColor = default;
15905 pathState = null!;
15906 return false;
15907 }
15908
15909 private bool TryGetColorMatchedCurrentPath(Color color, out Color currentColor, out ColorPath currentPath)
15910 {
15911 currentColor = default;
15912 currentPath = null!;
15913
15914 if (_pathManager?.ColorPaths == null)
15915 return false;
15916
15917 if (_pathManager.ColorPaths.TryGetValue(color, out currentPath!))
15918 {
15919 currentColor = color;
15920 return true;
15921 }
15922
15923 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
15924 {
15925 if (kvp.Key.ToArgb() == color.ToArgb())
15926 {
15927 currentColor = kvp.Key;
15928 currentPath = kvp.Value;
15929 return true;
15930 }
15931 }
15932
15933 return false;
15934 }
15935
15942 private static bool ColorPathStatesEqual(ColorPath oldState, ColorPath currentState)
15943 {
15944 const double tolerance = 0.001;
15945 if (oldState == null || currentState == null)
15946 return oldState == currentState;
15947
15948 return PointListsEqual(oldState.Points, currentState.Points, tolerance) &&
15949 PointListsEqual(oldState.OriginalPoints, currentState.OriginalPoints, tolerance) &&
15950 VectorListsEqual(oldState.Normals, currentState.Normals, tolerance) &&
15951 VectorListsEqual(oldState.UpVectors, currentState.UpVectors, tolerance) &&
15952 BoolListsEqual(oldState.IsMeasure, currentState.IsMeasure) &&
15953 StringListsEqual(oldState.PointTypes, currentState.PointTypes) &&
15954 IntListsEqual(oldState.PointEntityIndices, currentState.PointEntityIndices) &&
15955 oldState.IsVisible == currentState.IsVisible &&
15956 oldState.ShowPathLines == currentState.ShowPathLines &&
15957 oldState.TrajectoryMode == currentState.TrajectoryMode;
15958 }
15959
15967 private static bool PointListsEqual(IReadOnlyList<Point3D>? first, IReadOnlyList<Point3D>? second, double tolerance)
15968 {
15969 if (first == null || second == null)
15970 return first == second;
15971 if (first.Count != second.Count)
15972 return false;
15973
15974 for (int i = 0; i < first.Count; i++)
15975 {
15976 if (first[i].DistanceTo(second[i]) > tolerance)
15977 return false;
15978 }
15979
15980 return true;
15981 }
15982
15990 private static bool VectorListsEqual(IReadOnlyList<Vector3D>? first, IReadOnlyList<Vector3D>? second, double tolerance)
15991 {
15992 if (first == null || second == null)
15993 return first == second;
15994 if (first.Count != second.Count)
15995 return false;
15996
15997 for (int i = 0; i < first.Count; i++)
15998 {
15999 if (Math.Abs(first[i].X - second[i].X) > tolerance ||
16000 Math.Abs(first[i].Y - second[i].Y) > tolerance ||
16001 Math.Abs(first[i].Z - second[i].Z) > tolerance)
16002 {
16003 return false;
16004 }
16005 }
16006
16007 return true;
16008 }
16009
16016 private static bool BoolListsEqual(IReadOnlyList<bool>? first, IReadOnlyList<bool>? second) =>
16017 (first == null || second == null)
16018 ? first == second
16019 : first.Count == second.Count && first.SequenceEqual(second);
16020
16027 private static bool StringListsEqual(IReadOnlyList<string>? first, IReadOnlyList<string>? second) =>
16028 (first == null || second == null)
16029 ? first == second
16030 : first.Count == second.Count && first.SequenceEqual(second);
16031
16038 private static bool IntListsEqual(IReadOnlyList<int>? first, IReadOnlyList<int>? second) =>
16039 (first == null || second == null)
16040 ? first == second
16041 : first.Count == second.Count && first.SequenceEqual(second);
16042
16046 private void MoveObjectToOrigin(object parameter)
16047 {
16048 try
16049 {
16050 // Cancel any existing manipulation session first
16051 if (_designControl.ObjectManipulator.Visible)
16052 {
16053 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel();
16054 _manipulatingEntity = null;
16055 _isPartManipulating = false;
16056 }
16057
16058 // Identify the main part entity
16059 Entity? partEntity = ResolvePartEntity(parameter);
16060 if (partEntity == null) return;
16061
16062 // --- Find the part origin point (same logic as ManipulateObject) ---
16063 partEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
16064 Point3D partOrigin = partEntity.BoxMin;
16065
16066 var associatedEntities = GetManipulationEntitiesForPart(partEntity);
16067 var originEntity = associatedEntities.FirstOrDefault(e => IsPartOriginEntityForPart(e, partEntity));
16068 if (originEntity is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference brOrigin)
16069 partOrigin = brOrigin.InsertionPoint;
16070
16071 // Skip if already at origin (no-op)
16072 if (Math.Abs(partOrigin.X) < 1e-6 &&
16073 Math.Abs(partOrigin.Y) < 1e-6 &&
16074 Math.Abs(partOrigin.Z) < 1e-6)
16075 return;
16076
16077 // --- Build entity list and indices ---
16078 int partIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(partEntity);
16079 var exclusiveFallbackColors = partIndex >= 0
16080 ? GetExclusiveFallbackColorsForPart(partIndex)
16081 : new HashSet<Color>();
16082 var affectedPathColors = partIndex >= 0
16083 ? GetPathColorsForPart(partIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors)
16084 : new HashSet<Color>();
16085 var oldPathsState = CaptureCurrentPathStates();
16086
16087 var allParts = _designControl.Entities.Where(IsValidPartEntity).ToList();
16088 bool isMultiPart = allParts.Count > 1;
16089 var shellMeshEntities = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.LayerName != null && e.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
16090 bool hasShellMesh = shellMeshEntities.Count > 0;
16091 bool moveAllParts = false;
16092
16093 if (isMultiPart && hasShellMesh)
16094 {
16095 var result = MessageBox.Show(
16096 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBoxQuestion_MoveAllPartsWithShell") ??
16097 "You are moving a part in a multiple part setup. Do you want to move all the parts together? If you choose 'No' to move only this part, the generated shell mesh will become broken and will require regenerating.",
16098 "SmartFitSystems", MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Question);
16099 moveAllParts = result == MessageBoxResult.Yes;
16100 }
16101 else if (!isMultiPart)
16102 {
16103 moveAllParts = true;
16104 }
16105
16106 if (moveAllParts)
16107 {
16108 foreach (var part in allParts)
16109 {
16110 var assoc = GetManipulationEntitiesForPart(part);
16111 foreach (var a in assoc)
16112 if (!associatedEntities.Contains(a))
16113 associatedEntities.Add(a);
16114 }
16115 }
16116
16117 // ALWAYS add shell mesh if it exists, as requested by user
16118 if (hasShellMesh)
16119 {
16120 foreach (var shellMeshEntity in shellMeshEntities)
16121 {
16122 if (!associatedEntities.Contains(shellMeshEntity))
16123 {
16124 associatedEntities.Add(shellMeshEntity);
16125 }
16126 }
16127 }
16128
16129 var movedEntityIndices = new HashSet<int>();
16130 if (moveAllParts)
16131 {
16132 foreach (var part in allParts)
16133 {
16134 int idx = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(part);
16135 if (idx >= 0) movedEntityIndices.Add(idx);
16136 }
16137 affectedPathColors.Clear();
16138 foreach (var idx in movedEntityIndices)
16139 {
16140 var exc = GetExclusiveFallbackColorsForPart(idx);
16141 foreach (var col in GetPathColorsForPart(idx, exc))
16142 affectedPathColors.Add(col);
16143 }
16144 }
16145 else if (partIndex >= 0)
16146 {
16147 movedEntityIndices.Add(partIndex);
16148 }
16149
16150 foreach (var ent in associatedEntities)
16151 {
16152 int idx = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(ent);
16153 if (idx >= 0) movedEntityIndices.Add(idx);
16154 }
16155
16156 bool hasPathsToMove = affectedPathColors.Count > 0;
16157 bool shouldMovePaths = false;
16158 if (hasPathsToMove)
16159 {
16160 var result = MessageBox.Show(
16161 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBoxQuestion_MovePathsWithObject") ??
16162 "Path planning was already generated for this object. Do you want to move the paths alongside the object?",
16163 "SmartFitSystems", MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Question);
16164 shouldMovePaths = result == MessageBoxResult.Yes;
16165 }
16166
16167 var bridgeSnapshot = _pathManager?.CaptureAffectedBridgeState(movedEntityIndices, exclusiveFallbackColors);
16168
16169 // Build the translation
16170 Vector3D translation = new Vector3D(-partOrigin.X, -partOrigin.Y, -partOrigin.Z);
16171 devDept.Geometry.Transformation trans = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateTranslation(translation);
16172
16173 // STEP 1: Transform all geometry entities
16174 var traversalParams = new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams(_designControl);
16175 foreach (var ent in associatedEntities)
16176 {
16177 if (ent != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(ent))
16178 {
16179 ent.TransformBy(trans);
16180 ent.UpdateBoundingBox(traversalParams);
16181 }
16182 }
16183
16184 // STEP 2: Transform associated grid
16185 devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid? associatedGrid = null;
16186 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
16187 {
16188 foreach (var grid in _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.Skip(1))
16189 {
16190 if (Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.X - partOrigin.X) < 1.0 &&
16191 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Y - partOrigin.Y) < 1.0 &&
16192 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Z - partOrigin.Z) < 1.0)
16193 {
16194 associatedGrid = grid;
16195 break;
16196 }
16197 }
16198 if (associatedGrid != null)
16199 {
16200 var plane = associatedGrid.Plane;
16201 plane.TransformBy(trans);
16202 associatedGrid.Plane = plane;
16203 }
16204 }
16205 CleanUpOverlappingOriginGrids();
16206
16207 // STEP 3: Regen Brep tessellation BEFORE rebuilding overlays
16208 // so GenerateOverlayForFace uses the new post-move face geometry.
16209 foreach (var idx in movedEntityIndices)
16210 {
16211 if (idx >= 0 && idx < _designControl.Entities.Count &&
16212 _designControl.Entities[idx] is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Brep brepToRegen)
16213 {
16214 brepToRegen.Regen(new devDept.Eyeshot.RegenParams(0.01, _designControl));
16215 }
16216 }
16217
16218 if (!moveAllParts && hasShellMesh)
16219 {
16220 // Relies on live fingerprint validation to regenerate automatically
16221 }
16222 else if (hasShellMesh)
16223 _pathManager?.TransformShellCache(trans);
16224
16225 // STEP 4: Paths
16226 foreach (var idx in movedEntityIndices)
16227 TransformCadPlanningMetadataForEntities(new HashSet<int> { idx }, trans);
16228
16229 if (hasPathsToMove && _pathManager != null)
16230 {
16231 if (shouldMovePaths)
16232 {
16233 var changedPathColors = _pathManager.ApplyPartMoveToPathDataFromSnapshot(
16234 oldPathsState, movedEntityIndices, exclusiveFallbackColors, trans);
16235 foreach (var color in _pathManager.ReconnectAffectedHighZBridges(bridgeSnapshot, movedEntityIndices, exclusiveFallbackColors, trans))
16236 changedPathColors.Add(color);
16237 foreach (var color in changedPathColors)
16238 affectedPathColors.Add(color);
16239 _pathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
16240 }
16241 else
16242 {
16243 RestorePathStates(oldPathsState, affectedPathColors);
16244 _pathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
16245 }
16246 }
16247
16248 // STEP 5: Rebuild IgnoredItems overlay
16249 int mainPartIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(partEntity);
16250 if (mainPartIndex >= 0)
16251 _ignoredItemManager?.ApplyTransformation(mainPartIndex, trans);
16252 _ignoredItemManager?.SyncVisibility();
16253
16254 // STEP 6: Undo command
16255 var compositeCommands = new List<IUndoCommand>();
16256 var movedGeometryEntities = associatedEntities
16257 .Where(e => e != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(e))
16258 .Distinct()
16259 .ToList();
16260 if (!movedGeometryEntities.Contains(partEntity))
16261 movedGeometryEntities.Add(partEntity);
16262
16263 var finalMovedEntityIndices = movedEntityIndices
16264 .Where(idx => idx >= 0 && idx < _designControl.Entities.Count)
16265 .ToHashSet();
16266
16267 var ignoredParents = finalMovedEntityIndices
16268 .Select(idx => _designControl.Entities[idx])
16269 .ToList();
16270
16271 if (movedGeometryEntities.Count > 0)
16272 {
16273 compositeCommands.Add(new MovePartCommand(
16274 _designControl,
16275 movedGeometryEntities,
16276 trans,
16277 _ignoredItemManager,
16278 ignoredParents));
16279 }
16280
16281 if (finalMovedEntityIndices.Count > 0)
16282 {
16283 var metadataEntityIndices = new HashSet<int>(finalMovedEntityIndices);
16284 var metadataRedoTransform = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)trans.Clone();
16285 var metadataUndoTransform = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)trans.Clone();
16286 metadataUndoTransform.Invert();
16287 compositeCommands.Add(new ActionUndoCommand(
16288 undoAction: () =>
16289 {
16290 TransformCadPlanningMetadataForEntities(metadataEntityIndices, (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)metadataUndoTransform.Clone());
16291 if (!moveAllParts && hasShellMesh)
16292 {
16293 // Relies on live fingerprint validation to regenerate automatically
16294 }
16295 else if (hasShellMesh)
16296 _pathManager?.TransformShellCache((devDept.Geometry.Transformation)metadataUndoTransform.Clone());
16297 },
16298 redoAction: () =>
16299 {
16300 TransformCadPlanningMetadataForEntities(metadataEntityIndices, (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)metadataRedoTransform.Clone());
16301 if (!moveAllParts && hasShellMesh)
16302 {
16303 // Relies on live fingerprint validation to regenerate automatically
16304 }
16305 else if (hasShellMesh)
16306 _pathManager?.TransformShellCache((devDept.Geometry.Transformation)metadataRedoTransform.Clone());
16307 },
16308 description: "Updated CAD planning metadata for moved object to origin",
16309 category: "Part Manipulation"));
16310 }
16311
16312 if (hasPathsToMove && _pathManager != null && _pathManager.ColorPaths != null)
16313 {
16314 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
16315 {
16316 if (oldPathsState.TryGetValue(kvp.Key, out var oldState))
16317 {
16318 var cp = kvp.Value;
16319 if (!ColorPathStatesEqual(oldState, cp))
16320 compositeCommands.Add(new UpdateColorPathCommand(_pathManager, _designControl, kvp.Key, oldState, cp.CloneState(), regenerateAllPaths: true));
16321 }
16322 }
16323 }
16324
16325 if (compositeCommands.Count == 1)
16326 UndoManager.PushCommand(compositeCommands[0]);
16327 else if (compositeCommands.Count > 1)
16328 UndoManager.PushCommand(new CompositeCommand(compositeCommands));
16329
16330 // Transform cached shell mesh DTOs so they stay in sync with the moved geometry.
16331 // This must happen before Regen() which can destroy standalone Mesh vertex data.
16332 TransformCachedShellMeshDTOs(trans);
16333
16334 _designControl.Entities.UpdateBoundingBox();
16335 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
16336 _designControl.ZoomFit();
16337 _designControl.Invalidate();
16338
16339 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
16340 StoreOriginalPosition(partEntity, associatedEntities, trans, associatedGrid, oldPathsState, affectedPathColors);
16341 }
16342 catch (Exception ex)
16343 {
16344 Debug.WriteLine($"Error in MoveObjectToOrigin: {ex.Message}");
16345 }
16346 }
16347
16348 private sealed class OriginalObjectPositionState
16349
16350 {
16351 public List<(Entity ent, devDept.Geometry.Transformation trans)> Entities { get; } = new();
16352 public devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid? Grid { get; set; }
16353 public devDept.Geometry.Transformation GridTransform { get; set; } = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateIdentity();
16354 public Dictionary<Color, ColorPath> PathStates { get; } = new();
16355 public HashSet<Color> PathColors { get; } = new();
16356 }
16357
16358 private Dictionary<Entity, OriginalObjectPositionState> _originalPositions = new();
16359
16367 private void StoreOriginalPosition(
16368 Entity mainPart,
16369 List<Entity> associated,
16370 devDept.Geometry.Transformation appliedTrans,
16371 devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid? grid = null,
16372 Dictionary<Color, ColorPath>? pathStates = null,
16373 HashSet<Color>? pathColors = null)
16374 {
16375 if (!_originalPositions.ContainsKey(mainPart))
16376 {
16377 var state = new OriginalObjectPositionState
16378 {
16379 Grid = grid
16380 };
16381
16382 foreach (var ent in associated.Where(ent => ent != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(ent)).Distinct())
16383 {
16384 // We store the inverse of the applied transformation to get back
16385 var inverse = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)appliedTrans.Clone();
16386 inverse.Invert();
16387 state.Entities.Add((ent, inverse));
16388 }
16389
16390 var gridInverse = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)appliedTrans.Clone();
16391 gridInverse.Invert();
16392 state.GridTransform = gridInverse;
16393 CaptureOriginalObjectPathStates(state, pathStates, pathColors);
16394
16395 _originalPositions[mainPart] = state;
16396 }
16397 else
16398 {
16399 // Update existing stored inverse by multiplying
16400 var inverse = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)appliedTrans.Clone();
16401 inverse.Invert();
16402 var current = _originalPositions[mainPart];
16403
16404 for (int i = 0; i < current.Entities.Count; i++)
16405 {
16406 var item = current.Entities[i];
16407 current.Entities[i] = (item.ent, inverse * item.trans);
16408 }
16409
16410 current.Grid ??= grid;
16411 current.GridTransform = inverse * current.GridTransform;
16412 CaptureOriginalObjectPathStates(current, pathStates, pathColors);
16413 }
16414 }
16415
16421 private void TransformCadPlanningMetadataForEntities(HashSet<int> entityIndices, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16422 {
16423 if (entityIndices == null || entityIndices.Count == 0 || transform == null)
16424 return;
16425
16426 var transformedFaces = new HashSet<CADFace>();
16427 var transformedFaceIndices = new HashSet<int>();
16428
16429 foreach (var face in EnumerateCadPlanningFaces())
16430 {
16431 if (face == null || !entityIndices.Contains(face.EntityIndex) || !transformedFaces.Add(face))
16432 continue;
16433
16434 TransformFacePointList(face.KeyPoints, transform);
16435 TransformPoint4DList(face.ControlPoints, transform);
16436 TransformPoint4DList(face.MeasurementPoints, transform);
16437 face.GeometricInfo = TransformGeometricInfoVectors(face.GeometricInfo, transform);
16438
16439 if (face.FaceGlobalIndex > 0)
16440 transformedFaceIndices.Add(face.FaceGlobalIndex);
16441 }
16442
16443 if (transformedFaceIndices.Count == 0)
16444 return;
16445
16446 var transformedHoles = new HashSet<CADHole>();
16447 foreach (var hole in EnumerateCadPlanningHoles())
16448 {
16449 if (hole == null ||
16450 hole.FaceGlobalIndices == null ||
16451 !hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Any(transformedFaceIndices.Contains) ||
16452 !transformedHoles.Add(hole))
16453 continue;
16454
16455 hole.TopCenterPoint = TransformNullablePoint3D(hole.TopCenterPoint, transform);
16456 hole.BottomCenterPoint = TransformNullablePoint3D(hole.BottomCenterPoint, transform);
16457 if (hole.AxisDirection != null)
16458 hole.AxisDirection = TransformDirection(hole.AxisDirection, transform);
16459 hole.GeometricInfo = TransformGeometricInfoVectors(hole.GeometricInfo, transform);
16460 }
16461 }
16462
16467 private IEnumerable<CADFace> EnumerateCadPlanningFaces()
16468 {
16469 foreach (var list in _allFacesByColor?.Values ?? Enumerable.Empty<List<CADFace>>())
16470 {
16471 foreach (var face in list)
16472 yield return face;
16473 }
16474
16475 foreach (var list in _facesByColor?.Values ?? Enumerable.Empty<List<CADFace>>())
16476 {
16477 foreach (var face in list)
16478 yield return face;
16479 }
16480 }
16481
16486 private IEnumerable<CADHole> EnumerateCadPlanningHoles()
16487 {
16488 foreach (var list in _holesByColor?.Values ?? Enumerable.Empty<List<CADHole>>())
16489 {
16490 foreach (var hole in list)
16491 yield return hole;
16492 }
16493 }

16500 private static void TransformFacePointList(List<FacePoint>? points, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16501 {
16502 if (points == null)
16503 return;
16504
16505 foreach (var point in points)
16506 {
16507 if (point == null)
16508 continue;
16509
16510 var transformed = TransformPoint3D(new Point3D(point.X, point.Y, point.Z), transform);
16511 point.X = transformed.X;
16512 point.Y = transformed.Y;
16513 point.Z = transformed.Z;
16514 }
16515 }
16516
16522 private static void TransformPoint4DList(List<Point4D>? points, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16523 {
16524 if (points == null)
16525 return;
16526
16527 for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
16528 {
16529 var point = points[i];
16530 var transformed = TransformPoint3D(new Point3D(point.X, point.Y, point.Z), transform);
16531 point.X = transformed.X;
16532 point.Y = transformed.Y;
16533 point.Z = transformed.Z;
16534 points[i] = point;
16535 }
16536 }
16537
16544 private static Point3D? TransformNullablePoint3D(Point3D? point, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16545 {
16546 if (point == null)
16547 return null;
16548
16549 return TransformPoint3D(point, transform);
16550 }
16551
16558 private static Point3D TransformPoint3D(Point3D point, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16559 {
16560 var transformed = new Point3D(point.X, point.Y, point.Z);
16561 transformed.TransformBy(transform);
16562 return transformed;
16563 }
16564
16571 private static Vector3D TransformDirection(Vector3D direction, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16572 {
16573 var origin = new Point3D(0, 0, 0);
16574 var end = new Point3D(direction.X, direction.Y, direction.Z);
16575 origin.TransformBy(transform);
16576 end.TransformBy(transform);
16577
16578 var transformed = new Vector3D(end.X - origin.X, end.Y - origin.Y, end.Z - origin.Z);
16579 if (transformed.Length > 1e-8)
16580 transformed.Normalize();
16581 return transformed;
16582 }
16583
16590 private static string? TransformGeometricInfoVectors(string? geometricInfo, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16591 {
16592 if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(geometricInfo))
16593 return geometricInfo;
16594
16595 string result = TransformGeometricInfoVector(geometricInfo, "Normal", transform);
16596 result = TransformGeometricInfoVector(result, "Axis", transform);
16597 return result;
16598 }
16599
16607 private static string TransformGeometricInfoVector(string geometricInfo, string label, devDept.Geometry.Transformation transform)
16608 {
16609 return Regex.Replace(
16610 geometricInfo,
16611 $@"({Regex.Escape(label)}:\s*)\‍(([^,]+),\s*([^,]+),\s*([^)]+)\‍)",
16612 match =>
16613 {
16614 if (!double.TryParse(match.Groups[2].Value.Trim(), System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double x) ||
16615 !double.TryParse(match.Groups[3].Value.Trim(), System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double y) ||
16616 !double.TryParse(match.Groups[4].Value.Trim(), System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double z))
16617 {
16618 return match.Value;
16619 }
16620
16621 var transformed = TransformDirection(new Vector3D(x, y, z), transform);
16622 return string.Format(
16623 System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
16624 "{0}({1:0.######}, {2:0.######}, {3:0.######})",
16625 match.Groups[1].Value,
16626 transformed.X,
16627 transformed.Y,
16628 transformed.Z);
16629 },
16630 RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
16631 }

16637 private void ConfigureWaypointManipulator(bool isApproach)
16638 {
16639 if (_designControl == null) return;
16640
16641 if (isApproach)
16642 {
16643 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateX.Visible = false;
16644 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateX.Selectable = false;
16645 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateY.Visible = false;
16646 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateY.Selectable = false;
16647
16648 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateZ.Visible = true;
16649 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.TranslateZ.Selectable = true;
16650
16651 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateX.Visible = false;
16652 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateX.Selectable = false;
16653 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateY.Visible = false;
16654 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateY.Selectable = false;
16655 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.RotateZ.Visible = false;

16812 if ((startType == "Bridge" || startType == "BridgeIntermediary") && (endType == "Bridge" || endType == "BridgeIntermediary"))
16813 {

16870 }
16871
16872 _oldPathStateForWaypointMove = null;
16873 _tempInsertPath = null;
16874 _tempInsertPosition = null;
16875 _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo = null;

16877 var refreshPathManager = _pathManager;

16884
16885 objectManipulator.Cancel();

16888 _manipulatingEntity = null;

16890 }
16891
16892 var selectedEntities = designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.Selected).ToList();
16893
16894 // Check if manipulating a Waypoint
16895 var waypointEntity = (!wasPartManipulating && (_manipulatingEntity != null && _manipulatingEntity.EntityData is WaypointData))
16896 ? _manipulatingEntity
16897 : (!wasPartManipulating ? selectedEntities.FirstOrDefault(e => e.EntityData is WaypointData) : null);
16898 if (waypointEntity != null)
16899 {
16900 var data = (WaypointData)waypointEntity.EntityData;
16901 var pathManager = _pathManager;
16902
16903 if (wasCustomDragging && _draggingSphere != null)
16904 {
16905 designControl.Entities.Remove(_draggingSphere);
16906 _draggingSphere = null;
16907 }
16908 waypointEntity.Visible = true;
16909
16910 // Select only this entity so ObjectManipulator.Apply applies the transformation to it!
16911 designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
16912 waypointEntity.Selected = true;
16913
16914 objectManipulator.Apply();
16915
16916 Point3D oldPos = (Point3D)data.OriginalPosition.Clone();
16917 Vector3D oldNormal = (Vector3D)data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex].Clone();
16918
16919 Point3D newPos;
16920 if (wasCustomDragging)
16921 {
16922 newPos = _draggingSpherePosition != null ? (Point3D)_draggingSpherePosition.Clone() : (Point3D)data.Path.Points[data.PointIndex].Clone();
16923 deltaTrans = new devDept.Geometry.Transformation(1);
16924 }
16925 else
16926 {
16927 newPos = (Point3D)data.OriginalPosition.Clone();
16928 newPos.TransformBy(deltaTrans);
16929 }
16930 newPos = ConstrainSharedWaypointPosition(data, newPos);
16931
16932 // Do not waste time doing calculations if the point didn't move
16933 if (newPos.DistanceTo(oldPos) < 1e-4)

16935 CancelWaypointManipulation(waypointEntity);
16936 return;
16937 }
16938
16939 bool isMeasure = data.Path.IsMeasure != null && data.PointIndex < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && data.Path.IsMeasure[data.PointIndex];
16940 bool isScanPoint = data.Path.PointTypes != null && data.PointIndex < data.Path.PointTypes.Count && string.Equals(data.Path.PointTypes[data.PointIndex], "scanpoints", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
16941
16942 if (isMeasure && !isScanPoint)
16943 {
16944 Vector3D newNormal = oldNormal;
16945 Point3D snappedPos = newPos;
16946
16947 if (wasCustomDragging)
16948 {
16949 snappedPos = (Point3D)newPos.Clone();
16950 newNormal = (Vector3D)data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex].Clone();
16951 // Recalculate normal at snapped position
16952 if (_draggingMeasurePointBrep != null && _draggingMeasurePointFace != null)
16953 {
16954 try
16955 {
16956 var fn = _draggingMeasurePointBrep.Faces[_draggingMeasurePointFace.FaceIndex].Normal(snappedPos);
16957 if (fn != null && fn.Length > 1e-6)
16958 {
16959 newNormal = fn;
16960 newNormal.Normalize();
16961 }
16962 }
16963 catch { }
16964 }
16965 }
16966 else
16967 {
16968 // Find the parent face from the original position
16969 Entity targetPartForFace = null!;
16970 int targetFaceIndex = -1;
16971 double closestDist = double.MaxValue;
16972
16973 foreach (var ent in designControl.Entities)
16974 {
16975 if (ent is Brep brep)
16976 {
16977 for (int i = 0; i < brep.Faces.Length; i++)
16978 {
16979 try
16980 {
16981 var mesh = brep.Faces[i].ConvertToMesh();
16982 if (mesh != null)
16983 {
16984 var proj = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(oldPos, brep, i);
16985 double dist = proj.DistanceTo(oldPos);
16986 if (dist < closestDist && dist < 1.0)
16987 {
16988 closestDist = dist;
16989 targetPartForFace = brep;
16990 targetFaceIndex = i;
16991 }
16992 }
16993 }
16994 catch { }
16995 }
16996 }
16997 }
16998
16999 if (targetPartForFace is Brep targetBrep && targetFaceIndex != -1)
17000 {
17001 snappedPos = EyeshotGeometryUtils.ProjectPointToFaceSurface(newPos, targetBrep, targetFaceIndex);
17002 try
17003 {
17004 var fn = targetBrep.Faces[targetFaceIndex].Normal(snappedPos);
17005 if (fn != null && fn.Length > 1e-6)
17006 {
17007 newNormal = fn;
17008 newNormal.Normalize();
17009 }
17010 }
17011 catch { }
17012 }
17013 else
17014 {
17015 Entity? targetPart;
17016 snappedPos = SnapToClosestPartSurface(newPos, out newNormal, out targetPart);
17017 }
17018 }
17019
17020 // Align newNormal direction to match the previous normal
17021 Vector3D prevNormal = data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex];
17022 if (Vector3D.Dot(newNormal, prevNormal) < 0)
17023 {
17024 newNormal = new Vector3D(-newNormal.X, -newNormal.Y, -newNormal.Z);
17025 }
17026
17027 // Translate associated approach points (entrance and exit if applicable)
17028 // We move approach point(s) by the exact offset and normal rotation/alignment.
17029 // To stay perpendicular and aligned, the approach point should be placed at the
17030 // snapped position offset by the newNormal * offsetDistance.
17031
17032 // Entry approach point
17033 if (data.PointIndex > 0 && data.Path.IsMeasure != null && !data.Path.IsMeasure[data.PointIndex - 1])
17034 {
17035 bool isOurs = true;
17036 if (data.Path.OriginalPoints != null && data.PointIndex < data.Path.OriginalPoints.Count)
17037 {
17038 double originalOffset = data.Path.OriginalPoints[data.PointIndex - 1].DistanceTo(data.Path.OriginalPoints[data.PointIndex]);
17039 if (originalOffset > 100.0) isOurs = false;
17040 }
17041
17042 if (isOurs)
17043 {
17044 double offsetDistance = data.Path.Points[data.PointIndex - 1].DistanceTo(oldPos);
17045 if (offsetDistance < 0.001) offsetDistance = 15.0;
17046 SetPathPointPositionWithSharedOccurrences(
17047 data.Path,
17048 data.PointIndex - 1,
17049 snappedPos + newNormal * offsetDistance);
17050 data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex - 1] = newNormal;
17051 }
17052 }
17053
17054 // Exit approach point
17055 if (data.PointIndex + 1 < data.Path.Points.Count && data.Path.IsMeasure != null && data.PointIndex + 1 < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !data.Path.IsMeasure[data.PointIndex + 1])
17056 {
17057 bool isOurs = true;
17058 if (data.Path.OriginalPoints != null && data.PointIndex + 1 < data.Path.OriginalPoints.Count)
17059 {
17060 double originalOffset = data.Path.OriginalPoints[data.PointIndex + 1].DistanceTo(data.Path.OriginalPoints[data.PointIndex]);
17061 if (originalOffset > 100.0) isOurs = false;
17062 }
17063
17064 if (isOurs)
17065 {
17066 double offsetDistance = data.Path.Points[data.PointIndex + 1].DistanceTo(oldPos);
17067 if (offsetDistance < 0.001) offsetDistance = 15.0;
17068 SetPathPointPositionWithSharedOccurrences(
17069 data.Path,
17070 data.PointIndex + 1,
17071 snappedPos + newNormal * offsetDistance);
17072 data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex + 1] = newNormal;
17073 }
17074 }
17075
17076 newPos = snappedPos;
17077 data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex] = newNormal;
17078 }
17079 else if (isScanPoint)
17080 {
17081 // Scanner scan point: save translated position directly and keep the normal as is
17082 data.Path.Points[data.PointIndex] = newPos;
17083 }
17084 else
17085 {
17086 // It's an approach/intermediary point.
17087 // Check if it is bound to a measurement point (adjacent).
17088 int mIdx = -1;
17089 if (data.Path.IsMeasure != null && data.PointIndex + 1 < data.Path.Points.Count && data.PointIndex + 1 < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && data.Path.IsMeasure[data.PointIndex + 1])
17090 {
17091 mIdx = data.PointIndex + 1; // It is the entry approach point
17092 }
17093 else if (data.Path.IsMeasure != null && data.PointIndex > 0 && data.PointIndex - 1 < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && data.Path.IsMeasure[data.PointIndex - 1])
17094 {
17095 mIdx = data.PointIndex - 1; // It is the exit approach point
17096 }
17097
17098 if (mIdx != -1)
17099 {
17100 // Bound to a measurement point. Snap to the normal axis of the face of that measurement point.
17101 Point3D measurePt = data.Path.Points[mIdx];
17102 Vector3D normal = data.Path.Normals[mIdx];
17103 if (normal.LengthSquared < 1e-6) normal = Vector3D.AxisZ;
17104 normal.Normalize();
17105
17106 // Project newPos onto the line starting at measurePt along the normal direction.
17107 double t = Vector3D.Dot(new Vector3D(measurePt, newPos), normal);
17108 t = Math.Max(0.0, t); // Cannot go below the surface (inside the part)
17109 Point3D projectedPos = measurePt + normal * t;
17110 newPos = projectedPos;
17111
17112 // If the other approach point (entry/exit) exists, update it to match the projected pos.
17113 if (mIdx - 1 >= 0 && data.Path.IsMeasure != null && mIdx - 1 < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !data.Path.IsMeasure[mIdx - 1])
17114 {
17115 SetPathPointPositionWithSharedOccurrences(data.Path, mIdx - 1, newPos);
17116 data.Path.Normals[mIdx - 1] = normal;
17117 }
17118 if (mIdx + 1 < data.Path.Points.Count && data.Path.IsMeasure != null && mIdx + 1 < data.Path.IsMeasure.Count && !data.Path.IsMeasure[mIdx + 1])
17119 {
17120 SetPathPointPositionWithSharedOccurrences(data.Path, mIdx + 1, newPos);
17121 data.Path.Normals[mIdx + 1] = normal;
17122 }
17123 }
17124 }
17125
17126 if (wasCustomDragging && HasSurfaceMeasurementReference(data))
17127 {
17128 UpdateOtherSharedSurfaceMeasurementOccurrences(
17129 data,
17130 oldPos,
17131 newPos,
17132 isMeasure && !isScanPoint);

17135 ApplySharedWaypointPosition(data, newPos);
17136
17137 if (_otherOverlappingBridgePoints != null && _otherOverlappingBridgePoints.Count > 0)
17138 {
17139 foreach (var item in _otherOverlappingBridgePoints)

17141 var otherPath = item.Path;
17142 int otherIdx = item.PointIndex;
17143 otherPath.Points[otherIdx] = (Point3D)newPos.Clone();
17144 }

17146
17147 data.IsNew = false;
17148 data.OriginalPosition = (Point3D)newPos.Clone();
17149 Vector3D finalNormal = (Vector3D)data.Path.Normals[data.PointIndex].Clone();
17150
17151 // Rebuild once after all shared occurrences have received the final
17152 // coordinate. This recreates one marker at the new exact position and
17153 // avoids transient direct/duplicate markers between color paths.
17154 if (pathManager != null)

17160 if (_oldPathStateForWaypointMove != null && pathManager != null)

17164
17165 if (_otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo != null && _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Count > 0)
17166 {
17167 var commands = new List<IUndoCommand> { mainCommand };
17168 foreach (var info in _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo)
17169 {
17170 commands.Add(new UpdateColorPathCommand(pathManager, designControl, info.Path.Color, info.OldState, info.Path.CloneState()));
17171 }
17172 UndoManager.PushCommand(new CompositeCommand(commands));
17173 }
17174 else
17175 {
17176 UndoManager.PushCommand(mainCommand);
17177 }
17178 }
17179 else
17180 {
17181 var mainCommand = new MoveWaypointCommand(pathManager, designControl, data.Path, data.PointIndex, oldPos, newPos, oldNormal, finalNormal, waypointEntity);
17182 if (pathManager != null && _otherOverlappingBridgePoints != null && _otherOverlappingBridgePoints.Count > 0 && _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo != null && _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo.Count > 0)
17183 {
17184 var commands = new List<IUndoCommand> { mainCommand };
17185 foreach (var info in _otherOverlappingBridgePathsUndoInfo)
17186 {
17187 commands.Add(new UpdateColorPathCommand(pathManager, designControl, info.Path.Color, info.OldState, info.Path.CloneState()));
17188 }
17189 UndoManager.PushCommand(new CompositeCommand(commands));
17190 }
17191 else
17192 {
17193 UndoManager.PushCommand(mainCommand);
17194 }
17195 }
17196
17197 // Record in EditHistory for session persistence
17198 if (pathManager != null)
17199 {
17200 string editGroupId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
17201 pathManager.EditHistory.Add(new PointEditEventDTO
17202 {
17203 EditGroupId = editGroupId,
17204 ColorR = data.Path.Color.R,
17205 ColorG = data.Path.Color.G,
17206 ColorB = data.Path.Color.B,
17207 PointIndex = data.PointIndex,
17208 OldX = oldPos.X,
17209 OldY = oldPos.Y,
17210 OldZ = oldPos.Z,
17211 NewX = newPos.X,
17212 NewY = newPos.Y,
17213 NewZ = newPos.Z
17214 });
17215
17216 if (_otherOverlappingBridgePoints != null && _otherOverlappingBridgePoints.Count > 0)
17217 {
17218 foreach (var item in _otherOverlappingBridgePoints)
17219 {
17220 pathManager.EditHistory.Add(new PointEditEventDTO
17221 {
17222 EditGroupId = editGroupId,

17224 ColorG = item.Path.Color.G,
17225 ColorB = item.Path.Color.B,
17226 PointIndex = item.PointIndex,
17227 OldX = oldPos.X,
17228 OldY = oldPos.Y,
17229 OldZ = oldPos.Z,
17230 NewX = newPos.X,
17231 NewY = newPos.Y,
17232 NewZ = newPos.Z
17233 });
17234 }
17235 }
17236
17237 if (_indirectlyMovedSharedPoints != null)
17238 {
17239 foreach (var item in _indirectlyMovedSharedPoints)

17249 {

17273 objectManipulator.Cancel();

17277 _manipulatingEntity = null;
17278 _prevDragPosition = null;

17281 _indirectlyMovedSharedPoints = null;
