17285 if (!wasPartManipulating)
17286 {
17287 objectManipulator.Cancel();
17288 designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
17289 designControl.Invalidate();
17290 _manipulatingEntity = null;
17291 return;
17292 }
17293
17294 // Identity Transformation Check (Antennae Fix)
17295 bool isIdentity = true;
17296 if (deltaTrans != null)
17297 {
17298 for (int row = 0; row < 4; row++)
17299 {
17300 for (int col = 0; col < 4; col++)
17301 {
17302 double expected = (row == col) ? 1.0 : 0.0;
17303 if (Math.Abs(deltaTrans[row, col] - expected) > 1e-4)
17304 {
17305 isIdentity = false;
17306 break;
17307 }
17308 }
17309 if (!isIdentity) break;
17310 }
17311 }
17312
17313 if (isIdentity)
17314 {
17315 objectManipulator.Cancel();
17316 designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
17317 designControl.Invalidate();
17318 _manipulatingEntity = null;
17319 _isPartManipulating = false;
17320 return;
17321 }
17322
17323 var appliedTransform = deltaTrans!;
17324
17325 var mainPart = _manipulatingEntity ?? ResolvePartEntity(parameter) ?? selectedEntities.FirstOrDefault(e => e is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Brep || e is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Mesh);
17326 if (mainPart != null)
17327 selectedEntities = GetManipulationEntitiesForPart(mainPart);
17328
17329 var selectedPathVisualEntities = selectedEntities
17330 .Where(IsPathVisualEntity)
17331 .Distinct()
17332 .ToList();
17333
17334 selectedEntities = selectedEntities
17335 .Where(e => e != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(e))
17336 .Distinct()
17337 .ToList();
17338
17339 int mainPartIndex = mainPart != null ? _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(mainPart) : -1;
17340
17341 var allParts = _designControl.Entities.Where(IsValidPartEntity).ToList();
17342 bool isMultiPart = allParts.Count > 1;
17343
17344 var shellMeshEntities = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.LayerName != null && e.LayerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
17345 bool hasShellMesh = shellMeshEntities.Count > 0;
17346 bool moveAllParts = false;
17347
17348 if (isMultiPart && hasShellMesh)
17349 {
17350 var result = MessageBox.Show(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBoxQuestion_MoveAllPartsWithShell") ?? "You are moving a part in a multiple part setup. Do you want to move all the parts together? If you choose 'No' to move only this part, the generated shell mesh will become broken and will require regenerating.", "SmartFitSystems", MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Question);
17351 moveAllParts = result == MessageBoxResult.Yes;
17352 }
17353 else if (!isMultiPart)
17354 {
17355 moveAllParts = true;
17356 }
17357
17358 if (moveAllParts)
17359 {
17360 // Add all other parts and their associated entities
17361 foreach (var part in allParts)
17362 {
17363 var assoc = GetManipulationEntitiesForPart(part);
17364 foreach (var a in assoc)
17365 {
17366 if (!IsPathVisualEntity(a) && !selectedEntities.Contains(a))
17367 selectedEntities.Add(a);
17368 else if (IsPathVisualEntity(a) && !selectedPathVisualEntities.Contains(a))
17369 selectedPathVisualEntities.Add(a);
17370 }
17371 }
17372 }
17373
17374 var movedEntityIndices = new HashSet<int>();
17375 if (moveAllParts)
17376 {
17377 foreach (var part in allParts)
17378 {
17379 int idx = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(part);
17380 if (idx >= 0) movedEntityIndices.Add(idx);
17381 }
17382 }
17383 else if (mainPartIndex >= 0)
17384 {
17385 movedEntityIndices.Add(mainPartIndex);
17386 }
17387
17388 var exclusiveFallbackColors = mainPartIndex >= 0
17389 ? GetExclusiveFallbackColorsForPart(mainPartIndex)
17390 : new HashSet<Color>();
17391 var affectedPathColors = mainPartIndex >= 0
17392 ? GetPathColorsForPart(mainPartIndex, exclusiveFallbackColors)
17393 : new HashSet<Color>();
17394 foreach (var color in GetPathColorsFromVisualEntities(selectedPathVisualEntities))
17395 affectedPathColors.Add(color);
17396
17397 // --- PRE-MOVE STATE CAPTURE ---
17398 var oldPathsState = new Dictionary<Color, ColorPath>();
17399 if (_pathManager != null && _pathManager.ColorPaths != null)
17400 {
17401 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
17402 {
17403 oldPathsState[kvp.Key] = kvp.Value.CloneState();
17404 }
17405 }
17406
17407 var bridgeSnapshot = _pathManager?.CaptureAffectedBridgeState(movedEntityIndices, exclusiveFallbackColors);
17408 devDept.Eyeshot.Control.Grid? associatedGrid = null;
17409
17410 if (mainPart != null && _designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
17411 {
17412 var originEntity = selectedEntities.FirstOrDefault(e => IsPartOriginEntityForPart(e, mainPart));
17413 if (originEntity is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference brOrigin)
17414 {
17415 Point3D oldOriginPt = new Point3D(brOrigin.InsertionPoint.X, brOrigin.InsertionPoint.Y, brOrigin.InsertionPoint.Z);
17416
17417 foreach (var grid in _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids)
17418 {
17419 if (grid != _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids[0]) // Skip main
17420 {
17421 if (Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.X - oldOriginPt.X) < 1 &&
17422 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Y - oldOriginPt.Y) < 1 &&
17423 Math.Abs(grid.Plane.Origin.Z - oldOriginPt.Z) < 1)
17424 {
17425 associatedGrid = grid;
17426 }
17427 }
17428 }
17429 }
17430 }
17431
17432 bool hasPathsToMove = affectedPathColors.Count > 0 || selectedPathVisualEntities.Count > 0;
17433 bool shouldMovePaths = false;
17434
17435 bool movedPart = true;
17436 if (hasPathsToMove)
17437 {
17438 var result = MessageBox.Show(GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBoxQuestion_MovePathsWithObject") ?? "Path planning was already generated for this object. Do you want to move the paths alongside the object?", "SmartFitSystems", MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Question);
17439 shouldMovePaths = result == MessageBoxResult.Yes;
17440 }
17441
17442 foreach (var shellMeshEntity in shellMeshEntities)
17443 {
17444 if (!selectedEntities.Contains(shellMeshEntity))
17445 selectedEntities.Add(shellMeshEntity);
17446 }
17447
17448 _designControl.Entities.ClearSelection();
17449 foreach (var ent in selectedEntities)
17450 {
17451 ent.Selected = true;
17452 }
17453 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Apply();
17454
17455 // Transform cached shell mesh DTOs so they stay in sync with the moved geometry.
17456 // This must happen before Regen() which can destroy standalone Mesh vertex data.
17457 if (movedPart)
17458 TransformCachedShellMeshDTOs(appliedTransform);
17459
17460 if (hasShellMesh)
17461 {
17462 _pathManager?.TransformShellCache(appliedTransform);
17463 }
17464
17465 if (mainPartIndex >= 0)
17466 {
17467 TransformCadPlanningMetadataForEntities(movedEntityIndices, appliedTransform);
17468 }
17469
17470 if (mainPartIndex >= 0)
17471 {
17472 _ignoredItemManager?.ApplyTransformation(mainPartIndex, appliedTransform);
17473 }
17474
17475 if (associatedGrid != null)
17476 {
17477 var plane = associatedGrid.Plane;
17478 plane.TransformBy(appliedTransform);
17479 associatedGrid.Plane = plane;
17480 }
17481
17482 CleanUpOverlappingOriginGrids();
17483
17484 if (hasPathsToMove && _pathManager != null)
17485 {
17486 if (shouldMovePaths)
17487 {
17488 var changedPathColors = _pathManager.ApplyPartMoveToPathDataFromSnapshot(
17489 oldPathsState,
17490 movedEntityIndices,
17491 exclusiveFallbackColors,
17492 appliedTransform);
17493
17494 foreach (var color in _pathManager.ReconnectAffectedHighZBridges(bridgeSnapshot, movedEntityIndices, exclusiveFallbackColors, appliedTransform))
17495 changedPathColors.Add(color);
17496
17497 foreach (var color in changedPathColors)
17498 affectedPathColors.Add(color);
17499
17500 _pathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
17501 }
17502 else
17503 {
17504 RestorePathStates(oldPathsState, affectedPathColors);
17505 _pathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
17506 }
17507 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
17508 }
17509
17510 _selectionUtils.ClearDesignControlSelection();
17511 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
17512 _designControl.Invalidate();
17513
17514 if (movedPart)
17515 {
17516 // --- POST-MOVE COMMAND CREATION ---
17517 var compositeCommands = new List<IUndoCommand>();
17518 if (mainPart != null)
17519 {
17520 var movedGeometryEntities = selectedEntities
17521 .Where(e => e != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(e))
17522 .Distinct()
17523 .ToList();
17524
17525 if (!movedGeometryEntities.Contains(mainPart))
17526 movedGeometryEntities.Add(mainPart);
17527
17528 if (movedGeometryEntities.Count > 0)
17529 compositeCommands.Add(new MovePartCommand(_designControl, movedGeometryEntities, appliedTransform, _ignoredItemManager, movedGeometryEntities));
17530 }
17531
17532 if (mainPartIndex >= 0)
17533 {
17534 var metadataEntityIndices = new HashSet<int>(movedEntityIndices);
17535 var metadataRedoTransform = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)appliedTransform.Clone();
17536 var metadataUndoTransform = (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)appliedTransform.Clone();
17537 metadataUndoTransform.Invert();
17538
17539 compositeCommands.Add(new ActionUndoCommand(
17540 undoAction: () =>
17541 {
17542 TransformCadPlanningMetadataForEntities(metadataEntityIndices, (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)metadataUndoTransform.Clone());
17543 if (!moveAllParts && hasShellMesh)
17544 {
17545 // Relies on live fingerprint validation to regenerate automatically
17546 }
17547 else if (hasShellMesh)
17548 _pathManager?.TransformShellCache((devDept.Geometry.Transformation)metadataUndoTransform.Clone());
17549 },
17550 redoAction: () =>
17551 {
17552 TransformCadPlanningMetadataForEntities(metadataEntityIndices, (devDept.Geometry.Transformation)metadataRedoTransform.Clone());
17553 if (!moveAllParts && hasShellMesh)
17554 {
17555 // Relies on live fingerprint validation to regenerate automatically
17556 }
17557 else if (hasShellMesh)
17558 _pathManager?.TransformShellCache((devDept.Geometry.Transformation)metadataRedoTransform.Clone());
17559 },
17560 description: "Updated CAD planning metadata for moved part",
17561 category: "Part Manipulation"));
17562 }
17563
17564 if (_pathManager != null && _pathManager.ColorPaths != null)
17565 {
17566 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
17567 {
17568 if (oldPathsState.TryGetValue(kvp.Key, out var oldState))
17569 {
17570 var cp = kvp.Value;
17571 if (!ColorPathStatesEqual(oldState, cp))
17572 {
17573 compositeCommands.Add(new UpdateColorPathCommand(_pathManager, _designControl, kvp.Key, oldState, cp.CloneState(), regenerateAllPaths: true));
17574 }
17575 }
17576 }
17577 }
17578
17579 if (compositeCommands.Count == 1)
17580 UndoManager.PushCommand(compositeCommands[0]);
17581 else if (compositeCommands.Count > 1)
17582 UndoManager.PushCommand(new CompositeCommand(compositeCommands));
17583
17584 if (mainPart != null)
17585 {
17586 StoreOriginalPosition(
17587 mainPart,
17588 selectedEntities.Where(e => e != null && !IsPathVisualEntity(e)).Distinct().ToList(),
17589 appliedTransform,
17590 associatedGrid,
17591 oldPathsState,
17592 affectedPathColors);
17593 }
17594 // Relies on live fingerprint validation to regenerate automatically
17595 }
17596 }
17597
17598 _designControl.ObjectManipulator.Cancel(); // Ensure it hides explicitly
17599 _manipulatingEntity = null;
17600 }
17601 }

17608 private Entity? ResolvePartEntity(object? parameter)
17609 {
17610 if (_designControl == null || _designControl.Entities == null) return null;
17611
17612 Entity? partEntity = null;
17613 if (parameter is CADFace face)
17614 {
17615 if (face.EntityIndex >= 0 && face.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
17616 partEntity = _designControl.Entities[face.EntityIndex];
17617 }
17618 else if (parameter is CADHole hole)
17619 {
17620 partEntity = _designControl.Entities.FirstOrDefault(e => e is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Brep brep && hole.FaceGlobalIndices.Any(idx => brep.Faces.Length > idx));
17621 }
17622 else if (parameter is FacePoint)
17623 {
17624 partEntity = _designControl.Entities.FirstOrDefault(e => e is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.Brep);
17625 }
17626 else if (parameter is Entity entParams)
17627 {
17628 partEntity = entParams;
17629 }
17630
17631 partEntity ??= GetSectionCandidateParts().FirstOrDefault();
17632 return partEntity;
17633 }

17640 private List<Entity> GetAssociatedEntities(Entity partEntity)
17641 {
17642 var associatedEntities = new List<Entity> { partEntity };
17643
17644 associatedEntities.AddRange(_designControl.Entities.Where(e => IsPartOwnedManipulationHelper(e, partEntity)));
17645
17646 return associatedEntities.Distinct().ToList();
17647 }
17648
17655 private bool IsPartOwnedManipulationHelper(Entity entity, Entity partEntity)
17656 {
17657 if (entity == null || entity == partEntity || IsPathVisualEntity(entity))
17658 return false;
17659
17660 string? partSource = GetPartSourceKey(partEntity);
17661 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(partSource))
17662 {
17663 string? entitySource = GetPartSourceKey(entity);
17664 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entitySource) &&
17665 string.Equals(entitySource, partSource, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
17666 {
17667 return true;
17668 }
17669 }
17670
17671 if (IsPartOriginEntityForPart(entity, partEntity))
17672 return true;
17673
17674 if (IsBaseAvoidanceVisualEntityForSource(entity, partSource))
17675 return true;
17676
17677 string? layerName = entity.LayerName;
17678 bool isHelperLayer = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(layerName) &&
17679 (layerName.StartsWith("SHELL_", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
17680 layerName.Contains("IGNORED", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
17681 if (!isHelperLayer)
17682 return false;
17683
17684 int partIndex = _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(partEntity);
17685 if (entity.EntityData is CADFace faceData && faceData.EntityIndex == partIndex)
17686 return true;
17687
17688 return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(partSource) &&
17689 entity.EntityData is string helperSource &&
17690 string.Equals(helperSource, partSource, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
17691 }
17692
17699 private bool IsPartOriginEntityForPart(Entity entity, Entity partEntity)
17700 {
17701 if (entity.EntityData is not string entityData ||
17702 !entityData.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
17703 {
17704 return false;
17705 }
17706
17707 string? partSource = GetPartSourceKey(partEntity);
17708 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(partSource))
17709 {
17710 return string.Equals(entityData, $"PART_ORIGIN:{partSource}", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
17711 }
17712
17713 if (!string.Equals(entityData, "PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
17714 return false;
17715
17716 return IsOriginNearPart(entity, partEntity);
17717 }
17718
17724 private static string? GetPartSourceKey(Entity partEntity)
17725 {
17726 if (partEntity.EntityData is not string source ||
17727 string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(source) ||
17728 source.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
17729 source.StartsWith(BaseAvoidancePlaneEntityDataPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
17730 source.StartsWith(BaseAvoidanceLabelEntityDataPrefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
17731 string.Equals(source, "UI_MARKER", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
17732 string.Equals(source, "SECTION_VISUAL", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
17733 string.Equals(source, "IgnoredOverlay_Ref", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
17734 {
17735 return null;
17736 }
17737
17738 return source;
17739 }
17740
17747 private static bool IsOriginNearPart(Entity originEntity, Entity partEntity)
17748 {
17749 if (originEntity is not BlockReference origin)
17750 return false;
17751
17752 try
17753 {
17754 partEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
17755 return origin.InsertionPoint.DistanceTo(partEntity.BoxMin) < 1.0;
17756 }
17757 catch
17758 {
17759 return false;
17760 }
17761 }

17768 private Entity? GetAssociatedPart(Point3D point)
17769 {
17770 if (_allFacesByColor == null || !_allFacesByColor.Any()) return null;
17771
17772 CADFace? closestFace = null;
17773 double minDistance = double.MaxValue;
17774
17775 foreach (var faceList in _allFacesByColor.Values)
17776 {
17777 foreach (var face in faceList)
17778 {
17779 foreach (var mp in face.MeasurementPoints)
17780 {
17781 double dist = point.DistanceTo(new Point3D(mp.X, mp.Y, mp.Z));
17782 if (dist < minDistance)
17783 {
17784 minDistance = dist;
17785 closestFace = face;
17786 }
17787 }
17788 }
17789 }
17790
17791 if (closestFace != null && closestFace.EntityIndex >= 0 && closestFace.EntityIndex < _designControl.Entities.Count)
17792 {
17793 return _designControl.Entities[closestFace.EntityIndex];
17794 }
17795
17796 return null;
17797 }

17806 private bool IsWaypointOnPart(ColorPath path, int pointIndex, Entity part)
17807 {
17808 if (pointIndex < 0 || pointIndex >= path.Points.Count) return false;
17809 var wpPosition = path.Points[pointIndex];
17810 var assocPart = GetAssociatedPart(wpPosition);
17811 return assocPart == part;
17812 }

17815 public ICommand AlignTriadWithOriginGridCommand => alignTriadWithOriginGridCommand ??= new DelegateCommand<object>(AlignTriadWithOriginGrid);

17821 private void AlignTriadWithOriginGrid(object parameter)
17822 {
17823 if (_designControl == null) return;
17824
17825 Entity? partEntity = ResolvePartEntity(parameter);
17826 if (partEntity == null) return;
17827
17828 partEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams());
17829 Point3D newMin = partEntity.BoxMin;
17830 Point3D newMax = partEntity.BoxMax;
17831
17832 // Find associated origin and grid
17833 var originSymbols = _designControl.Entities.Where(e => e.EntityData is string str && str.StartsWith("PART_ORIGIN")).ToList();
17834 var associatedOrigin = originSymbols.OrderBy(o => (o is BlockReference br) ? br.InsertionPoint.DistanceTo(newMin) : double.MaxValue).FirstOrDefault() as BlockReference;
17835
17836 if (associatedOrigin != null)
17837 {
17838 associatedOrigin.Transformation = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateIdentity();
17839 associatedOrigin.InsertionPoint = new Point3D(newMin.X, newMin.Y, newMin.Z);
17840 }
17841
17842 if (_designControl.Viewports.Count > 0)
17843 {
17844 var grid = _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids.OrderBy(g => g.Plane.Origin.DistanceTo(newMin)).FirstOrDefault();
17845 if (grid != null && grid != _designControl.Viewports[0].Grids[0])
17846 {
17847 grid.Plane = new Plane(newMin, Vector3D.AxisX, Vector3D.AxisY);
17848 grid.Max = new Point2D(Math.Max(50, newMax.X - newMin.X), Math.Max(50, newMax.Y - newMin.Y));
17849 }
17850 }
17851
17852 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
17853 _designControl.Invalidate();
17854 }

17864 private Entity? FindNearbyWaypoint(System.Drawing.Point screenPoint, double pixelTolerance = 30.0)
17865 {
17866 Entity? closestWaypoint = null;
17867 double minScreenDist = pixelTolerance;
17868
17869 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
17870 {
17871 if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData wd && wd.Path != null && wd.PointIndex >= 0 && wd.PointIndex < wd.Path.Points.Count)
17872 {
17873 Point3D pt = wd.Path.Points[wd.PointIndex];
17874 Point3D wpScreen = _designControl.WorldToScreen(pt);
17875 if (wpScreen == null) continue;
17876
17877 double dx = screenPoint.X - wpScreen.X;
17878 double dy = screenPoint.Y - wpScreen.Y;
17879 double dist = Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
17880
17881 if (dist < minScreenDist)
17882 {
17883 minScreenDist = dist;
17884 closestWaypoint = ent;
17885 }
17886 }
17887 }
17888 return closestWaypoint;
17889 }

17897 private Point3D GetClosestPointOnPath(LinearPath pathLine, System.Drawing.Point screenPoint)
17898 {
17899 if (pathLine.Vertices.Length < 2) return null!;
17900
17901 var camera = _designControl.ActiveViewport.Camera;
17902 Point3D clickWorldPoint = _designControl.ScreenToWorld(screenPoint);
17903 if (clickWorldPoint == null) return null!;
17904
17905 Point3D rayOrigin;
17906 Vector3D rayDir;
17907
17908 if (camera.ProjectionMode == devDept.Eyeshot.projectionType.Perspective)
17909 {
17910 rayOrigin = camera.Location;
17911 rayDir = new Vector3D(camera.Location, clickWorldPoint);
17912 }
17913 else
17914 {
17915 rayOrigin = clickWorldPoint;
17916 rayDir = new Vector3D(camera.Location, camera.Target);
17917 }
17918 rayDir.Normalize();
17919
17920 Point3D a = pathLine.Vertices[0];
17921 Point3D b = pathLine.Vertices[1];
17922 Vector3D V = new Vector3D(a, b);
17923 Vector3D W0 = new Vector3D(a, rayOrigin);
17924
17925 double bDot = Vector3D.Dot(rayDir, V);
17926 double c = V.LengthSquared;
17927 double d = Vector3D.Dot(rayDir, W0);
17928 double e = Vector3D.Dot(V, W0);
17929
17930 double denom = c - bDot * bDot;
17931 double t = 0;
17932 if (denom < 1e-9)
17933 {
17934 if (c > 1e-9)
17935 {
17936 t = e / c;
17937 }
17938 }
17939 else
17940 {
17941 t = (e - bDot * d) / denom;
17942 }
17943 t = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(1.0, t));
17944
17945 return a + t * V;
17946 }
17947
17954 private LinearPath? FindNearbyPathLine(System.Drawing.Point screenPoint, double pixelTolerance = 150.0)
17955 {
17956 LinearPath? closestPathLine = null;
17957 double minScreenDist = pixelTolerance;
17958
17959 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
17960 {
17961 if (ent is LinearPath pathLine && pathLine.LayerName != null && pathLine.LayerName.StartsWith(PathManager.PATH_LAYER_PREFIX))
17962 {
17963 for (int i = 0; i < pathLine.Vertices.Length - 1; i++)
17964 {
17965 Point3D p1Screen = _designControl.WorldToScreen(pathLine.Vertices[i]);
17966 Point3D p2Screen = _designControl.WorldToScreen(pathLine.Vertices[i + 1]);
17967 if (p1Screen == null || p2Screen == null) continue;
17968
17969 double dist = DistanceToSegment(new Point2D(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y), new Point2D(p1Screen.X, p1Screen.Y), new Point2D(p2Screen.X, p2Screen.Y));
17970 if (dist < minScreenDist)
17971 {
17972 minScreenDist = dist;
17973 closestPathLine = pathLine;
17974 }
17975 }
17976 }
17977 }
17978 return closestPathLine;
17979 }
17980
17988 private double DistanceToSegment(Point2D p, Point2D a, Point2D b)
17989 {
17990 double dx = b.X - a.X;
17991 double dy = b.Y - a.Y;
17992 double l2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
17993 if (l2 < 1e-9)
17994 {
17995 double px = p.X - a.X;
17996 double py = p.Y - a.Y;
17997 return Math.Sqrt(px * px + py * py);
17998 }
17999 double t = ((p.X - a.X) * dx + (p.Y - a.Y) * dy) / l2;
18000 t = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(1, t));
18001 double projX = a.X + t * dx;
18002 double projY = a.Y + t * dy;
18003 double diffX = p.X - projX;
18004 double diffY = p.Y - projY;
18005 return Math.Sqrt(diffX * diffX + diffY * diffY);
18006 }
18007
18015 private (int prevWp, int nextWp) FindSurroundingWaypoints(ColorPath path, int p)
18016 {
18017 int prevWp = 0;
18018 int nextWp = path.Points.Count - 1;
18019
18020 var waypointIndices = new HashSet<int>();
18021 foreach (var ent in _designControl.Entities)
18022 {
18023 if (ent.EntityData is WaypointData wd && wd.Path == path)
18024 {
18025 waypointIndices.Add(wd.PointIndex);
18026 }
18027 }
18028
18029 waypointIndices.Add(0);
18030 waypointIndices.Add(path.Points.Count - 1);
18031
18032 for (int i = p - 1; i >= 0; i--)
18033 {
18034 if (waypointIndices.Contains(i))
18035 {
18036 prevWp = i;
18037 break;
18038 }
18039 }
18040
18041 for (int i = p + 1; i < path.Points.Count; i++)
18042 {
18043 if (waypointIndices.Contains(i))
18044 {
18045 nextWp = i;
18046 break;
18047 }
18048 }
18049
18050 return (prevWp, nextWp);
18051 }

18090 devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateRotation(devDept.Geometry.Utility.DegToRad(PointRotationY), Vector3D.AxisY) *
18091 devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateRotation(devDept.Geometry.Utility.DegToRad(PointRotationX), Vector3D.AxisX);

18093 var newNormal = (Vector3D)_pointRotationBaseNormal.Clone();
18094 var newUp = (Vector3D)_pointRotationBaseUp.Clone();

18098 newUp.Normalize();

18105 }

18109 {
18110 Point3D pt = wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex];
18111 previewBlock.Transformation = BuildPreviewToolTransform(pt, newNormal, newUp);
18112 _designControl.Invalidate();

18141
18142 private void CheckToolCollisionOnPoint(Entity entity, WaypointData wpData)
18143 {
18144 // 1. Visually place the tool using the existing logic
18145 ShowToolPreviewOnPoint(entity, wpData);
18146
18147 if (_previewToolEntity == null) return;
18148
18149 // Allow UI to render it briefly before locking up with computation
18150 System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.Invoke(() => { }, System.Windows.Threading.DispatcherPriority.Render);
18151
18152 try
18153 {
18154 // 2. Gather ONLY the actual workpiece part entities
18155 var partEntities = OrderedPartEntities.Where(e => e.Visible).ToList();
18156 if (partEntities.Count == 0) return;
18157
18158 // 3. Extract tool mesh with transformation applied
18159 Mesh? toolMesh = ExtractTransformedToolMesh(_previewToolEntity);
18160 if (toolMesh == null || toolMesh.Vertices == null || toolMesh.Vertices.Length == 0) return;
18161
18162 // 4. Extract part meshes
18163 var partMeshes = new List<(Entity Entity, Mesh Mesh)>();
18164 foreach (var partEnt in partEntities)
18165 {
18166 Mesh? partMesh = ExtractEntityMesh(partEnt);
18167 if (partMesh != null)
18168 partMeshes.Add((partEnt, partMesh));
18169 }
18170 if (partMeshes.Count == 0) return;
18171
18172 // 5. SOLID COLLISION CHECK (ray-casting containment + surface intersection)
18173 bool hasExactCollision = false;
18174 var collidedParts = new HashSet<string>();
18175 int intersectionPointsCount = 0;
18176
18177 // 5a. Ray-cast containment: sample multiple tool vertices and check if inside part
18178 var samplePoints = GetToolSamplePoints(toolMesh);
18179 foreach (var (partEnt, partMesh) in partMeshes)
18180 {
18181 foreach (var samplePt in samplePoints)
18182 {
18183 if (IsToolPointInsideMesh(samplePt, partMesh))
18184 {
18185 hasExactCollision = true;
18186 string partName = partEnt.EntityData as string ?? "Unknown Part";
18187 collidedParts.Add(System.IO.Path.GetFileName(partName));
18188 break;
18189 }
18190 }
18191 if (hasExactCollision) break;
18192 }
18193
18194 // 5b. Also check surface intersection using Eyeshot (catches partial surface crossings)
18195 if (!hasExactCollision)
18196 {
18197 var testEntities = new List<Entity>(partEntities);
18198 testEntities.Add(_previewToolEntity);
18199 var cdExact = new devDept.Eyeshot.CollisionDetection(testEntities, _designControl.Blocks, false, devDept.Eyeshot.collisionCheckType.Accurate, nodeMaxItemCount: 5);
18200 cdExact.DoWork();
18201
18202 if (cdExact.Result != null && cdExact.Result.Length > 0)
18203 {
18204 var exactResults = cdExact.Result.Where(r =>
18205 r.CollidedEntities.Item1.Entity == _previewToolEntity ||
18206 r.CollidedEntities.Item2.Entity == _previewToolEntity).ToList();
18207 hasExactCollision = exactResults.Count > 0;
18208
18209 foreach (var r in exactResults)
18210 {
18211 var otherEnt = (r.CollidedEntities.Item1.Entity == _previewToolEntity) ? r.CollidedEntities.Item2.Entity : r.CollidedEntities.Item1.Entity;
18212 string partName = otherEnt.EntityData as string ?? "Unknown Part";
18213 collidedParts.Add(System.IO.Path.GetFileName(partName));
18214 if (r.CollisionItems != null) intersectionPointsCount += System.Linq.Enumerable.Count(r.CollisionItems);
18215 }
18216 }
18217 }
18218
18219 // Determine normal direction for tolerance/depth check: use the point's normal; for approach points use the adjacent measurement point normal
18220 devDept.Geometry.Vector3D normal = new devDept.Geometry.Vector3D(0, 0, 1);
18221 if (wpData.Path?.Normals != null && wpData.PointIndex >= 0 && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.Normals.Count)
18222 {
18223 normal = wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex];
18224
18225 bool isApproach = wpData.Path.PointTypes != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.PointTypes.Count &&
18226 string.Equals(wpData.Path.PointTypes[wpData.PointIndex], "Approach", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
18227 if (isApproach)
18228 {
18229 int mIdx = -1;
18230 if (wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.Points.Count && wpData.PointIndex + 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count && wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex + 1])
18231 mIdx = wpData.PointIndex + 1;
18232 else if (wpData.Path.IsMeasure != null && wpData.PointIndex > 0 && wpData.PointIndex - 1 < wpData.Path.IsMeasure.Count && wpData.Path.IsMeasure[wpData.PointIndex - 1])
18233 mIdx = wpData.PointIndex - 1;
18234 if (mIdx >= 0 && mIdx < wpData.Path.Normals.Count)
18235 normal = wpData.Path.Normals[mIdx];
18236 }
18237 }
18238
18239 // 6. TOLERANCE CHECK — always performed when tolerance > 0
18240 double tolerance = 2.0;
18241 if (_pathManager != null)
18242 {
18243 tolerance = _pathManager.FilterConfig.CollisionTolerance;
18244 }
18245 else
18246 {
18247 if (double.TryParse(System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["ProbeCollision_CollisionTolerance"],
18248 System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Any, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double parsedTol))
18249 {
18250 tolerance = Math.Max(0.0, parsedTol);
18251 }
18252 }
18253 bool hasToleranceCollision = false;
18254
18255 if (tolerance > 0)
18256 {
18257
18258 // Move tool outward along normal by tolerance and re-check with both methods
18259 devDept.Geometry.Vector3D moveVec = normal * tolerance;
18260
18261 // Ray-cast: offset sample points
18262 var offsetSamples = samplePoints.Select(p => new Point3D(p.X + moveVec.X, p.Y + moveVec.Y, p.Z + moveVec.Z)).ToList();
18263 foreach (var (partEnt, partMesh) in partMeshes)
18264 {
18265 foreach (var sp in offsetSamples)
18266 {
18267 if (IsToolPointInsideMesh(sp, partMesh)) { hasToleranceCollision = true; break; }
18268 }
18269 if (hasToleranceCollision) break;
18270 }
18271
18272 // Eyeshot surface intersection with translated tool
18273 if (!hasToleranceCollision)
18274 {
18275 _previewToolEntity.Translate(moveVec);
18276 _previewToolEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams(_designControl));
18277 var testEntities = new List<Entity>(partEntities) { _previewToolEntity };
18278 var cdTol = new devDept.Eyeshot.CollisionDetection(testEntities, _designControl.Blocks, false, devDept.Eyeshot.collisionCheckType.Accurate, nodeMaxItemCount: 5);
18279 cdTol.DoWork();
18280 if (cdTol.Result != null && cdTol.Result.Length > 0)
18281 hasToleranceCollision = cdTol.Result.Any(r => r.CollidedEntities.Item1.Entity == _previewToolEntity || r.CollidedEntities.Item2.Entity == _previewToolEntity);
18282 _previewToolEntity.Translate(moveVec * -1);
18283 _previewToolEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams(_designControl));
18284 }
18285 }
18286 else
18287 {
18288 hasToleranceCollision = hasExactCollision;
18289 }
18290
18291 // 7. Calculate exact penetration depth (binary search) if collides
18292 double collisionDepth = 0.0;
18293 if (hasExactCollision)
18294 {
18295 double maxCheck = 50.0;
18296 Func<double, bool> checkDist = (d) =>
18297 {
18298 devDept.Geometry.Vector3D mVec = normal * d;
18299 var offSamples = samplePoints.Select(p => new Point3D(p.X + mVec.X, p.Y + mVec.Y, p.Z + mVec.Z)).ToList();
18300 bool hit = false;
18301 foreach (var (partEnt, partMesh) in partMeshes)
18302 {
18303 foreach (var sp in offSamples)
18304 if (IsToolPointInsideMesh(sp, partMesh)) { hit = true; break; }
18305 if (hit) break;
18306 }
18307 if (!hit)
18308 {
18309 _previewToolEntity.Translate(mVec);
18310 _previewToolEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams(_designControl));
18311 var cdDist = new devDept.Eyeshot.CollisionDetection(new List<Entity>(partEntities) { _previewToolEntity }, _designControl.Blocks, false, devDept.Eyeshot.collisionCheckType.Accurate, nodeMaxItemCount: 5);
18312 cdDist.DoWork();
18313 if (cdDist.Result != null && cdDist.Result.Length > 0)
18314 hit = cdDist.Result.Any(r => r.CollidedEntities.Item1.Entity == _previewToolEntity || r.CollidedEntities.Item2.Entity == _previewToolEntity);
18315 _previewToolEntity.Translate(mVec * -1);
18316 _previewToolEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams(_designControl));
18317 }
18318 return hit;
18319 };
18320
18321 if (checkDist(maxCheck))
18322 {
18323 collisionDepth = maxCheck; // > maxCheck actually
18324 }
18325 else
18326 {
18327 double low = 0.0;
18328 double high = maxCheck;
18329 for (int iter = 0; iter < 8; iter++)
18330 {
18331 double mid = (low + high) / 2.0;
18332 if (checkDist(mid)) low = mid;
18333 else high = mid;
18334 }
18335 collisionDepth = high;
18336 }
18337 }
18338
18339 // 8. Display results
18340 string title = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_Title") ?? "Point Collision Check";
18341 string statsHeader = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_StatsHeader") ?? "--- Collision Stats ---";
18342 string exactStatStr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_ExactStat") ?? "Exact Collision (0 mm):";
18343 string toleranceStatStr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_ToleranceStat") ?? "Tolerance Collision";
18344 string yesStr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_Yes") ?? "YES";
18345 string noStr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_No") ?? "NO";
18346 string penGtr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_PenetrationGreater") ?? "(Penetration > {0} mm)";
18347 string penLte = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_PenetrationLess") ?? "(Penetration <= {0} mm)";
18348 string colPartsStr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_CollidedParts") ?? "Collided Parts:";
18349 string intPointsStr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_IntersectionPoints") ?? "Intersection Points:";
18350 string estimatedDepthStr = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_EstimatedDepth") ?? "Estimated Collision Depth: ~{0} mm";
18351
18352 var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
18353
18354 if (hasExactCollision)
18355 {
18356 bool isWarningOnly = tolerance > 0 && !hasToleranceCollision;
18357
18358 if (isWarningOnly)
18359 {
18360 string warnMsg = (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_WarningCleared") ?? "Collision Detected within Tolerance!\nThe tool collides at exact position, but clears when moved out by {0} mm.").Replace("\\n", "\n");
18361 sb.AppendLine(string.Format(warnMsg, tolerance.ToString("F1")));
18362 }
18363 else
18364 {
18365 sb.AppendLine((GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_CollisionFound") ?? "Exact Collision Detected!\nThe tool model collides with the part.").Replace("\\n", "\n"));
18366 }
18367
18368 sb.AppendLine();
18369 sb.AppendLine(statsHeader);
18370 sb.AppendLine($"{exactStatStr} {yesStr}");
18371 sb.AppendLine(string.Format(estimatedDepthStr, collisionDepth.ToString("F1")));
18372
18373 if (hasToleranceCollision)
18374 sb.AppendLine($"{toleranceStatStr} (+{tolerance} mm): {yesStr} " + string.Format(penGtr, tolerance));
18375 else
18376 sb.AppendLine($"{toleranceStatStr} (+{tolerance} mm): {noStr} " + string.Format(penLte, tolerance));
18377
18378 sb.AppendLine();
18379 sb.AppendLine($"{colPartsStr} {string.Join(", ", collidedParts)}");
18380 if (intersectionPointsCount > 0) sb.AppendLine($"{intPointsStr} {intersectionPointsCount}");
18381
18382 if (isWarningOnly)
18383 {
18384 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(sb.ToString(), title, System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
18385 }
18386 else
18387 {
18388 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(sb.ToString(), title, System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
18389 }
18390 }
18391 else
18392 {
18393 if (hasToleranceCollision)
18394 {
18395 string msg = (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_ClearExactButToleranceHit") ?? "Clear of Exact Collision (0 mm),\nBUT Tolerance Collision (+{0} mm) Detected!\nThe tool is within {0} mm of the part.").Replace("\\n", "\n");
18396 sb.AppendLine(string.Format(msg, tolerance.ToString("F1")));
18397 }
18398 else
18399 {
18400 string msg = (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PointCollisionCheck_Clear") ?? "Clear of Collisions!\nThe tool does not collide with the part and the minimum distance ({0} mm) is safe (above {1} mm tolerance).").Replace("\\n", "\n");
18401 sb.AppendLine(string.Format(msg, "> " + tolerance.ToString("F1"), tolerance.ToString("F1")));
18402 }
18403 sb.AppendLine();
18404 sb.AppendLine(statsHeader);
18405 sb.AppendLine($"{exactStatStr} {noStr}");
18406 if (tolerance > 0)
18407 sb.AppendLine($"{toleranceStatStr} (+{tolerance} mm): {(hasToleranceCollision ? yesStr : noStr)}");
18408
18409 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(sb.ToString(), title, System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, hasToleranceCollision ? System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning : System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Information);
18410 }
18411 }
18412 catch (Exception ex)
18413 {
18414 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show("Error during collision check: " + ex.Message, "Error", System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK, System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
18415 }
18416 }
18417
18418 private Mesh? ExtractEntityMesh(Entity entity)
18419 {
18420 if (entity == null) return null;
18421 if (entity is Mesh m) return m;
18422 if (entity is Brep brep)
18423 {
18424 var combinedMesh = new Mesh();
18425 foreach (var face in brep.Faces)
18426 {
18427 var faceMesh = face?.ConvertToMesh();
18428 if (faceMesh != null && faceMesh.Vertices != null && faceMesh.Vertices.Length > 0)
18429 {
18430 int offset = combinedMesh.Vertices?.Length ?? 0;
18431 var newVerts = (combinedMesh.Vertices ?? Array.Empty<Point3D>()).Concat(faceMesh.Vertices ?? Array.Empty<Point3D>()).ToArray();
18432 var newTris = (combinedMesh.Triangles?.ToList() ?? new List<IndexTriangle>());
18433 if (faceMesh.Triangles != null)
18434 {
18435 foreach (var tri in faceMesh.Triangles)
18436 newTris.Add(new IndexTriangle(tri.V1 + offset, tri.V2 + offset, tri.V3 + offset));
18437 }
18438 combinedMesh.Vertices = newVerts;
18439 combinedMesh.Triangles = newTris.ToArray();
18440 }
18441 }
18442 return combinedMesh.Vertices?.Length > 0 ? combinedMesh : null;
18443 }
18444 if (entity is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference br && _designControl?.Blocks != null && _designControl.Blocks.Contains(br.BlockName))
18445 {
18446 var block = _designControl.Blocks[br.BlockName];
18447 var combinedMesh = new Mesh();
18448 foreach (var innerEnt in block.Entities)
18449 {
18450 var innerMesh = ExtractEntityMesh(innerEnt);
18451 if (innerMesh != null && innerMesh.Vertices != null && innerMesh.Vertices.Length > 0)
18452 {
18453 var cloned = (Mesh)innerMesh.Clone();
18454 cloned.TransformBy(br.Transformation);
18455 int offset = combinedMesh.Vertices?.Length ?? 0;
18456 var newVerts = (combinedMesh.Vertices ?? Array.Empty<Point3D>()).Concat(cloned.Vertices ?? Array.Empty<Point3D>()).ToArray();
18457 var newTris = (combinedMesh.Triangles?.ToList() ?? new List<IndexTriangle>());
18458 if (cloned.Triangles != null)
18459 {
18460 foreach (var tri in cloned.Triangles)
18461 newTris.Add(new IndexTriangle(tri.V1 + offset, tri.V2 + offset, tri.V3 + offset));
18462 }
18463 combinedMesh.Vertices = newVerts;
18464 combinedMesh.Triangles = newTris.ToArray();
18465 }
18466 }
18467 return combinedMesh.Vertices?.Length > 0 ? combinedMesh : null;
18468 }
18469 return null;
18470 }
18471
18472 private Mesh? ExtractTransformedToolMesh(Entity toolEntity)
18473 {
18474 return ExtractEntityMesh(toolEntity);
18475 }
18476
18477 private List<Point3D> GetToolSamplePoints(Mesh toolMesh)
18478 {
18479 var points = new List<Point3D>();
18480 if (toolMesh?.Vertices == null || toolMesh.Vertices.Length == 0)
18481 return points;
18482
18483 double cx = 0, cy = 0, cz = 0;
18484 double minX = double.MaxValue, minY = double.MaxValue, minZ = double.MaxValue;
18485 double maxX = double.MinValue, maxY = double.MinValue, maxZ = double.MinValue;
18486
18487 foreach (var v in toolMesh.Vertices)
18488 {
18489 cx += v.X; cy += v.Y; cz += v.Z;
18490 if (v.X < minX) minX = v.X; if (v.X > maxX) maxX = v.X;
18491 if (v.Y < minY) minY = v.Y; if (v.Y > maxY) maxY = v.Y;
18492 if (v.Z < minZ) minZ = v.Z; if (v.Z > maxZ) maxZ = v.Z;
18493 }
18494
18495 int count = toolMesh.Vertices.Length;
18496 points.Add(new Point3D(cx / count, cy / count, cz / count)); // Centroid
18497 points.Add(new Point3D((minX + maxX) / 2.0, (minY + maxY) / 2.0, (minZ + maxZ) / 2.0)); // BBox Center
18498 points.Add(new Point3D(minX, minY, minZ));
18499 points.Add(new Point3D(maxX, maxY, maxZ));
18500 points.Add(new Point3D(minX, maxY, maxZ));
18501 points.Add(new Point3D(maxX, minY, minZ));
18502
18503 // Also sample a subset of actual vertices if mesh is detailed
18504 int step = Math.Max(1, count / 16);
18505 for (int i = 0; i < count; i += step)
18506 {
18507 points.Add(toolMesh.Vertices[i]);
18508 }
18509
18510 return points;
18511 }
18512
18517 private bool IsToolPointInsideMesh(Point3D point, Mesh mesh)
18518 {
18519 if (mesh?.Vertices == null || mesh.Triangles == null || mesh.Triangles.Length == 0)
18520 return false;
18521
18522 try
18523 {
18524 // Bounding box check
18525 double minX = double.MaxValue, minY = double.MaxValue, minZ = double.MaxValue;
18526 double maxX = double.MinValue, maxY = double.MinValue, maxZ = double.MinValue;
18527 foreach (var v in mesh.Vertices)
18528 {
18529 if (v.X < minX) minX = v.X; if (v.X > maxX) maxX = v.X;
18530 if (v.Y < minY) minY = v.Y; if (v.Y > maxY) maxY = v.Y;
18531 if (v.Z < minZ) minZ = v.Z; if (v.Z > maxZ) maxZ = v.Z;
18532 }
18533 if (point.X < minX || point.X > maxX || point.Y < minY || point.Y > maxY || point.Z < minZ || point.Z > maxZ)
18534 return false;
18535
18536 // Ray casting along +Z axis to count intersections
18537 Vector3D rayDir = Vector3D.AxisZ;
18538 int intersectionCount = 0;
18539 const double EPSILON = 0.0000001;
18540
18541 foreach (var tri in mesh.Triangles)
18542 {
18543 if (tri.V1 >= mesh.Vertices.Length || tri.V2 >= mesh.Vertices.Length || tri.V3 >= mesh.Vertices.Length)
18544 continue;
18545
18546 var v0 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V1];
18547 var v1 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V2];
18548 var v2 = mesh.Vertices[tri.V3];
18549
18550 // Fast AABB check for the ray column
18551 double tMinX = Math.Min(v0.X, Math.Min(v1.X, v2.X));
18552 double tMaxX = Math.Max(v0.X, Math.Max(v1.X, v2.X));
18553 double tMinY = Math.Min(v0.Y, Math.Min(v1.Y, v2.Y));
18554 double tMaxY = Math.Max(v0.Y, Math.Max(v1.Y, v2.Y));
18555 if (point.X < tMinX || point.X > tMaxX || point.Y < tMinY || point.Y > tMaxY)
18556 continue;
18557 double tMaxZ = Math.Max(v0.Z, Math.Max(v1.Z, v2.Z));
18558 if (point.Z > tMaxZ)
18559 continue;
18560
18561 // Möller–Trumbore intersection test
18562 Vector3D edge1 = new Vector3D(v1.X - v0.X, v1.Y - v0.Y, v1.Z - v0.Z);
18563 Vector3D edge2 = new Vector3D(v2.X - v0.X, v2.Y - v0.Y, v2.Z - v0.Z);
18564 Vector3D h = Vector3D.Cross(rayDir, edge2);
18565 double a = Vector3D.Dot(edge1, h);
18566 if (a > -EPSILON && a < EPSILON) continue;
18567
18568 double f = 1.0 / a;
18569 Vector3D s = new Vector3D(point.X - v0.X, point.Y - v0.Y, point.Z - v0.Z);
18570 double u = f * Vector3D.Dot(s, h);
18571 if (u < 0.0 || u > 1.0) continue;
18572
18573 Vector3D q = Vector3D.Cross(s, edge1);
18574 double vParam = f * Vector3D.Dot(rayDir, q);
18575 if (vParam < 0.0 || u + vParam > 1.0) continue;
18576
18577 double t = f * Vector3D.Dot(edge2, q);
18578 if (t > EPSILON)
18579 intersectionCount++;
18580 }
18581
18582 return intersectionCount % 2 == 1;
18583 }
18584 catch
18585 {
18586 return false;
18587 }
18588 }

18590 private void ShowToolPreviewOnPoint(Entity entity, WaypointData wpData)
18591 {
18592 HideToolPreview();
18593
18594 if (_pathManager == null) return;
18595 string toolName = _pathManager.CurrentSimulationToolName;
18596 if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(toolName)) toolName = wpData.Path.ToolName;
18597 if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(toolName)) return;
18598
18599 Entity? toolEntity = null;
18600 if (wpData.Path.PathCmmType == Models.CMMType.Scanner)
18601 {
18602 toolEntity = Utilities.ToolModelLoader.LoadMachineModel(toolName, _designControl);
18603 }
18604 else
18605 {
18606 double r = _pathManager.FilterConfig.ProbeRadius;
18607 double h = _pathManager.FilterConfig.ProbeHeight;
18608 toolEntity = Utilities.ToolModelLoader.LoadToolModel(toolName, r, h, _designControl);
18609 if (toolEntity == null)
18610 {
18611 double defaultToolSizeMultiplier = Math.Max(0.01, _pathManager.FilterConfig.SimulationDefaultToolSizeMultiplier);
18612 double defaultRadius = r * defaultToolSizeMultiplier;
18613 double defaultHeight = h * defaultToolSizeMultiplier;
18614 toolEntity = Utilities.ToolModelLoader.CreateDefaultCylinderProbe(defaultRadius, defaultHeight, Point3D.Origin);
18615 toolEntity.Color = System.Drawing.Color.Red;
18616 toolEntity.ColorMethod = colorMethodType.byEntity;
18617 }
18618 }
18619
18620 if (toolEntity == null) return;
18621
18622 if (!(toolEntity is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference))
18623 {
18624 string blockName = "PreviewToolBlock_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
18625 var block = new devDept.Eyeshot.Block(blockName);
18626 block.Entities.Add(toolEntity);
18627 _designControl.Blocks.Add(block);
18628 toolEntity = new devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference(0, 0, 0, blockName, 1, 1, 1, 0);
18629 }
18630
18631 Point3D pt = wpData.Path.Points[wpData.PointIndex];
18632 Vector3D normal = wpData.Path.Normals[wpData.PointIndex];
18633 Vector3D? up = null;
18634 if (wpData.Path.UpVectors != null && wpData.PointIndex < wpData.Path.UpVectors.Count)
18635 up = wpData.Path.UpVectors[wpData.PointIndex];
18636
18637 if (toolEntity is devDept.Eyeshot.Entities.BlockReference blockRef)
18638 {
18639 blockRef.Transformation = BuildPreviewToolTransform(pt, normal, up);
18640 }
18641 _previewToolEntity = toolEntity;
18642 _previewToolEntity.UpdateBoundingBox(new devDept.Eyeshot.TraversalParams(_designControl));
18643 _designControl.Entities.Add(_previewToolEntity);
18644 _designControl.Invalidate();
18645 }
18646
18647 private devDept.Geometry.Transformation BuildPreviewToolTransform(Point3D targetPoint, Vector3D surfaceNormal, Vector3D? upVector)
18648 {
18649 Vector3D rotationTarget = surfaceNormal.Length > 0.0001
18650 ? new Vector3D(surfaceNormal.X, surfaceNormal.Y, surfaceNormal.Z)
18651 : new Vector3D(0, 0, 1);
18652 rotationTarget.Normalize();
18653
18654 Vector3D zAxis = new Vector3D(0, 0, -1);
18655 devDept.Geometry.Transformation rotationTrans = new devDept.Geometry.Transformation();
18656 Vector3D rotationAxis = Vector3D.Cross(zAxis, rotationTarget);
18657 if (rotationAxis.Length > 0.0001)
18658 {
18659 rotationAxis.Normalize();
18660 double angle = Math.Acos(Math.Max(-1.0, Math.Min(1.0, Vector3D.Dot(zAxis, rotationTarget))));
18661 rotationTrans = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateRotation(angle, rotationAxis);
18662 }
18663 else if (Vector3D.Dot(zAxis, rotationTarget) < -0.999)
18664 {
18665 rotationTrans = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateRotation(Math.PI, Vector3D.AxisX);
18666 }
18667
18668 if (upVector != null && upVector.Length > 1e-6)
18669 {
18670 var localY = new Vector3D(0, 1, 0);
18671 localY.TransformBy(rotationTrans);
18672
18673 var projUp = upVector - rotationTarget * Vector3D.Dot(upVector, rotationTarget);
18674 if (projUp.Length > 1e-6)
18675 {
18676 projUp.Normalize();
18677 double rollAngle = Math.Acos(Math.Max(-1.0, Math.Min(1.0, Vector3D.Dot(localY, projUp))));
18678
18679 if (Vector3D.Dot(Vector3D.Cross(localY, projUp), rotationTarget) < 0)
18680 {
18681 rollAngle = -rollAngle;
18682 }
18683
18684 var rollTrans = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateRotation(rollAngle, rotationTarget);
18685 rotationTrans = rollTrans * rotationTrans;
18686 }
18687 }
18688
18689 devDept.Geometry.Transformation translationTrans = devDept.Geometry.Transformation.CreateTranslation(targetPoint.X, targetPoint.Y, targetPoint.Z);
18690 return translationTrans * rotationTrans;
18691 }

18811 private async Task RedoFaceCollisionCheckAsync(object param)
18812 {
18813 if (_pathManager == null || !_pathManager.HasGeneratedProbePaths()) return;
18814 if (_pathManager.IsSimulating)
18815 {
18816 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
18817 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ProbeCollision_Error_SimulationRunning") ?? "Cannot start a probe collision check while a simulation is running. Please stop the simulation first.",
18818 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_RerunFaceSegmentsCollisionCheck") ?? "Check Face Path Segments Collisions",
18819 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
18820 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
18821 return;
18822 }
18823
18824 int selectedEntityIndex = _lastRightClickedPart != null && _designControl != null ? _designControl.Entities.IndexOf(_lastRightClickedPart) : -1;
18825
18826 if (selectedEntityIndex >= 0)
18827 {
18828 var pathsToVerify = _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values
18829 .Where(p => p.PathCmmType == CMMType.Probe && p.Points != null && p.Points.Count > 1)
18830 .Where(p => p.PointEntityIndices != null && p.PointEntityIndices.Contains(selectedEntityIndex))
18831 .ToList();
18832
18833 if (pathsToVerify.Any())
18834 {
18835 HideBaseAvoidancePlaneForCollisionOrSimulation();
18836 await PreloadToolModelsAsync(false);
18837 // Clear previous red marks on these specific paths
18838 foreach (var path in pathsToVerify)
18839 {
18840 path.ProbeCollisionSegmentIndices?.Clear();
18841 }
18842 _pathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
18843
18844 await _pathManager.RunProbeCollisionValidationAsync(promptForSave: false, showNoCollisionMessage: true, pathsToVerify: pathsToVerify);
18845 }
18846 else
18847 {
18848 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
18849 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ProbeCollision_NoFaceProbePaths") ?? "No generated probe paths exist on this face.",
18850 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ContextMenu_RerunFaceSegmentsCollisionCheck") ?? "Check Face Path Segments Collisions",
18851 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
18852 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Information);
18853 }
18854 }
18855 }

18857 private async Task RunProbeCollisionCheckAsync()
18858 {
18859 if (_pathManager == null || !_pathManager.HasGeneratedProbePaths())
18860 return;
18861 if (_pathManager.IsSimulating)
18862 {
18863 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
18864 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ProbeCollision_Error_SimulationRunning") ?? "Cannot start a probe collision check while a simulation is running. Please stop the simulation first.",
18865 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ProbeCollision_Title") ?? "Probe Collision Check",
18866 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
18867 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
18868 return;
18869 }
18870
18871 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
18872 try
18873 {

18875 _measuringToolConfig.ReloadConfiguration();
18876 if (_pathManager.ColorPaths != null)
18877 {
18878 foreach (var colorPath in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
18879 {
18880 if (colorPath.PathCmmType == Models.CMMType.Probe || colorPath.PathCmmType == Models.CMMType.Scanner)
18881 {
18882 string currentToolName = _measuringToolConfig.GetToolForColor(colorPath.Color);
18883 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(currentToolName) && colorPath.ToolName != currentToolName)
18884 {
18885 colorPath.ToolName = currentToolName;
18886 }
18887 }
18888 }
18889 }
18890
18891 HideBaseAvoidancePlaneForCollisionOrSimulation();
18892 string startingText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "StartingProbeCollisionCheck") ?? "Starting probe collision check...";
18893 Machine_Status_ProgressText = startingText;
18894 EyeshotStatus_Text = startingText;
18895 await PreloadToolModelsAsync(false);
18896 await _pathManager.RunProbeCollisionValidationAsync();
18897 EyeshotStatus_Text = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "ProbeCollision_CompleteStatus") ?? "Probe collision check complete.";
18898 }
18899 finally
18900 {
18901 bool wasCancelled = probeCollisionCancelRequested ||
18902 (_pathManager != null && _pathManager.IsProbeCollisionValidationCancellationRequested);
18903 if (!wasCancelled)
18904 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle";
18905 Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
18906 UpdateProbeCollisionCheckMenuVisibility();
18907 }
18908 }
18909
18910 private async Task RunSegmentCollisionCheckAsync()
18911 {
18912 if (_pathManager == null)
18913 return;
18914
18915 HideBaseAvoidancePlaneForCollisionOrSimulation();
18916
18917 int removedUnsafePoints = _pathManager.PruneUnsafeBaseAvoidancePoints();
18918 if (removedUnsafePoints > 0)
18919 {
18920 _pathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
18921 measuring_sp?.PopulatePathViewerTree();
18922 }
18923
18924 if (!_pathManager.CanRunGeneratedPathSegmentCollisionValidation)
18925 {
18926 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
18927 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "SegmentCollision_NoGeneratedSegments") ?? "No generated path segments are available for collision validation, or segment collision validation is disabled.",
18928 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathPlanning_SegmentCollisionTitle") ?? "Path Planning Collision Check",
18929 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
18930 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Information);
18931 return;
18932 }
18933
18934 if (_pathManager.IsSimulating || _pathManager.IsProbeCollisionValidationRunning)
18935 {
18936 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
18937 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "SegmentCollision_Error_SimulationRunning") ?? "Cannot start a segment collision check while simulation or probe collision validation is running.",
18938 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathPlanning_SegmentCollisionTitle") ?? "Path Planning Collision Check",
18939 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
18940 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
18941 return;
18942 }
18943
18944 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
18945
18946 _segmentCollisionCancellationTokenSource?.Dispose();
18947 _segmentCollisionCancellationTokenSource = new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource();
18948
18949 if (measuring_sp != null)
18950 {
18951 measuring_sp.IsSegmentCollisionCheckRunning = true;
18952 measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
18953 }
18954
18955 try
18956 {
18957 DateTime lastSegmentProgressUpdateUtc = DateTime.MinValue;
18958 string runningText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "SegmentCollision_Running") ?? "Running segment collision validation...";
18959 Machine_Status_ProgressText = runningText;
18960 EyeshotStatus_Text = runningText;
18961
18962 _designControl.Entities.Regen();
18963 _designControl.Invalidate();
18964
18965 Action<int, int, int> progress = (processed, total, collisions) =>
18966 {
18967 if (total <= 0)
18968 return;
18969
18970 if (processed < total &&
18971 (DateTime.UtcNow - lastSegmentProgressUpdateUtc).TotalMilliseconds < 30)
18972 {
18973 return;
18974 }
18975
18976 lastSegmentProgressUpdateUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
18977 int percent = (int)Math.Round((processed / (double)Math.Max(1, total)) * 100.0);
18978 int remaining = Math.Max(0, total - processed);
18979 string progressFormat = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_SegmentCollisionValidation")
18980 ?? "Validating segment collisions: {0}/{1} checked, {2} left, {3} collisions";
18981 string progressMessage = string.Format(
18982 CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
18983 progressFormat,
18984 processed,
18985 total,
18986 remaining,
18987 collisions);
18988
18989 Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(() =>
18990 {
18991 Machine_Status_Progress = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(100, percent));
18992 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{progressMessage} ({percent}%)";
18993 });
18994 };
18995
18996 var result = await _pathManager.RunGeneratedPathSegmentCollisionValidationAsync(progress, _segmentCollisionCancellationTokenSource.Token);
18997 if (!result.Completed)
18998 {
18999 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
19000 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Progress_SegmentCollisionValidationSkipped") ?? "Segment collision validation skipped",
19001 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathPlanning_SegmentCollisionTitle") ?? "Path Planning Collision Check",
19002 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
19003 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Information);
19004 return;
19005 }
19006
19007 _pathManager.RegeneratePathVisuals();
19008 measuring_sp?.PopulatePathViewerTree();
19009
19010 string title = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathPlanning_SegmentCollisionTitle") ?? "Path Planning Collision Check";
19011 string message = result.Collisions == 0
19012 ? (GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "SegmentCollision_CompleteNoCollisions") ?? "No segment collisions were found.")
19013 : string.Format(
19014 CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
19015 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "SegmentCollision_CompleteWithCollisions") ?? "{0} segment(s) collide and were marked red.",
19016 result.Collisions);
19017
19018 EyeshotStatus_Text = message;
19019 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
19020 message,
19021 title,
19022 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
19023 result.Collisions == 0 ? System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Information : System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Warning);
19024 }
19025 catch (Exception ex)
19026 {
19027 System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
19028 string.Format(
19029 CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
19030 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "SegmentCollision_Error") ?? "Segment collision validation failed: {0}",
19031 ex.Message),
19032 GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "PathPlanning_SegmentCollisionTitle") ?? "Path Planning Collision Check",
19033 System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
19034 System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
19035 }
19036 finally
19037 {
19038 if (measuring_sp != null)
19039 {
19040 measuring_sp.IsSegmentCollisionCheckRunning = false;
19041 measuring_sp.GeneratePaths_Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
19042 }
19043
19044 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
19045 Machine_Status_ProgressText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "Idle") ?? "Idle";
19046 Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
19047 UpdateProbeCollisionCheckMenuVisibility();
19048 }
19049 }

19181 private async Task PreloadToolModelsAsync(bool isScanner)
19182 {
19183 if (_pathManager == null) return;
19184
19185 var modelsToLoad = new List<(string ModelName, bool IsScanner)>();
19186 var seenModelsToLoad = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
19187
19188 void AddModelToLoad(string modelName, bool isScan)
19189 {
19190 if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(modelName))
19191 return;
19192
19193 string trimmedModelName = modelName.Trim();
19194 string normalizedModelName = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(trimmedModelName);
19195 if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(normalizedModelName))
19196 return;
19197
19198 string key = $"{(isScan ? "scanner" : "tool")}:{normalizedModelName}";
19199 if (seenModelsToLoad.Add(key))
19200 modelsToLoad.Add((trimmedModelName, isScan));
19201 }
19202
19203 // 1. Add tools referenced by all generated paths
19204 if (_pathManager.ColorPaths != null)
19205 {
19206 foreach (var path in _pathManager.ColorPaths.Values)
19207 {
19208 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path.ToolName))
19209 AddModelToLoad(path.ToolName, isScanner);
19210 }
19211 }
19212
19213 // 2. Add currently selected simulation tool
19214 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_pathManager.CurrentSimulationToolName))
19215 {
19216 AddModelToLoad(_pathManager.CurrentSimulationToolName, isScanner);
19217 }
19218
19219 // 3. Add all available tools from disk so hot-swapping never freezes
19220 if (!isScanner)
19221 {
19222 try
19223 {
19224 var allTools = HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.ToolModelLoader.GetAvailableToolNames(includeDefaultTool: false);
19225 foreach (var tool in allTools)
19226 {
19227 AddModelToLoad(tool, false);
19228 }
19229 }
19230 catch (Exception ex)
19231 {
19232 Debug.WriteLine($"WARNING: Error scanning available tool models in PreloadToolModelsAsync: {ex.Message}");
19233 }
19234 }
19235 else
19236 {
19237 try
19238 {
19239 var allScanners = HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.ToolModelLoader.GetAvailableScannerNames();
19240 foreach (var scanner in allScanners)
19241 {
19242 AddModelToLoad(scanner, true);
19243 }
19244 }
19245 catch (Exception ex)
19246 {
19247 Debug.WriteLine($"WARNING: Error scanning available scanner models in PreloadToolModelsAsync: {ex.Message}");
19248 }
19249 }
19250
19251 var uncachedModelsToLoad = modelsToLoad
19252 .Where(model => !HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.ToolModelLoader.IsModelCached(model.ModelName))
19253 .ToList();
19254
19255 if (uncachedModelsToLoad.Any())
19256 {
19257 _isModelLoading = true;
19258 string loadingModelText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "LoadingModel") ?? "Loading Model";
19259 string startingText = GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "StartingSimulation") ?? "Starting Simulation...";
19260
19261 // Set initial progress bar state
19262 System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher?.Invoke(() =>
19263 {
19264 StatusProgressBarColor = new SolidColorBrush(System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(128, 128, 128));
19265 Machine_Status_Progress = 0;
19266 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{startingText} {loadingModelText} (0%)";
19267 });
19268
19269 try
19270 {
19271 for (int modelIndex = 0; modelIndex < uncachedModelsToLoad.Count; modelIndex++)
19272 {
19273 var modelToLoad = uncachedModelsToLoad[modelIndex];
19274 int currentIndex = modelIndex;
19275 await HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.ToolModelLoader.LoadModelIntoCacheAsync(modelToLoad.ModelName, modelToLoad.IsScanner, (percent) =>
19276 {
19277 double overallPercent = ((currentIndex + (percent / 100.0)) / uncachedModelsToLoad.Count) * 100.0;
19278 System.Windows.Application.Current?.Dispatcher?.Invoke(() =>
19279 {
19280 Machine_Status_Progress = overallPercent;
19281 Machine_Status_ProgressText = $"{startingText} {loadingModelText} '{modelToLoad.ModelName}' ({overallPercent:F0}%)";
19282 });
19283 });
19284 }
19285 }
19286 catch (Exception ex)
19287 {
19288 Debug.WriteLine($"WARNING: Error preloading tool models: {ex.Message}");
19289 }
19290 finally
19291 {
19292 _isModelLoading = false;
19293 }
19294 }
19295 }
19296
19297
19301 private void RecalculatePaths()
19302 {
19303 if (_pathManager == null || !_pathManager.ColorPaths.Any()) return;
19304
19305 Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
19306 try
19307 {
19308 // Backup old state for undo
19309 var oldStates = new Dictionary<Color, ColorPath>();
19310 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
19311 {
19312 oldStates[kvp.Key] = kvp.Value.CloneState();
19313 }
19314
19315 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
19316 {
19317 var path = kvp.Value;
19318
19319 // 1. Gather all active waypoint markers for this path
19320 var baseWaypoints = _designControl.Entities
19321 .Where(ent => ent.EntityData is WaypointData wd && wd.Path == path)
19322 .Select(ent => (WaypointData)ent.EntityData)
19323 .OrderBy(wd => wd.PointIndex)
19324 .ToList();
19325
19326 if (baseWaypoints.Count < 2) continue;
19327
19328 // 2. Extract base waypoint info
19329 var baseInfos = baseWaypoints.Select(wd => new
19330 {
19331 Position = (Point3D)path.Points[wd.PointIndex].Clone(),
19332 Normal = (Vector3D)path.Normals[wd.PointIndex].Clone(),
19333 IsMeasure = path.IsMeasure[wd.PointIndex]
19334 }).ToList();
19335
19336 var newPoints = new List<Point3D>();
19337 var newNormals = new List<Vector3D>();
19338 var newIsMeasure = new List<bool>();
19339
19340 newPoints.Add(baseInfos[0].Position);
19341 newNormals.Add(baseInfos[0].Normal);
19342 newIsMeasure.Add(baseInfos[0].IsMeasure);
19343
19344 for (int i = 0; i < baseInfos.Count - 1; i++)
19345 {
19346 var startInfo = baseInfos[i];
19347 var endInfo = baseInfos[i + 1];
19348
19349 bool shouldRecalculate = _lastRightClickedPart == null ||
19350 IsWaypointOnPart(path, baseWaypoints[i].PointIndex, _lastRightClickedPart) ||
19351 IsWaypointOnPart(path, baseWaypoints[i + 1].PointIndex, _lastRightClickedPart);
19352
19353 if (shouldRecalculate)
19354 {
19355 bool isApproachSegment = (startInfo.IsMeasure && !endInfo.IsMeasure) || (!startInfo.IsMeasure && endInfo.IsMeasure);
19356
19357 if (isApproachSegment)
19358 {
19359 newPoints.Add(endInfo.Position);
19360 newNormals.Add(endInfo.Normal);
19361 newIsMeasure.Add(endInfo.IsMeasure);
19362 }
19363 else
19364 {
19365 List<Point3D> segment = _pathManager.PlanCollisionFreePath(startInfo.Position, endInfo.Position);
19366 if (segment != null && segment.Count >= 2)
19367 {
19368 for (int j = 1; j < segment.Count; j++)
19369 {
19370 newPoints.Add(segment[j]);
19371 if (j == segment.Count - 1)
19372 {
19373 newNormals.Add(endInfo.Normal);
19374 newIsMeasure.Add(endInfo.IsMeasure);
19375 }
19376 else
19377 {
19378 newNormals.Add(Vector3D.AxisZ);
19379 newIsMeasure.Add(false);
19380 }
19381 }
19382 }
19383 else
19384 {
19385 newPoints.Add(endInfo.Position);
19386 newNormals.Add(endInfo.Normal);
19387 newIsMeasure.Add(endInfo.IsMeasure);
19388 }
19389 }
19390 }
19391 else
19392 {
19393 // Copy existing points from path.Points[startWpIdx + 1] to path.Points[endWpIdx]
19394 int startWpIdx = baseWaypoints[i].PointIndex;
19395 int endWpIdx = baseWaypoints[i + 1].PointIndex;
19396 for (int k = startWpIdx + 1; k <= endWpIdx; k++)
19397 {
19398 newPoints.Add((Point3D)path.Points[k].Clone());
19399 newNormals.Add((Vector3D)path.Normals[k].Clone());
19400 newIsMeasure.Add(path.IsMeasure[k]);
19401 }
19402 }
19403 }
19404
19405 path.Points = newPoints;
19406 path.Normals = newNormals;
19407 path.IsMeasure = newIsMeasure;
19408
19409 // Draw the path
19410 _pathManager.DrawSinglePath(path);
19411 }
19412
19413 // Push composite undo command for all modified paths
19414 var commands = new List<IUndoCommand>();
19415 foreach (var kvp in _pathManager.ColorPaths)
19416 {
19417 commands.Add(new UpdateColorPathCommand(_pathManager, _designControl, kvp.Key, oldStates[kvp.Key], kvp.Value.CloneState()));
19418 }
19419 UndoManager.PushCommand(new CompositeCommand(commands));
19420
19421 _designControl.Invalidate();
19422 SaveCurrentSession();
19423 }
19424 catch (Exception ex)
19425 {
19426 MessageBox.Show($"Error recalculating paths: {ex.Message}", GetXMLElementValue(DocLanguage, "MessageBox_InternalError") ?? "Error recalculating paths", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
19427 }
19428 finally
19429 {
19430 Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
19431 }
19432 }
19433 #endregion
19434 }
19435}
